Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Cloud Network Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate cloud or enterprise infrastructure and platforms.   • Hands-on knowledge of the named cloud, operating-system, container, or automation technologies.

  • Experience with scripting, automation, source control, or infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and production issues methodically.
  • Strong documentation and cross-team collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Additional hands-on depth in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPN, load balancing, AWS VPC/Azure VNet, and network security.

jobs.description:
At 2U, we are all in on purpose. We are motivated by our mission – to eliminate the back row in education – and connected by our shared passion to deliver world-class digital education at scale. As the parent company of edX, the world’s leading online learning platform, 2U powers more than 4,000 online higher education offerings – from free courses to full degrees. Together with more than 230 colleges, universities, and corporate partners, we are helping to unlock human potential.

What We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Senior Product Support Specialist to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will provide guidance to specialists taking incoming calls, chats or emails from students and faculty; addressing both technical and non-technical inquiries with a white-glove service approach. Your role extends beyond troubleshooting, as you will collaborate closely with other teams to report and analyze bugs, features, and ticket trends, contributing to continuous improvement in our services. You will also be responsible for effectively managing and escalating cases related to faculty or students, ensuring swift and accurate resolutions. This role is essential in maintaining and enhancing the quality of support we offer, making a direct impact on our learning community's success and satisfaction.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To:

  • Customer and Technical Support: Provide comprehensive customer and technical support for students and faculty issues. This includes real-time monitoring of support channels to ensure coverage, and ensuring a positive user experience.
  • Team Leadership and Training: Lead and train the team, assist with new hire onboarding, and coordinate with external departments for technical challenges and needs.
  • Process Improvement and Analysis: Develop and implement initiatives for department efficiency, streamline processes, participate in root cause analysis, and communicate findings.
  • Technical Expertise and Troubleshooting: Master tools like Zoom and Learning Management Systems. Troubleshoot technical issues in coordination with technical teams and stay updated with emerging web technologies.
  • Collaboration and Project Management: Work with internal stakeholders, representing the Support organization, and develop subject-matter expertise. Contribute to support ticket handling and resolution with an emphasis on empathy and quality service.

Things That Should Be In Your Background:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, or related fields.
  • Experience with ticketing or case management systems (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce).
  • Solid technical acumen, including proficiency with Google and/or Microsoft environments.
  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a customer-first mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Flexibility to work evening and weekend hours as needed.
  • Project management and time management skills.
  • Fluent in simplifying and translating technical concepts for varied audiences.

Other Attributes That Will Help You In This Role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • Experience with JIRA and Confluence is a plus.
  • Experience in utilizing data to assess the health and productivity of a team.
  • Experience in supporting online higher education degrees or certificate programs.
  • Multilingual abilities.
  • Enthusiasm for continuous learning and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

Working Conditions

This role supports a 24/7 global operation and requires schedule and location flexibility under a rotational shift agreement, which may include irregular hours and rotating weekends (no more than one per month) as needed to meet business requirements.

Benefits & Culture

Our global employee base is a diverse collection of innovators, dreamers, and doers working together to transform lives through higher education. We believe that every employee can advance our shared purpose, and that life at 2U should be fun and meaningful. If you’re excited by the opportunity to provide over 40 million learners and counting with access to world-class online higher education, then join us – and do work that makes a difference. #NoBackRow

We offer comprehensive benefits (unique per country) and excellent work/life balance.

Full-time, ZA benefits include:

  • 2 complimentary Getsmarter short courses per year
  • Subsidised medical aid with Discovery Health Medical Scheme
  • 4% 2U contribution towards Discovery Life Pension Fund and Group Risk Benefit
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous leave policy including time off to volunteer for non-profit organization, study leave, sports leave and a company-wide festive season break

2U Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At 2U, we are committed to building and sustaining a culture of belonging, respect, and inclusion. We are proud of the steps we’ve taken to bring together an employee base that embodies diverse walks of life, ideas, genders, ages, races, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities and other unique qualities. We strive to offer a workplace where every employee feels empowered by what makes us different, as well as by how we are alike.

For more than a decade, 2U, Inc. has been the digital transformation partner of choice to great non-profit colleges and universities delivering high-quality online education at scale. As the parent company of edX, a leading global online learning platform, 2U provides over 45 million learners with access to world-class education in partnership with more than 230 colleges, universities, and corporations. Our people and technology are powering more than 4,000 digital education offerings — from free courses to full degrees — and helping unlock human potential. To learn more: visit 2U.com.

edX is the education movement for restless learners and a leading global online learning platform from 2U, Inc. At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm’s Identity team is mission-critical to the customer checkout experience. When a customer chooses Affirm, one of the first steps is an identity check, and our ability to make the right decision directly impacts conversion, revenue, fraud exposure, and regulatory compliance. Our team owns Identity for all markets outside North America, playing a key role in Affirm’s international expansion. We are responsible for KYC, user lifecycle management, and identity decisioning across multiple regulatory environments. This work is about shaping how Affirm adapts its core Identity platform to new market dynamics, customer expectations, and compliance requirements.

We are a team of six engineers based across Spain and Poland. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can turn ambiguous business and customer problems into reliable, well-designed technical solutions.

In this role, you will help shape our quarterly technical direction, translate team goals into concrete projects, and identify cross-cutting risks, tradeoffs, and opportunities. You should be comfortable designing across system boundaries, driving collaboration with partner teams, and advocating for technical investments that improve long-term execution. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership beyond shipping code: raising code quality and review standards, making performance, availability, and scale tradeoffs explicit, and improving the operational health of the systems they own. You’ll help reduce toil, create useful playbooks, mentor engineers, support new hires and interns, and contribute to high-signal hiring.

Most importantly, we’re excited to work with someone who leaves things better than they found them, communicates clearly across audiences, uses customer feedback to influence technical plans, and helps the team continuously improve.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on coding role where feature velocity and operational excellence go hand-in-hand. You’ll spend most of your week in the codebase - leveraging AI tools to write robust Kotlin and Python, ship impactful features, investigate complex production issues, and keep our systems rock-solid and reliable. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who wants to work on foundational systems that directly enable Affirm’s global growth.

What You'll Do

· You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
· You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
· You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

· On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What We Look For

· You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
· You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
· Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Role Title: Hematology Physician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Hematology Physicians to participate in a high-impact customer project focused on advancing clinical AI solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. This opportunity is ideal for independent clinical experts interested in leveraging their hematology experience for transformative technology.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and annotate AI Generated transcripts of outpatient hematology clinic conversations for accuracy, clinical completeness, and clarity.
  2. Assess AI Generated documentation sections such as History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment & Plans (A&Ps), providing input on appropriate information inclusion.
  3. Identify and comment on nuances of anticoagulation management, transfusion and iron therapy, treatment toxicities, laboratory discussions, and decision-making processes in clinical documentation.
  4. Provide feedback on how well AI Generated transcripts reflect real-world clinical reasoning and patient interactions, especially during follow-up visits.
  5. Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI scribe outputs or EHR note templates, as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Board certification in Hematology or Oncology with demonstrable outpatient clinical experience.
  2. Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR) and clinical documentation workflows.
  3. Deep familiarity with chemotherapy cycle management and hematologic malignancy care.
  4. Experience in crafting or reviewing patient histories, including histories of present illness and differential diagnosis.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to communicate complex concepts clearly in both written and spoken formats.
  6. Previous participation in clinical research, quality improvement, or AI/data-driven healthcare projects is a plus.
  7. Motivation to support innovative healthcare projects with real-world impact.

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

  6. Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.

The Technical SBM Lead (Supply Base Management Lead) is the senior technical person for Robotics supply base management and reports to the Senior Director of Technical Sourcing. You work with Robotics engineering on the technology roadmap for navigation, precision motion, gears, motors, plastics, sheet metal, and batteries, and you need to know those designs well enough to tell whether a supplier can build the part the way it is drawn.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++.
  • Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. You take the admin load off the Fund Principal so he can focus on sourcing, allocations and raising. You prepare and recommend, and a senior person validates statements, updates and anything sent to investors; you never sign, approve payments or give legal or tax answers.

You report to the Finance Lead, with a dotted line to the Fund Principal, and work closely with the Managing Partner, the Bookkeeper and the Production and Marketing team.

Moj Mahdara is an entrepreneur and investor. She is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Kinship Ventures, the venture platform she launched alongside Gwyneth Paltrow, and the founder of Trolley. Before Kinship, Moj was CEO of Beautycon Media, the global festival and media company built at the intersection of beauty and pop culture.

Trolley is a fast-growing creative operations company delivering high-impact digital and marketing solutions. We work with high-profile clients and founder-led brands to strategize, produce and optimize content that drives engagement, brand visibility and business growth. Our team combines strategy, design, production and performance analysis, and we work AI-first. We are a fast-moving, collaborative remote team that values respect, teamwork and open communication.

What you will own

  • A complete file in Drive for every investor and SPV, from first capital call to latest K-1, with gaps flagged with an owner and a date.
  • The Fund I close checklist, from subscription documents, side letters, KYC and AML to wires and countersignatures, complete by the January 15, 2027 close.
  • The investor tracker and Real Deal CRM, with every touchpoint logged within one business day and a one-page pipeline snapshot ready before the daily partner call.
  • Capital calls and fund administrator requests, with notices sent, receipts tracked, wire instructions verified by phone and every request list cleared.
  • K-1 distribution, the compliance calendar, and the statement and investor update calendar, so every filing and update goes out on time after validation.
  • Data rooms, Carta, entity records and insurance summaries kept current, with one dated final version of each document and access approved and logged.
  • The investor inbox, with routine replies within one business day, plus expense and management fee tracking by entity.
  • A short weekly update, an SOP for every recurring task, AI workflows that save time, and support for the Finance Lead on Trolley finance operations as capacity allows.

Who you are

  • You come from fund operations or financial operations, such as a fund administrator, VC or PE fund, family office, or an accounting, audit, legal operations or investor relations operations team serving funds.
  • You have hands-on experience in at least two of these: capital calls, investor records, K-1 or tax document distribution, investor onboarding, fund administrator requests and entity paperwork.

  • You work comfortably in Google Sheets or Excel, read a capital account statement and check receipts against commitments.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • Advanced use of AI: it is already part of how you work every day.

Nice to have

  • Spanish, or experience with a US-based leadership team in a remote contractor setup.
  • Hands-on use of Carta, Real Deal or a similar CRM, DocuSign and a data room platform.
  • Experience supporting a fund close, placement agent work, investor relations, expense and management fee tracking, or plain-language summaries of insurance policies and agreements.

This role is not

Not an investment analyst, fundraiser, controller, signer, payment approver, legal or tax advisor, or HR role.

  • A skills test
  • A 30-minute interview with the manager
  • A final interview with Moj, our CEO

Description

About LiveU

LiveU provides live video streaming and connectivity solutions for 1st responders, law enforcement, transportation agencies and public information agencies. Through our patented bonding and video transport technology, LiveU delivers consistent bandwidth and a reliable connection from anywhere in the world, so agencies can acquire, manage and distribute high-quality live video, build a common operating picture, enhance situational awareness, and maintain resilient edge connectivity and communications.

If you are passionate about technology that can help save lives, this could be a great opportunity for you!

Position Overview

LiveU is seeking a results-driven Regional Sales Manager to accelerate growth across the Public Safety, and Critical Infrastructure. The successful candidate will develop and close new business, expand customer relationships, and achieve assigned regional revenue objectives.

LiveU specializes in reliable, low-latency live video delivery and connectivity using bonded cellular, 5G, IP networks, and advanced video transmission technologies for mission-critical operations. This role positions LiveU solutions with public safety agencies, emergency response organizations, utilities, telecommunications providers, and critical infrastructure operators.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Ownership: Develop and execute regional sales strategies to achieve assigned bookings and revenue targets.
  • New Business Development: Identify, qualify, advance, and close opportunities across public safety, government, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure.
  • Full Sales Cycle Management: Lead discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, proposals, procurement, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Customer Relationships: Build relationships with law enforcement leadership, emergency management officials, public-sector decision-makers, utilities, and technology stakeholders.
  • Solution Positioning: Communicate the operational value of LiveU video delivery infrastructure, bonded connectivity, and resilient live-streaming solutions.
  • Proof-of-Concept Execution: Partner with Sales Engineering on structured evaluations with clear objectives, timelines, and commercial outcomes.
  • Channel Collaboration: Work with resellers, systems integrators, OEM partners, and telecommunications providers to expand regional revenue.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate Salesforce records, qualified pipeline coverage, opportunity progression, and reliable forecasts.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and Channel Sales.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of successful B2B technology sales experience, preferably in Public Safety, Critical Infrastructure, Telecommunications, Government, or adjacent mission-critical markets.
  • Demonstrated success managing the complete sales cycle and consistently achieving revenue quotas.
  • Experience selling live video delivery, wireless communications, network connectivity, IP-based transmission, cloud services, or related technologies.
  • Understanding of public safety operations, emergency response, situational awareness, command centers, and field communications.
  • Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into operational and financial value.
  • Experience with channel partners, systems integrators, and technology solution providers.
  • Strong relationship management, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms, including pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Self-directed territory management and willingness to travel regularly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relationships within law enforcement, fire services, emergency management, government agencies, utilities, or critical infrastructure organizations.
  • Familiarity with UAS/drone operations, Drone as First Responder (DFR), Real-Time Crime Centers (RTCCs), mobile command, and video management systems.
  • Knowledge of bonded cellular, LTE/5G, FirstNet, private wireless networks, satellite communications, and IP video transport.
  • Experience with public-sector procurement, cooperative purchasing, government contracts, RFPs, and grant-funded acquisitions.
  • Experience converting technical evaluations and proof-of-concept deployments into recurring revenue.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Performance Expectations

Success will be measured through assigned bookings and revenue targets, qualified pipeline development, customer acquisition, opportunity conversion, forecast accuracy, and strategic account expansion. The RSM owns commercial outcomes from initial engagement through purchase and deployment.

Why LiveU?

LiveU is an established leader in resilient live video transmission and connectivity. As demand for real-time operational visibility expands, LiveU brings proven video delivery capabilities into mission-critical environments. This role directly contributes to Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure growth.

About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to spearhead the strategy, design vetting, and end-to-end delivery of our next-generation, high-density AI Data Center footprint. You will lead pre-approval technical vetting (evaluating space, power, cooling, and network floor plans before site acquisition) and take ownership of the full deployment lifecycle through to operational handoff.

Proactive and a self-starter, you must be highly organized with the ability to manage competing priorities. What Sets You Apart

Join Us

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations Systems
jobs.excerpt: About Karbon Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms.
jobs.description:
About Karbon

Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.

We are hiring a Senior Manager of Revenue Operations Systems to lead the team that owns Salesforce across Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization, and to own the technology stack that powers our sales team. This person sets the architecture and standards for our core GTM platform, runs the team's intake and allocation, and makes sure every tool we pay for earns its place.

This is a player-coach role. Expect roughly half your time building: designing solutions, shipping complex configuration, and reviewing the architecture your team delivers. The other half goes to leading a team of three Revenue Operations Analysts, managing the team's workload, and partnering with GTM leaders so the right work gets done in the right order. We are looking for someone who is the most capable technical operator in the room and gets real energy from making the people around them better. As the function grows, so will the scope of this role.

Karbon is building an agentic organization. Every role here is expected to operate with an AI-first mindset, and this role carries a specific expectation: grow your team's capacity faster than its headcount. The rest of this JD describes what that looks like for Salesforce and the sales technology stack.

About the Role

Salesforce Platform Leadership

  • Own Salesforce as the core GTM platform for Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization, including the data model, lifecycle automation, sharing and security model, and release management. Set the platform standards and architecture principles your team builds to
  • Design and ship solutions end to end, from complex flows and record types to integrations. Review and approve architectural changes from your team and others, and hold a high bar on quality, documentation, and change management
  • Architect how Salesforce connects to the rest of the GTM stack. Own integration patterns (native, middleware, event-driven) and know when to use each. Build with observability in mind so issues are caught before the business feels them
  • Partner with the Senior Manager of Marketing Operations on the data flow between marketing systems and Salesforce, including campaign sync, lead and contact routing, and attribution field architecture

Sales Technology Stack

  • Own the sales technology stack, including sales engagement, conversation intelligence, data enrichment, and quoting tools, along with the integrations that connect them to Salesforce. Run vendor evaluations, implementations, renewals, and consolidation analyses
  • Keep technology aligned to how Sales, Marketing, and the Customer organization work. Stay close enough to each team to understand their workflows, translate their needs into the right systems decisions, and say no when a new tool is not the answer
  • Make build vs. buy vs. automate decisions with business-case rigor. Identify redundancies, integration gaps, and where AI can remove manual work across the stack. The expectation is to continuously improve how the sales organization is enabled by technology, not just maintain what we have
  • Maintain the tech stack inventory, ownership, and renewal calendar for your domain so leadership and Finance always know what we use, what it costs, who owns it, and what it returns

Data Quality & Governance

  • Own data governance for the Salesforce platform: field definitions and ownership, stage gate enforcement, validation, and dashboard accuracy. Every field has a definition and an owner, and the numbers leaders see can be trusted
  • Run the change management and release process that keeps Salesforce stable as it scales. Enforce scope and intake boundaries without needing escalation
  • Surface issues before they are reported. Connect symptoms to root causes across systems, and frame findings in terms of revenue impact and a proposed action

Team Leadership & Workload Management

  • Lead and develop a team of three Revenue Operations Analysts: two focused on Salesforce and connected tools, and one supporting the Customer organization (customer success, service delivery, and support). Coach through weekly 1:1s and semi-annual reviews, build development plans tailored to each person, and grow people into bigger scope
  • Own the performance process for your team: goal setting, mid-year and annual reviews, calibration, and merit and promotion cases. Address underperformance early and directly
  • Own intake, prioritization, and allocation for the team. Publish the queue, manage to defined SLAs, and make the Now/Next/Later call with the Director of Revenue Operations as a partner. Push back on low-ROI work and reallocate toward the highest-leverage activity
  • Run capacity planning for your team. Every headcount ask is justified through the agentic lens: what AI has already taken on, what still needs a person, and why. Design AI-augmented workflows as the default for new work and teach your team to do the same
  • Own hiring for your team as roles open: write the JD, run the interview loop, and build onboarding that gets new hires productive quickly
  • Codify tribal knowledge into documented processes and runbooks. Remove single points of failure on the team, including yourself

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Be a trusted partner to Sales, Marketing, and Customer leaders at the Director and VP level. Translate their questions into the systems and data changes that answer them, and communicate in business terms
  • Own the roadmap for Salesforce and the sales technology stack, and sequence it against the GTM plan. Present priorities and progress to GTM leadership monthly
  • Lead multi-quarter, cross-functional initiatives end to end. Keep stakeholders informed before they have to ask, and never surprise anyone on delivery

About You!

  • 8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce administration in a B2B SaaS environment, including at least 2 years leading a team. You are as comfortable building a complex flow yourself as you are walking the CRO through the roadmap
  • Deep Salesforce expertise. You have personally built and scaled Salesforce at a growing company and understand the architecture beneath the UI: data model, sharing and security, automation, APIs, and release management. Experience supporting post-sale teams in Salesforce is a strong plus
  • Cross-platform breadth. You have owned Salesforce alongside at least three integrated GTM platforms (e.g., sales engagement, conversation intelligence, marketing automation, data enrichment, CPQ) and can speak to how data moves between them
  • A track record of owning a tech stack. You have run evaluations, implementations, renewals, and consolidations, and can point to tools you added, tools you cut, and why
  • A people leader who grows people. You have coached analysts or admins into bigger scope, handled hard performance conversations with clarity, and managed a shared queue with competing priorities from multiple teams
  • Revenue literacy. You understand the full revenue engine, from new business to expansion, retention, and churn, and you prioritize by revenue impact. You can defend why one request matters more than another in terms a revenue leader accepts
  • Operational rigor with architectural thinking. You balance urgency in fixing what is broken today with a clear vision for what the system needs to look like at 2x and 5x scale
  • An AI-first operator. You are using AI in your work today, you have shipped AI-assisted workflows that expanded real capacity, and you have a point of view on how AI reshapes Revenue Operations
  • Clear, direct communicator. Tight for executives, detailed for peers, and willing to push back when the work calls for it
  • Experience in accounting, professional services, or practice management software is a plus but not required

Why Work at Karbon?

  • Industry-leading benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and up to three eligible dependents. Also:
    • Work-from-home allowance
    • Rice subsidy
    • Meal allowance per working day
    • Laundry allowance
  • 15 paid time off days per year (which includes 5 Karbon Days per year)
  • 7 Sick leave days per year
  • Internet and work-from-home subsidy
  • Discretionary bonus program
  • Work with (and learn from) a very experienced team
  • Be part of a startup team that will continue to grow around you
  • Flexible approach to work environment (we believe in trust and autonomy)
  • A culture of open communication, consistent feedback, and full transparency into company results, metrics, and financial position

Please be aware that Karbon will only contact you via email from our domain, karbonhq.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links.

Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single criteria. jobs.excerpt: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director, Customer Experience, Partner Program in our strategic partner services organization, you will be tasked with defining how SentinelOne governs the services delivered with our partners, owning the end-to-end service catalog, clear definitions of service scope, and the SLA, SLO, and experience-level (XLA) framework across delivery towers. This role turns a complex partnership, which brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response, into an operating model with clear commitments, escalation procedures, accountabilities, and verifiable customer outcomes. You will lead through standards, data, and cross-functional collaboration rather than through direct management of partner delivery staff.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own and maintain the joint service catalog, including service definitions, boundaries, inclusions, exclusions, prerequisites, and operational ownership.
  • Define and govern SLA, service-level objective (SLO), and XLA measurement standards for Threat Services, Professional Services, and related offerings.
  • Establish service-management processes for intake, incident and problem management, change control, escalation, continuous improvement, and service transition.
  • Collaborate with the partner's service-delivery leadership to align operational handoffs, RACI, review cadence, and decision mechanisms.
  • Translate customer and contractual commitments into measurable service requirements, quality thresholds, and audit-ready evidence.
  • Chair service-management reviews and track cross-tower issues through documented corrective actions.
  • Set expectations for capacity planning, service readiness, exceptions, reporting controls, and escalation thresholds.
  • Partner with independent performance and analytics teams to ensure service measures are consistently defined and traceable to evidence.
  • Lead, develop, and prioritize the SentinelOne service-management capability as the program scales.
  • Deliver against success measures including a current, adopted service catalog with clear accountable owners and delivery boundaries; reliable aggregate SLA, SLO, and XLA attainment and fewer unresolved ownership gaps; service governance adopted across customer, partner, product, and commercial stakeholders; recurring service failures addressed through measurable remediation; and better customer experience without unnecessary executive escalation.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 10 or more years of experience in enterprise service delivery, IT service management, managed security services, or service operations, including people leadership.
  • Proven ability to design service catalogs, operating models, SLAs, SLOs, XLAs, and service-review governance.
  • Strong experience with partner or outsourced delivery contracts, service boundaries, and multi-party escalation management.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL disciplines, service assurance, problem management, and continual service improvement.
  • Strong operational and analytical skills, with the ability to link service definitions with telemetry, commercial commitments, and customer outcomes.
  • Effective executive communication, negotiation, documentation, and decision-making across matrixed teams.
  • Ability to lead a team and influence senior stakeholders while managing conflicting service priorities.
  • Experience in cybersecurity MDR, managed SIEM, incident response, or technical professional services.
  • Experience building a service function during a large provider transition or partnership launch.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

  • Flexible time off

jobs.description:
Since 2016, T-Rex Solutions (T-Rex) has been supporting large scale hybrid-cloud migrations and systems modernization, to include the successful deployment of the first-ever online U.S. Census in 2020. T-Rex is actively expanding its IT Modernization services within the Federal Civilian market, specifically supporting the Department of Education’s Federal Student Aid (FSA) strategic priorities.

T-Rex is seeking an experienced Microsoft Transformation Architect to lead enterprise modernization across the Microsoft ecosystem for our FSA customer. The architect will define the target-state architecture and transformation roadmap spanning Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra identity, Windows, and security platforms, guiding the agency from legacy environments to secure, integrated, cloud-enabled services that meet federal compliance requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop the enterprise target-state architecture, transformation roadmap, and business case across Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Windows platforms.
  • Assess the current application, infrastructure, identity, and collaboration landscape, and define migration waves and dependencies.
  • Architect Azure and Azure Government landing zones, hybrid connectivity, and workload migrations for Windows and Linux applications.
  • Lead Microsoft 365 modernization, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and tenant-to-tenant or on-premises migrations.
  • Design identity modernization with Active Directory consolidation, Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Design endpoint modernization using Windows 11, Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and Azure Virtual Desktop.
  • Integrate Microsoft Defender, Purview, and Sentinel to meet DISA STIG, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, FedRAMP, and agency ATO requirements.
  • Automate deployment and governance using PowerShell, Bicep, Terraform, and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Produce architecture artifacts and executive briefings for government stakeholders and architecture review boards, and mentor engineering teams in an Agile delivery environment.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience, including 4+ years as an architect leading Microsoft-based transformation or migration programs.
  • US citizenship required.
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Windows Server.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 workloads and migration tooling.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager.
  • Working knowledge of federal security and compliance frameworks, including NIST RMF, FISMA, FedRAMP, and DISA STIGs.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and Infrastructure as Code skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief technical and executive audiences.

Desired:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert, or Identity and Access Administrator Associate.
  • Experience with Azure Government, Microsoft 365 GCC High, and DoD Impact Level 4/5 environments.
  • Security or architecture certifications such as CISSP or TOGAF.
  • Experience with Power Platform, Dynamics 365, or Azure data and AI services.
  • Familiarity with Agile/SAFe delivery and ITIL-aligned operations.

T-Rex Overview

Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $180,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.

jobs.description:
Financial Data Manager

Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions. By integrating Agentic Underwriting™, Agentic Broker Services™, Agentic Risk Mitigation™, Agentic Claims Management™, Agentic Coverage™, and Agentic Capacity™ into one powerful platform, Counterpart empowers brokers - and the businesses they serve - to do more with less risk. Backed by A rated carriers, Counterpart has been recognized by CB Insights as a 2025 “Top 50 Insurtech,” by Great Place to Work, and by Business Insurance as one of its 2025 “Best Places to Work.”

We're seeking a Financial Data Manager to design and deliver the data workflows that power Counterpart's financial and accounting systems. You will report to Pricing & Analytics and serve three primary customers: the finance function, the analytics function, and broker services (billing). You will translate insurance accounting concepts — written and earned premium, unearned premium reserves, commissions, and cash application — into clear data requirements. You will then partner with engineering to build them. This is a design and project management role at the intersection of finance, data, and product.

YOU WILL

  • Design data-driven workflows that feed Counterpart's financial and accounting systems and the downstream processes that depend on them.
  • Translate finance, analytics, and billing requirements into clear data models, source-of-truth definitions, and technical specifications.
  • Own the definitions behind core insurance accounting measures — written premium, earned premium, unearned premium, commissions, and ceded amounts — so every team reports the same number.
  • Partner with engineering to implement these workflows, and manage the projects end to end from scoping through delivery and adoption. Enable resilient systems that can handle edge cases (even with easy manual override)
  • Serve as the primary data partner to the finance function for the monthly and quarterly close, reconciliations, and audit support.
  • Support broker services on billing and invoicing data, including installment schedules, cash application, and commission accuracy.
  • Build controls and automated checks that catch premium, billing, and bordereau discrepancies before they reach carriers or auditors.
  • Design and maintain the carrier and bordereau reporting pipelines, and make sure the outputs tie to the general ledger.
  • Document data lineage, change tracking, business rules, and known limitations so finance and analytics users can self-serve with confidence.
  • Prioritize a backlog of finance data requests, and set expectations with stakeholders on scope, sequence, and timing.
  • Identify manual finance processes that data and automation can remove, and build the business case to fix them.

YOU HAVE

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics, information systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years in financial data management, financial systems, insurance operations, or a comparable analytical role.
  • A working knowledge of insurance accounting concepts, including written premium, earned premium, unearned premium reserves, and commissions.
  • Practical SQL skills — you can query, join, and validate data on your own without waiting on an analyst.
  • Experience writing requirements for engineering teams and managing delivery against them.
  • Strong project management skills, and a track record of shipping cross-functional work with finance and technical partners.
  • Clear written communication, and the ability to explain data decisions to accountants and engineers alike.
  • Experience with data warehouses and business intelligence tools (Snowflake, Looker, dbt, or similar) is a plus.
  • Insurance, insurtech, or fintech experience is highly desirable.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Stanley Wang, Director, Pricing Analytics: Before joining Counterpart, Stanley worked as an actuary within the pricing solutions and methods team at USAA to combine actuarial pricing with data science models. Before that, he was a leading data scientist for Digital Partners, a Munich Re Company where he specialized in building data science models and insights for leading insurtech companies. He has had many other relevant roles such as capital modeling, risk management etc. He lives in New York with his growing family.
  • Tobias Schuler, Chief Underwriting Officer: After becoming a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society & working as a consultant actuary at EY for several years, Tobias went on to drive the actuarial data & systems teams at QBE. He further leveraged his deep insurance & technical expertise at Munich Re Digital Partners in North America, where he headed data & analytics & oversaw the data infrastructure behind some of their largest programs.
  • Newton Truong, Engineering Manager: Newton joins Counterpart with 7+ years of experience in platform and data engineering. In his last company Thrive Market, he had a hand in building out new microservices and architecting data pipelines with Airflow and Spark. He's vegetarian and loves trying new restaurants when traveling. Nowadays he's busy keeping up with his 2-year-old and doing outdoor activities with his family.

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don't cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren't being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal. Leverage AI ruthlessly. We measure success by outcomes, not lines of code written. Use every available AI tool to ship faster and think more strategically.
  • Practice Omotenashi ("selfless hospitality") - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely. Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

WE OFFER

  • Fully remote workplace
  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
  • Stock Options
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Parental Leave
  • Home Office Allowance: to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
  • Wellness Stipend
  • Book stipend
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Charitable Contribution Matching

Our estimated pay range for this role is $150,000 to $180,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

Working in close partnership with Medical Affairs, the Senior Director translates unmet medical needs and strategic evidence priorities into scientifically rigorous research programs capable of generating meaningful clinical, economic, and operational evidence to support innovation, product development, regulatory submissions, post-market evidence generation, clinical practice adoption, and value-based healthcare initiatives.   • Design evidence-generation programs that address unmet clinical, scientific, healthcare system, and customer needs.

Scientific Leadership

Clinical Operations Leadership

Your role at Baxter


As a Senior AI Security Architect, you will play a key role in helping Baxter securely adopt and scale Artificial Intelligence technologies across the enterprise. This position sits within Baxter's Cybersecurity organization and serves as the primary security expert for AI technologies, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and machine learning platforms.


You will partner closely with teams across Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data & Analytics, Infrastructure, R&D, Privacy, Legal, and Quality to establish the security standards, governance frameworks, and guardrails needed to enable responsible AI innovation. As Baxter continues to expand the use of AI across products, operations, and corporate functions, you will help shape the company's AI security strategy while balancing innovation, risk management, and regulatory requirements.


This is an opportunity to join Baxter early in its AI journey and help define how AI technologies are secured across a global healthcare organization. The role offers significant visibility, cross-functional exposure, and the opportunity to grow into a broader cybersecurity leadership role over time.


This is a remote U.S.-based role with quarterly travel to Baxter's Deerfield, IL headquarters.


What you'll be doing


  • Lead security reviews and assessments for AI, Generative AI, machine learning, and AI agent solutions across the enterprise.
  • Define AI security standards, architectures, and best practices that support secure and responsible AI adoption.
  • Partner with technical and business teams to evaluate new AI technologies, platforms, vendors, and use cases from a security and risk perspective.

  • Establish security controls and guardrails for LLMs, AI copilots, RAG solutions, AI agents, and related technologies.
  • Support AI governance initiatives by defining security requirements, approval processes, monitoring capabilities, and risk management practices.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data & Analytics, R&D, Privacy, Legal, and Quality teams to ensure AI solutions meet security and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and mentor to architects, engineers, developers, and business stakeholders on AI security best practices.

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, enterprise architecture, or related technology disciplines.

  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar technologies.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and enterprise risk assessments.
  • Knowledge of identity and access management, cloud security, data protection, encryption, API security, and AI governance principles.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence across a complex global organization.

  • Experience with Microsoft security technologies including Purview, Defender, Entra ID, and Azure security services.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 42001, or ISO 27001.

jobs.description:
About this role:
Our Chief HR Officer clients find themselves challenged with the pace of change within the HR function and their respective organizations as companies continue to focus on developing digital dexterity, shifting business models and evolving customer and workforce expectations. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for CHRO clients adeptly assess the changes needed within their organization, achieve their goals more quickly and with a higher assurance of success. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to learn about and deliver solutions for the most complex talent and workforce challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with the member includes developing, coaching and/or critiquing overarching HR and talent strategies; helping to develop and/or transform their HR teams/organizations, assisting/advising with the development and execution of critical initiatives such as workforce planning and development, employee experience, enterprise change management, and diversity and inclusion. Gartner for CHRO Executive Partners serve as accountability partners through delivery of research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide executive advisory services to approximately 20 CHRO members who work across all industries and business models.
  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving Gartner for CHRO members in conjunction with Team Client Managers and Account Executives
  • Participate in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal.
  • Responsible for member retention and for contributing toward growth in the region through direct support of Gartner Sales in prospect cultivation, account plan development and value demonstration activities.
  • Host and /or participate in periodic member activities, including strategy workshops, roundtables and webinars.
  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.
  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for CHRO member community portal and assisted member connections.

What You’ll Need:

  • An undergraduate degree or Masters is preferred with 5+ years of experience working as a CHRO; 15+ years of experience in HR.
  • An in-depth understanding of the HR function and the role of the CHRO (including leadership, operations management, strategy and trends, use of metrics, etc.)
  • In depth understanding of the business value of HR and the alignment of business and HR strategies.
  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished CHRO, working with the C-suite, the Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • Gartner/(CEB) client experience preferred
  • Consulting background a plus
  • Experience consulting into the federal government on human capital issues is a plus

Who You Are:

  • Critical thinker and problem solver demonstrating the ability to assess our Member’s situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate resources to help Members achieve results.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills, including experience working with C-level executives.
  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
  • This role is a Client-facing position that requires a high level of Executive presence and ability to quickly build trust and deliver value.
  • Demonstrate superior verbal and written communication skills as well as strong facilitation and presentation skills.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE UNITED STATES.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

jobs.description:
About Ascent

Ascent Global Logistics, headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.

Our Guiding Principles


At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair, and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.

What You’ll Do

The Program Manager owns the program of related technology initiatives for a single business domain. For this position, the domain is two shared programs: Ascent's customer-facing shipment visibility platform, which serves every business unit, and the final-mile business unit and its operating application. The Program Manager aligns that work to the domain's strategic objectives and carries it from framing through delivery and benefits realization. It is a strategic, hands-on role: the Program Manager is the connective owner across the domain's initiatives, the primary partner to its business sponsors, and the internal IT subject-matter expert for the domain's applications, with agentic AI as primary leverage. The core of the role is translating business needs into a clear, sequenced program roadmap that product owners and delivery teams can build against.

Program Ownership and Strategic Alignment

  • Own the domain's portfolio of related initiatives as a single program; align it to the business area's objectives and shape sequencing and roadmap.
  • Frame major project outcomes with the business and translate them into a coherent program plan.
  • Serve as the internal IT subject-matter expert for the domain's applications, maintaining deep knowledge of how those systems work and how the business uses them.
  • Maintain one integrated roadmap for the shared customer visibility platform with its product owner, so requests from every business unit are sequenced in a single plan.

Business Need to Program Roadmap

  • Understand how the business units operate and how the platforms are used by employees and customers, so requests are evaluated against how the work is done.
  • Work with the business to define the current state, the target state and the process change in between before a build begins, so requirements reflect the real workflow rather than assumptions.
  • Turn business needs into outcome statements, scope and sequencing on the program roadmap; make the trade-offs visible and get them decided.

Cross-Initiative Coordination and Dependencies

  • Manage interdependencies across the domain initiatives and across the IT delivery teams, so the program advances.
  • Coordinate timing, handoffs, and sequencing across initiatives; surfacing conflicts early.
  • Governance and Reporting
  • Run the program's governance and cadence: decisions, transparency, and status to sponsors and leadership.
  • Champion PMO methodology and standards to ensure consistency across the program.

Benefits Realization

  • Determine the business value of program initiatives based on defined outcomes.
  • Provide visibility into progress toward program outcomes and value delivery

Business UAT Engagement (major and higher-risk projects)

  • Identify, recruit, and engage business UAT testers.
  • Responsible for UAT schedule and milestones; UAT team owns validation protocols and sign-off.

Stakeholder and Program Risk

  • Own the sponsor and stakeholder relationship for the domain and keep expectations aligned as the program evolves.
  • Manage program change management communication to promote clear, timely messaging about what is changing and when.
  • Track program-level risks and issues and escalate to the appropriate level with context, options, and a recommendation.

Agentic AI

  • Use AI to draft plans, status, and reporting, accelerate program documentation, and reduce routine coordination overhead.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years managing programs or large, cross-functional initiatives, ideally within a PMO.
  • Strong command of program governance, dependency management, and benefits realization.
  • Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders to align technology outputs with business outcomes.
  • Strong executive communication skills: able to brief senior leaders concisely, present options and recommendations, and communicate key decision points for leaders to act on.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into program roadmaps: outcome statements, scope, actionable plans for sequencing and trade-offs that product owners and delivery teams.
  • Strong experience in logistics or supply chain, including time spent in or supporting an operation’s role and its business processes.
  • Working knowledge of Agile and structured delivery methods.
  • Demonstrated fluency using AI tools to accelerate program and reporting work.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field; PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification preferred.

Ascent’s Competitive Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
