jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.excerpt: Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on.
jobs.description:
Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on. We’re building the perception-based world model stack that makes this possible. It takes raw multi-sensor input and produces a live, accurate 3D model of lanes, boundaries, crosswalks, intersection topology, and traffic control semantics. It also fuses perception, map, and localization data into a consistent model of the driving environment that the rest of the driving stack depends on.

You will join a team of world-class software engineers improving these algorithms. This is a software engineering role: algorithms are only as good as the software that runs them, so we need an engineer who obsesses over quality, performance, and architecture, and who can turn algorithmic ideas into safe, fast, maintainable code for production vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. Your code will meet ASIL-B/D requirements and ship across L2++, L3, and L4 programs.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and own core online world model and context fusion software that runs in the car, from architecture through implementation to deployment.
  • Write production C++ for real-time embedded systems, with a focus on correctness, determinism, and maintainability.
  • Design software architecture, interfaces, and data flows that promote code reuse and clean boundaries across vehicle programs, while meeting CPU, memory, and latency budgets.
  • Profile complex pipelines, find bottlenecks, and deliver measurable improvements in CPU utilization, memory usage, and end-to-end latency, backed by reproducible measurements on Orin and Thor.
  • Develop benchmarks and performance regression tests that track improvements and prevent regressions.
  • Use GPU parallelism (CUDA) where it helps to accelerate compute-heavy mapping components.
  • Implement and integrate algorithmic solutions from the mapping team into NVIDIA’s AV stack, working closely with algorithm engineers to understand and refine them while preserving behavior, output quality, and correctness.
  • Develop to automotive safety standards (ASIL-B/D): apply strong static analysis, follow safety-oriented coding guidelines, and achieve 100% line and branch coverage with rigorous unit and integration tests.
  • Build software that is robust to the varied conditions and failure modes of vehicles operating around the world.
  • Contribute to code reviews and uphold the team’s quality and safety expectations.

What we need to see:

  • PhD with 1+ year, MS with 3+ years, or BS with 5+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience building robust, production-quality software
  • 3+ years of professional modern C++ development, with a strong grasp of memory management, concurrency, and performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory consumption, and latency using profilers and benchmarks under representative workloads.
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures and their impact on performance.
  • Experience designing software architecture and APIs for large, long-lived codebases.
  • A quality-first, systematic approach to debugging and optimization: comfort with static analysis, unit testing, and high-coverage test strategies.
  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and understand their work.
  • Strong communication and analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.
  • Autonomous and responsible, a strong team player who enjoys solving hard problems, with a passion for robotics and autonomous vehicles.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Software development on embedded, real-time, or automotive platforms, including RTOS experience (e.g., QNX, Linux RT), experience with functional safety standards and processes (ISO 26262, ASIL-B/D), MISRA or AUTOSAR C++ guidelines, and safety-qualified toolchains.
  • GPGPU programming (CUDA) and GPU performance tuning.
  • Cache-aware data layouts, memory allocation optimization, multithreading, or SIMD/vectorization.
  • Experience with 3D geometry and graphics.
  • Experience building efficient, reusable APIs and frameworks for complex systems.

As an Identity Security Architect, you will design and govern enterprise identity and access management solutions that protect organizational assets while enabling secure access to business systems and applications. You will serve as the technical authority for identity security and partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, application, enterprise architecture, security operations, and business teams across on-premises and cloud environments.

Technical Responsibilities:

Design and maintain enterprise identity security architecture, standards, and reference designs.

Develop identity strategies that support Zero Trust Architecture and enterprise digital transformation.

Architect authentication, authorization, federation, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and identity lifecycle management solutions.

Lead architecture reviews for IAM projects, cloud implementations, and business applications.

Design and govern Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions and privileged identity controls.

Integrate identity security controls with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Application Development, and Security Operations teams.

Develop identity governance processes for role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, segregation of duties (SoD), and access certification.

Conduct identity threat modeling, architecture risk assessments, and security design reviews.

Evaluate emerging identity technologies and recommend architectural improvements.

Support compliance with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, FDA Cybersecurity Guidance, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Develop architecture documentation, technical standards, implementation guidance, and operating procedures.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams implementing identity security capabilities.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Analyze complex identity security challenges and translate findings into practical architecture decisions.

Design enterprise identity architectures that connect security requirements, business needs, and technology capabilities.

Communicate identity architecture standards, risks, and implementation guidance to technical and business partners.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in cybersecurity or identity management.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience designing enterprise IAM architectures.
  • Experience implementing SSO, MFA, PAM, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and directory services.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, Ping Identity, SailPoint, CyberArk, Delinea, or similar technologies, including cloud identity security across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

jobs.excerpt: Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction.
jobs.description:
Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. GPU Deep Learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason and solve problems. Now, NVIDIA’s GPU runs Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world.


We are now looking for an extraordinary Senior Engineer to develop and productize NVIDIA’s autonomous driving solutions. As a member of our prediction team, you will be driving solutions for prediction modules that are responsible for producing multi-modal scene consistent prediction for other road participants. You will be challenged to improve robustness and accuracy as well as efficiency of the solutions to fully enable autonomous driving anywhere and anytime.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Designing end-to-end solutions for Prediction and AV stack using state of the art ML techniques to enable agents prediction across various driving environments from complex intersections to rural curvy roads to multi-level highways.
  • Applied research and development of innovative deep learning models, including end-to-end models
  • Develop generalizable approaches to support diverse ODDs and Country/region expansion
  • Drive and prioritize data-driven development by working with large data collection and labeling teams to bring in high value data to improve prediction system accuracy. Efforts will include data collection prioritization and planning, labeling prioritization, labeling efficiency optimization, so that value of data is maximized
  • Leverage data simulation and augmentation for solving extreme scenarios
  • Productize the developed solutions by meeting product requirements for safety, latency, and SW robustness.

What We Need to See:

  • Minimum Requirement: PhD with 6+ years, MS with 10+ years, or BS (or equivalent experience) with 12+ years of meaningful experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on work experience in developing deep learning and algorithms to solve sophisticated real world problems, and proficiency in using deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch).
  • Experience in data-driven development and collaboration with data and ground truth teams.
  • Strong programming skills in python and/or C++.
  • Outstanding communication and teamwork skills as we work as a tightly-knit team, always discussing and learning from each other.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Proven expertise in developing generalizable ML solutions for autonomous driving or robotics.
  • Hands-on experience in developing and deploying DNN-based solutions to embedded platforms for real time applications.
  • Proven expertise in deep learning backed up by technical publications in leading conferences/journals.
  • Expertise with Transformers, BEV architectures, E2E ML systems.
  • Having over 2 years of experience in technical leadership involving significant technical and organizational challenges is highly advantageous.

Join us and help define the future of reliable, data-driven autonomous driving.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Our Telemetry Platform team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us build and evolve the services that collect and process data from millions of NVIDIA users worldwide. If you love working on high-impact infrastructure, we want to hear from you!


What you will be doing:

  • Design, build, and tune real-time, high-throughput services that ingest, validate, and route telemetry events from NVIDIA products worldwide.
  • Make ingestion durable end to end (delivery guarantees, backpressure, persistent buffering, graceful degradation) so data survives component failures.

  • Lead design reviews, write clear documents, and mentor other engineers.
  • Own the services you build in production, including a shared on-call rotation and incident management.

  • Deep expertise in modern Java (17+) and Spring Boot, including concurrency, the Java Memory Model, and performance profiling.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals (microservices, event-driven architecture, delivery semantics, failure handling).
  • Experience running large-scale services with Docker, Kubernetes, and message brokers (Apache Kafka preferred) on AWS or another major cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and production observability.
  • Proficiency in agentic engineering (AI coding agents).
  • Fluent English.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Production experience with reactive, non-blocking Java (Project Reactor, Spring WebFlux, Netty).
  • Background in telemetry, analytics, or high-volume data ingestion.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloud delivers AI services and endpoints for research and production workloads. We are looking for a Senior Production Engineer to build software and automation that make those services reliable, scalable, and safe to operate. The Production Engineering team works on large-scale distributed systems spanning internal and external model endpoints; regional control plane services that orchestrate workloads and route requests; and the GPU/CPU compute infrastructure where inference and agentic workloads run. Our work spans Kubernetes clusters across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, other partner cloud environments, and on-premises deployments.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and operate production software, automation, and tooling for control plane services, model deployments, and inference and agentic workloads across DGX Cloud environments.
  • Improve the reliability of inference and agentic platforms and services, including NVIDIA Cloud Functions, SGLang- and vLLM-based endpoints, and inference services built with NVIDIA Dynamo, through health validation, safer rollouts, observability, and recovery.
  • Improve endpoint availability, inference routing, capacity management, and service health to maintain predictable performance as workloads and demand change.
  • Use infrastructure as code and GitOps to deploy, configure, validate, upgrade, and recover services consistently across environments.
  • Build workflows for service enablement, model releases, handoff, deprecation, and ongoing operations; replace repeatable manual work with reliable automation.
  • Define and instrument SLIs and SLOs for inference and control plane services, including availability and latency, use error budgets to guide reliability improvements, and make production health visible to partner teams.
  • Participate in on-call and incident response, troubleshoot failures across routing, model runtimes, software, and infrastructure, and turn recurring issues into automation and durable fixes.
  • Collaborate with model, platform, storage, networking, security, and GPU infrastructure teams to design and operate services safely at scale.

What we need to see:

  • 8+ years of experience building or operating production services and large-scale distributed systems, including hands-on automation.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or a comparable language, with experience developing tools for production operations.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management, or GitOps, and with building automation for repeatable service deployments and changes.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux, Kubernetes, containers, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and networking fundamentals; ability to diagnose failures in production.
  • Understanding of Production Engineering principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and reducing operational toil.
  • Experience instrumenting services and using metrics, logs, and traces to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Clear technical communication and ability to work across engineering teams.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Familiarity with technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, CUDA, or NCCL, and with GPU performance analysis.
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators, controllers, workload orchestration services, fleet management systems, or self-healing automation.
  • Experience with Terraform, Argo CD, CI/CD, policy validation, or safe deployment and rollback systems.
  • Background with developing with AI tools and agents.
  • Experience with production AI inference or agentic workloads, including debugging issues across models, runtimes, Kubernetes, and hardware.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people on the planet working for us. If you're creative, hard-working and self-motivated, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s DGX Cloud organization is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to become part of its data team! We develop the reliable data foundation that supports fleet health, capacity, utilization, cost, reliability, and operational decision-making throughout DGX Cloud. Our platform supports engineering, operations, finance, and product teams managing and expanding large GPU fleets across cloud service providers and NVIDIA Cloud Partners. We are looking for a practical engineer and technical lead to take charge of a key part of the Navigator data platform. We develop the systems that transform distributed infrastructure telemetry and operational data into dependable, managed data products that support fleet health, capacity, utilization, cost, and operational decisions.

You will be responsible for the architecture, technical plan, and production results of a major platform area like ingestion and orchestration, data quality and reconciliation, or data serving and consumption. You will clarify requirements with customers, define technical objectives, guide design and development among engineers and partner teams, and stay actively engaged in coding, debugging, and production tasks. Successful candidates have already led complex technical work across team boundaries and delivered improvements that other groups adopted. Our primary implementation environment is Python, SQL, Databricks, and Spark.

What you’ll be doing:

  • You will own a major platform component and its roadmap. For example, define its architecture, interfaces, technical goals, and evolution. Anticipate capacity, compatibility, and operational needs over a multi-year horizon, and translate them into achievable breakthroughs that balance immediate delivery with long-term maintainability.

  • Lead technical delivery across teams. Work with customers and interested parties to clarify vague requirements. Break down design and implementation work for contributing engineers. Establish release turning points and manage dependencies and delivery risks. Guide the work process, revise plans when requirements shift, and keep management and partner teams informed and aligned.

  • Build data pipelines and products. Plan and carry out batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, and serving processes for fleet, capacity, utilization, cost, scheduling, and operational telemetry. Establish data models and agreements that remain stable as sources, consumers, and scale progress.

  • Develop shared platform capabilities. Direct the creation and adoption of libraries, workflow and DAG or comparable experience abstractions, deployment tools, and standard implementation approaches. Partner with related teams to solve shared challenges and evaluate progress in onboarding time, engineering effort, reliability, and cost.

  • Lead complex production investigations. Serve as the technical point of accountability for issues spanning pipelines, applications, SQL engines, Spark, storage, networks, and cloud services. Coordinate investigations across owners, drive resolution of release blockers and critical issues from partners, and implement preventive measures.

  • Define quality, security, and operational expectations. Establish and implement testing, data-quality, reconciliation, lineage, SLO, and release-readiness standards for your platform area. Partner with security and infrastructure teams on trust boundaries, service identities, least privilege, secrets, environment isolation, and auditability, and drive adoption across contributing teams.

  • Make trusted data usable. Deliver well-modeled tables, APIs, automation, dashboards, and focused internal applications. Align with consumers on semantics, access patterns, freshness, compatibility, and ownership so that shared capabilities support dependable operational decisions.

  • Provide technical leadership through others. Guide design reviews, mentor engineers taking on larger ownership, and resolve technical disagreements using evidence and clear tradeoffs. Partner with leadership on priorities and explain how technical investments support DGXC objectives.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and at least 12+ years of equivalent experience

  • A sustained record of building and operating production software, data platforms, databases, or distributed systems. This includes owning a major component or complex project from requirements and architecture through release and ongoing operation.

  • Proven ability to outline a component’s technical plan, establish objectives for engineers, assign design and implementation tasks, and guide delivery within your team and nearby teams with little supervision.

  • Extensive practical experience in one or more of these areas: distributed processing using Spark or a similar system; relational, distributed, or analytical databases; production ETL, change-data capture, streaming, or event handling; or backend and cloud platforms managing large data volumes. You must grasp the interfaces and failure modes of nearby layers thoroughly to inform solid architectural choices.

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production proficiency in Python or another backend or systems language, with the ability and willingness to work primarily in Python and SQL. Experience designing reusable abstractions, reviewing substantial changes, and personally implementing and debugging critical code paths.

  • Strong SQL and data-modeling skills, with practical depth in query execution, incremental processing, schema evolution, consistency, and analytical consumption. Ability to reason about idempotency, replay, late-arriving data, partial failure, and correctness across system boundaries.

  • Experience leading complex investigations involving multiple components and teams. Ability to use logs, metrics, traces, query plans, profiles, and controlled experiments to establish root cause, coordinate resolution, and prevent recurrence.

  • Demonstrated architectural judgment: evaluating alternatives, anticipating future requirements, and balancing reliability, performance, cost, security, compatibility, and maintainability. Experience leading significant migrations or architectural changes while preserving production service.

  • Experience establishing production quality and operational practices that other engineers adopt, including testing, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, rollback, incident response, and secure deployment.

  • Proven success in influencing technical decisions without official authority, advising engineers outside your immediate project, and advancing workflow improvements across closely related teams. Ability to simplify complex issues, offer a course of action, and communicate decisions and delivery risks clearly.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven expertise in building, refining, and running Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog workloads along with shared platform features.

  • Experience designing and operating Kafka or comparable streaming systems, including partitioning, consumer behavior, offset management, backpressure, replay, and schema compatibility.

  • Experience scaling, migrating, or tuning relational, distributed, time-series, object-storage, or information retrieval systems, including Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

  • Background operating compute or GPU clusters, or working with Kubernetes, Slurm, cloud infrastructure, and fleet telemetry across AWS, Azure, GCP, or other providers.

  • Experience building production agentic systems or agent harnesses, including tool integration, context management, evaluation, permissions, observability, and failure recovery. Evidence of measurable improvements in engineering productivity or operational outcomes.

The Mnong Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Mnongand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inMnongand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

jobs.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Revenue Operations Analytics Manager is a strategic and highly visible role responsible for driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization. This individual serves as a trusted partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating complex data into actionable insights that directly influence business strategy and performance.

This role owns critical components of revenue operations, including sales compensation execution, performance analytics, and executive reporting. In addition to delivering accurate and timely insights, the Senior Analyst proactively identifies opportunities to optimize processes, improve data integrity, and enhance forecasting accuracy.

As a key contributor to strategic planning and revenue optimization, this individual plays a central role in enabling predictable, scalable growth while continuously evolving reporting frameworks, compensation programs, and operational processes.

What You Do

Sales Compensation Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the build and end-to-end administration of sales compensation programs, including plan implementation, maintenance, and commission calculations.
  • Test new plans and changes before release. Document expected results, check edge cases, and validate Salesforce inputs and commission calculations against approved plan terms.
  • Lead monthly and quarterly compensation cycles, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely delivery.
  • Partner with Finance, People, and RevOps leadership to ensure alignment with payroll, audit, and compliance requirements.
  • Analyze compensation effectiveness and lead modeling efforts to optimize plan design and align incentives with business objectives.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of compensation operations.

Revenue Operations & Executive Reporting

  • Own and evolve executive and board-level reporting, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast accuracy, and key performance metrics.
  • Design and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide clear visibility into business performance.
  • Deliver actionable insights on sales performance, productivity, and forecasting trends, influencing strategic decision-making.
  • Lead complex data analysis initiatives, synthesizing insights across multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce, BI tools).
  • Partner with senior leadership to support planning cycles, QBRs, and strategic initiatives.

AI Agents and Workflow Automation

  • Identify and prioritize RevOps workflows for agentic AI based on business impact, manual effort, data readiness, and risk. Define the expected outcome and how to measure it before building.
  • Build and maintain multi-step workflows with Claude or comparable tools. Define which data sources each workflow uses, what it checks, and when it routes an exception to a person.
  • Strengthen Board and executive reporting. Build workflows to reconcile metrics across Salesforce, Power BI, and Finance, flag unexplained variances, and draft commentary tied to verified figures for human review.
  • Support GTM planning and analysis. Use agentic workflows to compare quota, capacity, and territory scenarios, document assumptions, and show which inputs drive the largest changes in projected bookings.
  • Validate workflows before release and after changes. Test against known outcomes and edge cases, track false positives and missed exceptions, and require human approval before workflows update records or distribute sensitive reports.
  • Measure results and support adoption. Track time saved, exception accuracy, and usage. Document workflows and train analysts and business partners to run them, review outputs, and troubleshoot common issues.

GTM Systems Administration

  • Own day-to-day administration of Gong and assigned sales intelligence tools. Manage user access, permissions, licenses, team structures, and platform settings.
  • Configure Gong to support weekly forecast reviews, deal inspection, and manager coaching. Build and maintain views that help leaders spot deal risk, track forecast changes, and prepare for pipeline reviews.
  • Configure sales intelligence tools to support account research, prospecting, and contact enrichment. Set rules for which data flows into Salesforce and how to handle duplicates or conflicting values.
  • Monitor data flow between Gong, sales intelligence tools, and Salesforce. Investigate sync failures and data discrepancies. Partner with GTM Systems and vendors on integration changes and escalations.
  • Lead testing and rollout of new features. Document configurations, train users, and track adoption and license usage to inform renewal and expansion decisions.
  • Build agentic AI workflows that combine approved Gong and Salesforce data to flag deal risks and prepare forecast review briefs. Link findings to source records and route them to sales leaders for review.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, or related analytical roles, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and administering production commission plans in Spiff.
  • Experience owning full sales compensation cycles, including payout reconciliation, exception resolution, and approval workflows.
  • Experience producing Board or executive leadership reporting, including reconciling metrics across systems and writing concise variance commentary.
  • Demonstrated experience building AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as Claude or comparable platforms
  • Experience connecting agents to business systems, troubleshooting failures, and validating results.
  • Advanced Salesforce and Excel skills and experience building or maintaining reporting in Power BI or a comparable BI platform.

Asset Qualifications

  • Experience with commission tools (e.g., SPIFF or similar platforms).
  • Proficiency in SQL or other data querying languages.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV) and recurring revenue models.
  • Experience with territory planning, quota setting, and GTM strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive process improvements.

Note: Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Corporate Affairs Intercontinental (ICON)
jobs.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity

As we expand globally, the Intercontinental (ICON) region represents a strategically important opportunity for clinical development, patient access and future commercialization. This is a unique leadership opportunity to establish and lead Revolution Medicines’ Corporate Affairs capability across Japan, Canada, Australia, Brazil and the broader ICON region. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Corporate Affairs, with a dotted line to the Senior Vice President, Intercontinental (ICON), the Executive Director, Corporate Affairs, Intercontinental will shape the company’s external presence and help create the conditions for sustainable growth across the region.

Working as a partner to the ICON leadership team and country General Managers, this leader will be responsible for developing an integrated regional Corporate Affairs strategy across external and internal communications and corporate reputation. The role will help shape healthcare environments that improve cancer outcomes, strengthen healthcare systems and enable timely access to innovation. It will translate global priorities into locally relevant strategies while ensuring country perspectives inform enterprise decisions.

Success in the Role

Within the first 24–36 months, the successful leader will:

  • Establish an integrated ICON strategy and scalable Corporate Affairs network with clear country priorities, accountabilities and measures of impact.

  • Deliver coordinated corporate and launch communications, supported by effective stakeholder governance, issues management and crisis preparedness.

  • Build trusted relationships with industry associations, strengthening the company’s reputation and understanding of patient needs.

  • Support oncology innovation, clinical research and timely, equitable access to precision medicines.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic and Regional Leadership

  • Develop and execute the ICON Corporate Affairs strategy, aligning global objectives with country priorities, market maturity and launch timing.

  • Advise regional leaders and country General Managers on reputational developments; bring country insights into global planning and decision-making forums.

  • Set annual priorities, budgets and performance measures; build a lean operating model with clear responsibilities across global, regional and country teams.

  • Recruit and develop talent as needs evolve; select and manage specialist partners, setting expectations for quality, impact, budget discipline and ethical conduct. Equip countries with practical guidance and share effective approaches.

Corporate Communications and Reputation

  • Develop a coherent regional narrative connecting the company’s science, patient purpose and local contribution; adapt global messaging for local audiences across media, digital and company channels.

  • Partner with the Global Head of Communications to ensure ICON communications advance the global corporate narrative, scientific leadership and reputation priorities, while reflecting local market needs.

  • Build media relationships and lead proactive and reactive communications with Global Communications and country leaders. In partnership with Global Communications, coordinate spokesperson strategy and executive visibility through interviews, speaking engagements and opinion articles.

  • Coordinate communications around affiliate establishment, clinical milestones and launches, ensuring scientific accuracy and appropriate review. Partner with Global Corporate Affairs and Investor Relations on sensitive announcements and disclosure requirements.

  • Bring country and regional insights, trends and milestones into global communications; use stakeholder feedback and media monitoring to assess impact.

Launch Readiness

  • Jointly plan major announcements and launch communications with Global Communications, with clear responsibilities, review processes and escalation expectations across global, regional and country teams.

  • Represent ICON Corporate Affairs in relevant brand teams, asset leadership teams and launch taskforces; identify external opportunities and barriers.

  • Develop integrated campaigns with Medical Affairs, Market Access and Commercial teams. Maintain clear separation between corporate communications, disease awareness and promotional activities, with appropriate local review.

  • Support distributor-market readiness through agreed communications standards, partner responsibilities and escalation processes.

Internal Communications/Employee Engagement

  • Develop and execute regional/country internal communications plans in partnership with Global Executive & Enterprise Communications, regional leaders and HR, aligning employees around company strategy, regional priorities and patient impact.

  • Equip regional and country leaders with messaging and tools to communicate organizational change, affiliate growth and launch milestones consistently and effectively.

  • Ensure ICON internal communications align with global tone, cadence and key messages, while bringing regional employee perspectives and country examples into enterprise communications.

  • Connect employees to strategy and patient progress through leadership forums, town halls and channels aligned with global messaging.

Governance and Issues Management

  • Establish regional issues management and crisis communications preparedness aligned with global protocols and country requirements; coordinate timely responses with relevant global teams, Legal, Compliance, Medical Affairs and Government Affairs.

  • Uphold integrity, protect confidential information and build a culture of accountability, collaboration and patient focus across the Corporate Affairs network.

External Partnership

  • Partner on disease awareness, understanding of precision oncology and barriers to care; collaborate with Medical Affairs and Government Affairs on appropriate engagement with professional societies, research institutions and policy makers.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Degree in Communications, Life Sciences, Business or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

  • At least 15 years of relevant Corporate Affairs, Communications, or Public Affairs experience, including senior leadership responsibility in biopharmaceuticals.

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated Corporate Affairs strategies across multiple countries.

  • Experience building corporate reputation, leading executive communications and managing sensitive issues or crises.

  • Ability to build capabilities and deliver through lean teams, agencies and global matrix organizations, with sound strategic judgment, prioritization and budget management.

  • Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive influencing skills, including translating complex science and policy for non-specialists; fluency in English.

Preferred Skills:

  • Oncology, precision medicine, biomarker-driven healthcare or rare diseases.

  • Affiliate establishment and international launch readiness in a high-growth or early commercial-stage biotechnology company.

  • Regional leadership across Asia-Pacific and Latin America, including direct experience in Japan, Canada, Australia or Brazil.

  • Distributor or partner-led markets, complex stakeholder partnerships and additional languages relevant to ICON.

Leadership Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strategic and enterprise thinking — sound policy judgment and courageous decisions.

  • Entrepreneurial leadership — build capabilities, develop people and prioritize for growth.

  • Collaboration and influence — executive presence, cultural awareness and adaptability.

  • Patient focus and integrity — accountability, transparency and meaningful patient outcomes.

Travel

  • This role requires regular international travel across ICON markets and to Revolution Medicines’ global offices.

Why Join Revolution Medicines

  • This is an opportunity to shape Revolution Medicines’ presence across a diverse and strategically important region. You will build a Corporate Affairs capability from the ground up, strengthen trusted partnerships, influence healthcare policy and help create the conditions for innovative precision medicines to reach patients with significant unmet medical needs.

  • Revolution Medicines is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives drive innovation and improve outcomes for patients worldwide.

Revolution Medicines takes protection and security of personal data very seriously and respects your right to privacy while using our website and when contacting us by email or phone. We will only collect, process and use any personal data that you provide to us in accordance with our CCPA Notice and Privacy Policy. For additional information, please contact .

We are aware of recent recruitment scams in which individuals or organizations falsely represent themselves as being affiliated with Revolution Medicines. These scams may appear as false job advertisements or unsolicited contacts through communication or chat platforms, email, phone, or text message.

Please note that Revolution Medicines does not extend unsolicited employment offers and will never ask candidates to provide financial information, purchase equipment, or pay fees as part of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from Revolution Medicines will come from an official @revmed.com email address.

Job Title: Technical Support Specialist

Employment Type: Regular, Full-time

Team: Customer Success

Reports to: Senior Manager, Customer Success

Location: US – Remote

About Us:

SimpliGovis a leading government workflow automation platform that helps state and local agencies digitize and streamline mission-critical processes. Its form-building, workflow-routing, document-management, and digital-signature capabilities replace manual work with secure, auditable digital workflows. Trusted by hundreds of U.S. government agencies,SimpliGovdelivers secure, dependable SaaS technology and an exceptional customer experience.

We are growing rapidly and looking for talented, high-impact players to join our team!

Role Overview:

The Technical Support Specialist supports SimpliGov’s SaaS platform while protecting the reliability, security, and integrity of customer environments. This role investigates complex technical issues, communicates clearly with customers and internal teams, and drives incidents through diagnosis, resolution, and root-cause documentation. Leveraging AI tools, this position continuously maximizes efficiency and effectiveness in operations and reporting.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically curious, and security-minded, with the ability to partner across Support, Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success to resolve issues, validate fixes, improve operations, and strengthen the customer experience.

Responsibilities:

Technical Support

  • Own escalated customer issues involving application behavior, data, workflows, integrations, authentication, connectivity, and performance
  • Proficiency using generative AI tools to accelerate technical research, troubleshooting, case analysis, and documentation.
  • Ability to create clear, structured prompts that provide appropriate context, constraints, examples, and desired output formats.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants to develop, explain, review, and troubleshoot SQL queries, PowerShell scripts, API requests, JSON, and XML.
  • Ability to use AI to summarize logs, identify patterns, generate diagnostic hypotheses, and recommend investigation steps.
  • Strong judgment in independently validating AI-generated queries, scripts, technical conclusions, and customer communications before use.
  • Knowledge of secure and responsible AI practices, including protecting customer data, credentials, personally identifiable information, confidential information, and proprietary code.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted knowledge management, including drafting knowledge-base articles, incident summaries, root-cause analyses, and troubleshooting runbooks.
  • Ability to evaluate new AI tools and identify responsible opportunities to improve support quality, response time, and operational efficiency.
  • Understanding of prompt-injection risks and the need to treat untrusted customer content, documents, logs, and websites cautiously when using AI-enabled tools.
  • Ability to explain AI-assisted findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences without overstating certainty.
  • Use diagnostics, logs, and approved tools to investigate issues and execute support procedures
  • Reproduce issues, isolate causes, document findings, and determine resolution or escalation paths
  • Communicate timely, accurate updates to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle
  • Maintain complete and actionable case documentation in Jira Service Management and related support systems
  • Troubleshoot customer identity and access configurations
  • Diagnose certificate, networking, and web application connectivity issues across customer and SimpliGov environments

Integrations, APIs & Cloud Operations

  • Troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations using standard support tools
  • Supportcloud services related to identity, networking, monitoring, and application hosting
  • Analyze telemetry using available monitoring and diagnostics tools, including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics
  • Research and resolve issues involving Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph API, and other connected business applications
  • Maintain safe, repeatable queries, scripts, and runbooks

Product Quality & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to validate defects, assess customer impact, and track resolution
  • Test bug fixes and release candidates, confirm production outcomes, and communicate relevant changes to Support and customer-facing teams
  • Collaborate with Professional Services and Customer Success on complex implementations, integrations, and customer environment issues
  • Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting playbooks, and training
  • Identifyrecurring support trends and recommend product or process improvements
  • Produce reporting dashboards, trend analysis and executive reporting packages

Qualifications:

  • 3-5+ years of progressive technical experience in a software company
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent combination of relevant education, certifications, and professional experience.
  • Demonstrated track record of troubleshooting technical issues and explaining complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, internally and externally
  • Ability to independently learn unfamiliar software platforms and business systems, and interpret technical documentation, system logs, API documentation, and vendor resources.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across SaaS applications, integrations, databases, cloud services, and logs
  • Proficiency using approved generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to support technical research, log analysis, SQL and PowerShell development, API troubleshooting, case documentation, and knowledge creation.
  • Ability to critically evaluate and independently validate AI-generated technical recommendations, queries, scripts, and conclusions before applying them in customer or production environments.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, information security, appropriate handling of customer information, and compliance with organizational AI-use policies.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, identity protocols, DNS, SSL/TLS, networking, and web application connectivity
  • Familiarity with APIs, data formats, Postman, Jira Service Management, service desk operations, and enterprise software platforms
  • Clear technical communication for case notes, customer updates, documentation, and internal guidance
  • Strong customer focus, prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement mindset

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, with significant employer contributions for employees AND dependents (contributions based on base-level plan; buyup plans available at additional costs)
  • Company-sponsored life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance
  • 11 Paid holidays
  • Flexible time off
  • 401k plan with 4% employer match
  • Monthly home office stipend
  • Monthly wellness stipend

Why Join SimpliGov?

At SimpliGov, you’ll be part of a mission‑driven team transforming how government works. We help state and local agencies modernize their processes and deliver better services to their communities. As a Customer Success Manager, you will gain hands‑on experience working with customers, technology teams, and real public‑impact projects—while developing the skills and experience needed to advance your career.

SimpliGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive team.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Legal Disclaimers:

SimpliGov does not currently sponsor applicants for work visas.

The US base salary range for this full-time position begins at $85,000 + bonus and benefits. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

SimpliGov participates in the federal government's E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of all newly hired employees and most existing employees through an electronic database maintained by the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security. For new hires, the E-Verify process is completed in conjunction with the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on or before the first day of work. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Revenue Technology Manager at GitLab, you'll lead how the tools we build and buy work together as we grow our consumption-based business. You'll own the vision, roadmap, and requirements for internal go-to-market applications, starting with Command Center, which helps field teams act on product usage and consumption data. You'll decide what those applications need to do and how they should fit with the rest of the stack. Engineering will own their technical architecture, code, and infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director, Revenue Technology, within Revenue Operations.

What you’ll do

  • Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.
  • Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.
  • Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.
  • Partner with Engineering to deliver applications that fit the existing stack and limit technical debt. Lead user acceptance testing, launch, documentation, and enablement, then use adoption data to decide what to improve, expand, or retire.
  • Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.
  • Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.
  • Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.
  • Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.
  • Hands-on experience with a consumption- or usage-based business model, including how teams use consumption metrics across the customer lifecycle.
  • Experience delivering internal tools with engineering teams, including writing scoped requirements and acceptance criteria and running user acceptance testing before release.
  • Experience making build-versus-buy or consolidation decisions based on cost, return on investment, and business fit. You can reconcile competing requests from senior stakeholders and explain your decisions clearly.
  • Experience shipping artificial intelligence agents or workflows people rely on, with the judgment to know where automation helps and where it adds complexity.
  • Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.

Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. We welcome transferable skills from related roles.

About the team

Revenue Technology owns the tools GitLab's go-to-market teams use, whether we build them or buy them. We're a globally distributed team that works asynchronously and partners with Revenue Operations, Revenue Strategy, Enablement, IT, and Engineering to support Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Ecosystem teams. We put decisions in writing and focus on making the tools easier for field teams to use.

Remote-Global

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$115,200—$194,400 USD

ServiceTitan is looking for an exceptional Senior Director of Product to lead our Enterprise product organization. Our largest customers are multi-brand, multi-location operators running complex organizations on ServiceTitan. This is a senior product leadership role. You will set the multi-year strategy, lead a team of product leaders and PMs, and make ServiceTitan the platform that the largest and most complex businesses in the trades can model, secure, and govern on their own terms. Just as important, you will rally product teams across the company to build enterprise-ready, organization-aware experiences. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of ownership, bring clarity to complex problems that span the company, and lead through influence well beyond your own team. The work directly drives new-logo growth, renewals, and expansion across our enterprise segment.


What you'll do:

  • Own the multi-year product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for ServiceTitan's Enterprise pillar, including accountability for enterprise new-logo, retention, and expansion goals.
  • Lead and develop a team of product leaders and PMs, setting a high bar for product thinking, execution, and customer impact, and building the next layer of product leadership.
  • Develop a clear point of view on how ServiceTitan should serve multi- brand, multi-location operators, where to invest, and how organization modeling and security and compliance capabilities should evolve over the next several years. Bring that point of view to the Executive Team and use it to shape company-level investment decisions.

  • Onboarding, and other product leaders to deliver cohesive enterprise experiences across ServiceTitan.

  • Build strong operating mechanisms that let the organization scale, make good decisions, and execute with increasing autonomy.
  • Develop talent, give clear feedback, and create growth opportunities for the leaders and PMs in your organization.
  • Identify opportunities beyond your immediate area and contribute to the broader product and platform strategy.

What you'll bring:

  • Strong systems thinking and an understanding of how products, platforms, workflows, and organizational boundaries interact.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and develop strong product teams and product leaders.
  • Strong executive presence, cross-functional leadership, and influence, including the ability to align Executive Team members and senior stakeholders with different perspectives.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to create clarity around complex topics for both internal and customer executive audiences.
  • A high degree of ownership and accountability, with a willingness to step beyond organizational boundaries when needed to deliver the right outcome.

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Gujarati -English Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Gujarati Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.55 - $0.70 per minute


We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:


The Gujarati Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Gujaratiand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inGujarati and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

    • Kaspersky products.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.

You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Research & Discovery

  • Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.
  • Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.
  • Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.

Outreach & Relationship Management

  • Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.
  • Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.
  • Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.

Contracts & Partnership Operations

  • Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.
  • Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.
  • Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.

Briefs, Content Review & Facilitation

  • Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.
  • Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.
  • Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.
  • QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.

Performance & Reporting

  • Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.
  • Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.

What We Are Looking For

  • 1-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, sponsorships, partner marketing, demand generation, or adjacent fields.
  • Hands-on technical experience, such as running a homelab, self-hosting services, or tinkering with networking, so you can follow technical content and spot inaccuracies.
  • Experience reaching out to and building relationships with external partners, creators, or vendors.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write briefs that are clear, concise, and easy to act on.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-assurance mindset; you catch broken links, missing tracking, or off-brand messaging before anything ships.
  • Ability to manage several partnerships at once with high reliability and end-to-end ownership.
  • Comfortable collaborating across Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product to move multi-stakeholder projects forward.
  • Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up research and routine operational work.
  • Genuine curiosity about the people who create technical content and the communities that watch, read, and listen.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a developer-focused, infrastructure, security, or B2B SaaS company.
  • Active presence in technical communities such as r/homelab, r/selfhosted, Discord servers, or similar.
  • An existing network of technical creators or familiarity with the technical creator landscape.
  • Experience with influencer discovery tools or creator databases.
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or Jira.
  • Familiarity with FTC disclosure guidelines and content usage rights.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support events and creator meetups.

Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$76,000—$92,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.

Channelscaler is transforming how companies scale through their partners. Our AI-powered platform automates and simplifies partner engagement — from onboarding and incentives to performance tracking — helping vendors and partners grow faster together.

You’ll develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business processes, configuration, integrations, data flows, and technical objectives, working closely with Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, and Integration teams to drive successful outcomes.

This role does not carry a sales quota or direct commercial target, and is critical to strong customer technical health and long-term platform adoption.

  • Provide expert guidance across APIs, SSO, CRM connections, data mapping, file exchanges, and other integrations.
