From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Pricing at our company is evolving quickly, and sellers need to keep pace with each change. We are seeking a Senior Pricing Enablement Manager who can translate packaging, curve, consumption, and ELA updates into clear enablement that provides guidance, covering what changed, why it changed, what sellers can offer, and when approval is required. You will own the enablement timeline across Pricing, Product, Deal Desk, and Product Marketing, and you will use field feedback to help shape future pricing decisions.

This is a full-time remote position with a preference for candidates to be near one of our offices in New York, Austin, or Denver.

Technologies You’ll Use

Thought Industries, Salesforce, Gong, Notion, Claude

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Pricing and Product Operations to provide enablement around net-new packaging, curve, discounts, consumption, bundles, and ELA changes. Build compelling and thorough and multi-modal enablement that explains what changed, why it changed, how to price it in a live deal, and deliver them through live sessions, leader briefings, and LMS content so the message lands consistently across segments.
  • Translate approved pricing policies into clear, digestible enablement so sellers understand what they can offer, when approval is needed, and how to follow the process. Work with Strat Ops, Pricing, and Deal Desk to confirm that quoting, approval, and CPQ workflows match the policy, and train the field on system changes as they ship.
  • Support with post launch reinforcement byidentifying gaps in how the field is applying each pricing change, using deal reviews, Deal Desk escalations, call recordings, and sales input. Attend follow-up launches and pricing meetings to pull in sales feedback, and keep iterating on reinforcement until seller behavior changes.
  • Partner with Deal Desk, Pricing, Product, and Product Marketing to maintain a single enablement timeline for all pricing and product updates, from launch through follow-up. Run a regular cadence with these teams to surface upcoming changes early, agree on owners and dates, and prevent conflicting or late communications to the field.
  • Gather structured input from Sales, Customer Success, and field leaders on pricing effectiveness, customer sentiment, and operational challenges, through surveys, office hours, and deal-level conversations. Analyze recurring themes and pain points, and synthesize them into specific recommendations for pricing policy improvements.
  • Bring what you see in the field to Pricing Strategy, Product, and Sales leadership to inform future pricing and packaging decisions.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, product marketing, pricing, deal desk, or sales strategy at a B2B software company
  • Experience enabling sellers on complex pricing, packaging, and consumption-based or usage-based models
  • Understanding of how pricing and packaging decisions flow into GTM systems, such as CPQ and Salesforce, and the ability to write clear business requirements for systems teams
  • Ability to build trusted relationships across Deal Desk, Pricing, Product, and Product Marketing, and to coordinate their input into a clear training timeline
  • Skill designing and delivering learning across formats, including live sessions, LMS content, and follow-up coaching
  • An analytical approach to field feedback, with the ability to find recurring themes and turn them into clear recommendations for leadership
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present to sellers and to Pricing Strategy, Product, and Sales leaders
  • Ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across a fast-moving launch cadence

jobs.description:
Arise is a globally active weight-loss app with over 10 million downloads and a 4.6 rating on the App Store. Our mission is simple but ambitious: empower millions of people to become healthier and happier.

We're looking for a CTO who is a true architect on both iOS and Android — someone deeply skilled in iOS who can take full ownership of our existing app and raise it further, and who can also build our Android app from scratch. You'll develop primarily through AI rather than by hand, and you'll thrive on ownership, precision, and long-term thinking. This role is for someone who ships high-quality code today while foreseeing how today's decisions shape the app for years ahead — technically, strategically, and financially.

Today Arise is iOS-only, so this is where you'll start and where you'll prove yourself: owning, deepening, and future-proofing a mature codebase used by millions. From there, you'll architect and build our Android app from the ground up.

If you excel at structured, autonomous work, build with AI as your default way of working, understand the importance of monetization, and want to own the technology behind a product used by millions, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role

  • Own and architect the existing iOS app — maintain, optimize, deepen, and future-proof a codebase used by millions.
  • Build the Arise Android app from scratch — architecture, delivery, and long-term ownership.
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency and a coherent technical vision across both platforms.
  • Develop and test features that enhance the Arise experience.
  • Use AI agents and automated workflows as your primary means of building, testing, and shipping — not as an occasional helper.
  • Anticipate technical pitfalls and proactively design solutions.
  • Collaborate with design to refine usability for a smooth user experience.
  • Support monetization by integrating features with measurable business impact.

Requirements

  • Proven track record architecting and shipping production mobile apps, ideally as a senior engineer, lead, or technical founder.
  • Deep, architect-level iOS expertise — you can own a mature codebase end to end and make the hard structural calls with confidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to build an Android app from scratch to the same standard.
  • Hands-on fluency building through AI — agentic coding tools, LLM-driven workflows, automated testing and release. You've actually shipped this way, not just experimented.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working fully in English.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level iOS/Swift — architecture, patterns, performance, and the judgment to keep a large app maintainable as it grows.
  • Strong Android development (Kotlin) with the ability to architect a new app end to end.
  • Familiarity with mobile build and release tooling (e.g. Fastlane).
  • Deep understanding of Apple and Android design principles, patterns, and best practices.
  • Ability to write clean, well-documented, maintainable code — and to direct AI to do the same.

Who You Are

  • A decisive builder who takes a problem and runs with it — you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for certainty.
  • Direct and results-driven, comfortable owning outcomes and making the call.
  • Energized by autonomy and full ownership of the technology.
  • Allergic to bureaucracy — "meetings that should have been emails" are your enemy.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

How to Apply

Send us your application including:

  • Your CV
  • A history of the mobile apps you've built (iOS and Android)

jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role overview

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.

In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.

You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.

Responsibilities

Security Tool Rollout

  • Take key part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company
  • Evaluate tools and present recommendations to the CTO and IT Director
  • Apply security baselines across tools and devices

Identity & Access Management

  • Own the administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA and integrations with our tools
  • Manage access to new software and AI tools through Okta
  • Run regular access reviews and fix permissions that don’t match current roles

Tool Administration

  • Administer Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp and AI assistant tools, including users, permissions and security settings
  • Track licences and flag unused or underused accounts
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of tools, accounts and admin roles

Automation

  • Automate onboarding so new joiners get the right access on day one
  • Automate offboarding so leavers lose access promptly and their data is handled correctly
  • Build integrations and workflows between tools using automation platforms or scripting

Security Monitoring & Support

  • Monitor security alerts, sign-in activity and admin logs, and act on issues
  • Work with our security and DevOps colleagues on infrastructure hardening
  • Handle first-line access requests and support tickets from colleagues
  • Investigate incidents, then record causes and fixes

Documentation

  • Document every tool, automation and process so others can understand and run it
  • Write clear guides for colleagues on access and security practices
  • Share regular progress updates and agree priorities with your manager

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering tools for organisations of 50+ people
  • Hands-on experience administering Okta (or equivalent IAM solution) and Google Workspace
  • A track record of driving IT or security initiatives, not only handling tickets
  • Willingness to handle requests from the team, helping keep tools and infrastructure running smoothly

Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of identity and access management, including SSO, MFA and role-based access
  • Working knowledge of device management and endpoint protection
  • Ability to build workflows with automation platforms, APIs or scripting
  • Understanding of security good practice for SaaS tools and BYOD environments
  • Cybersecurity experience is a strong plus
  • An engineering degree is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

  • Takes ownership and works independently in a less structured environment
  • Coachable and open to feedback
  • Explains technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Organised, prioritises well and follows through
  • Collaborative and low-ego team player

What we offer

  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid Vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff.

jobs.excerpt: Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies.
jobs.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

Parachute Health sells its order management platform to HME/DME suppliers, and our Supplier BDR team sources the first meeting for a significant share of the new opportunities our Account Executives pursue. The team has established strong activity volume. The next priority is meeting quality: improving show rates, engaging more owners and budget holders, and focusing on suppliers with the scale to buy. The goal is pipeline that converts to signed revenue rather than stalling in early stages.

The BDR team does not currently have a dedicated leader. In this role, you will lead the team full time as its manager and coach, allowing our Account Executives to focus fully on selling. You will not carry a personal closing quota. Your success will be measured by the team’s results: held meetings, meeting quality, and the pipeline and revenue generated from those meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Leading and developing the team

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s, Gong call reviews, and live call coaching with each BDR.
  • Lead hiring, onboarding, and ramp for new BDRs. We plan to add two to four seats in 2027, and you will own the 30/60/90-day ramp plan.
  • Establish a clear career path from BDR to Account Executive and prepare top performers for promotion.
  • Identify and address performance concerns early, document them appropriately, and partner with People Operations as needed.

Activity, Pipeline, and Meeting Quality

  • Establish daily and weekly activity standards, including dials, connects, emails, and booked and held meetings, and hold the team accountable to them.
  • Own the team’s held-meeting target and the conversion from held meeting to demo to signed deal.
  • Reduce no-shows by partnering with Marketing on confirmation and reminder sequences and defining a clear standard for a qualified meeting.
  • Maintain accurate HubSpot data: every booked meeting has an associated deal with an amount and the correct AE owner, every deal carries BDR attribution, and stale early-stage deals are either advanced or closed.
  • Report team performance to Sales leadership weekly and lead monthly and quarterly business reviews.

Targeting and Campaigns

  • Build and assign territories and target lists, including High Value Target lists, dormant-account outreach, and conference lead follow-up (e.g., Medtrade, ResMed Connect).
  • Keep the team focused on suppliers that match our ideal customer profile: those that bill insurance, hold a PTAN, and receive consistent order volume from multiple referring clinicians.
  • Partner with Marketing to improve MQL response times, optimize sequences, and execute account-based campaigns for priority targets.
  • Collaborate with HME Business Operations on contact data, lead routing, and reporting.

Partnership with the Account Executive Team

  • Route qualified meetings to the appropriate AE with thorough handoff notes covering product lines, payers, billing system, intake process, and key decision makers.
  • Maintain a regular feedback loop with AEs on meeting quality and address gaps promptly.
  • Share insights from the field, including objections, competitive intelligence, and pricing feedback, with Sales, Marketing, and Product, and keep scripts and battle cards current.

Compensation and Programs

  • Administer the BDR compensation plan: track meetings, prepare monthly commission results for approval, and recommend plan adjustments as the sales process evolves.
  • Design contests and recognition programs that reward the right outcomes, such as held meetings with qualified buyers rather than booked meetings alone.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

  • The team meets or exceeds its held-meeting target each quarter, with a hold rate above 65%.
  • Fewer opportunities are lost to no-shows, unresponsive prospects, or stalled deals.
  • Every BDR-sourced deal in HubSpot includes an amount, an owner, and BDR attribution.
  • New BDRs are fully ramped within their first 90 days.
  • The team secures more meetings with owners and decision makers at higher-value suppliers, and BDR-sourced revenue grows as a share of total signed revenue.
  • At least one BDR is promoted into an Account Executive role.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B sales or sales development, including at least 1–2 years leading, coaching, or managing SDRs or BDRs.
  • Proven track record of building outbound programs that achieve meeting and pipeline targets.
  • Successful experience as a BDR, with the ability to model effective calls for the team.
  • Proficiency in HubSpot or Salesforce reporting, with the ability to independently analyze data and diagnose activity and conversion issues.
  • Hands-on experience with prospecting and call tools such as HubSpot Sequences, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
  • Healthcare technology or HME/DME experience strongly preferred.
  • Direct communicator who raises issues early and takes ownership of results.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for team meetings, conferences, and customer events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums.
  • Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance.
  • Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces.
  • Flexible Vacation Policy

We’re looking for a Director of Sales Talent Acquisition to lead our global team of sales recruiters and make sales hiring a genuine competitive advantage for Grafana Labs. What makes you a great fit

Utility 3D Modeling & Design Manager

Why YOU want thisposition

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Enverus is currently seeking a Utility 3D Modeling & Design Engineer. This is a hands-on management position requiring a strong understanding of electric power utility engineering, design standards, equipment specifications, and 3D modeling practices. The ideal candidate will have direct experience with electric utility design and model development, along with proficiency in industry-standard design platforms such as Autodesk AutoCAD, Inventor, and/or Revit. This is a remote position based in the US.

The manager will oversee a team of approximately seven employees consisting of entry-level and senior-level 3D modelers. In addition to managing daily operations, this individual will actively participate in complex modeling projects, develop and refine modeling standards, perform technical reviews, and mentor team members.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of accurate, intelligent, and reusable 3D utility models that support SBS software functionality, customer requirements, and the continued expansion of SBS's utility engineering content libraries.

Performance Objectives

Hands-On 3D Modeling & Technical Design

  • Actively participate in the creation, development, and refinement of intelligent 3D models for electric utility equipment and infrastructure.
  • Develop complex or specialized models that require advanced utility engineering knowledge and modeling expertise.
  • Utilize AutoCAD, Inventor, Revit, and other applicable design tools to develop and maintain 3D model content.
  • Establish and maintain modeling standards, templates, workflows, and best practices.
  • Review and validate model geometry, engineering attributes, dimensions, connectivity, and other technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex modeling issues and provide direct technical assistance to team members.
  • Identify opportunities to improve model accuracy, functionality, consistency, and reusability.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of approximately seven 3D modelers with varying levels of experience.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and coaching to entry-level and senior-level team members.
  • Assign projects, establish priorities, and manage team workloads to meet customer and internal deadlines.
  • Monitor team performance, productivity, quality, and project deliverables.
  • Establish quality assurance and peer-review processes for all 3D modeling deliverables.
  • Identify training needs and develop team capabilities in utility engineering, modeling techniques, and SBS software tools.
  • Foster a collaborative environment focused on technical excellence and continuous improvement.

Utility Model Library Development

  • Lead the development and maintenance of SBS's standardized 3D utility model libraries.
  • Oversee the creation of models representing electric substation, transmission, distribution, and other utility infrastructure.
  • Ensure models accurately represent equipment geometry, engineering characteristics, specifications, and applicable design standards.
  • Manage new model development based on customer requirements, manufacturer specifications, and industry standards.
  • Ensure models are properly structured, attributed, and optimized for use within SBS software applications.
  • Establish processes for model version control, documentation, quality review, and ongoing library maintenance.

Utility Standards & Engineering Practices

  • Apply practical knowledge of electric utility engineering standards and design practices to guide model development.
  • Interpret utility engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and design standards and translate them into accurate 3D models.
  • Maintain familiarity with industry standards and utility-specific requirements.
  • Work with customers and internal technical resources to resolve engineering and modeling questions.
  • Ensure consistent application of engineering and modeling standards across the team.

Customer & Project Support

  • Coordinate and prioritize customer-specific 3D modeling requests.
  • Work with SBS customer-facing teams to understand technical requirements and establish project deliverables.
  • Participate in customer discussions requiring utility engineering or 3D modeling expertise.
  • Balance customer-specific requests with ongoing development and expansion of SBS's standard model libraries.
  • Ensure timely delivery of accurate, high-quality modeling projects.

Competitive Candidate Profile

  • Minimum of five years of experience in the electric power utility industry involving engineering standards, electrical design, equipment modeling, or related technical disciplines.
  • Direct experience with electric utility equipment, infrastructure, and engineering design practices.
  • Hands-on proficiency with at least one of the following: Autodesk AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, and/or Autodesk Revit.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining 3D engineering models or equipment libraries.
  • Previous experience leading, supervising, or mentoring technical personnel.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Ability and willingness to remain actively involved in hands-on modeling and technical design.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with electric substation design, transmission, or distribution engineering.
  • Experience developing intelligent, parametric 3D models and reusable equipment libraries.
  • Experience with utility engineering standards and manufacturer equipment specifications.
  • Familiarity with BIM processes, CAD standards, and engineering content management.
  • Experience integrating 3D models with engineering design and analysis software.
  • Experience with automation or scripting to improve modeling productivity.
  • Experience working with software development and product management teams.

Key Success Factors

The successful candidate will:

  • Maintain an active role in 3D model development while effectively managing a seven-person modeling team.
  • Serve as the team's primary technical resource for complex utility modeling and design challenges.
  • Develop a consistent, high-quality, and reusable library of utility equipment models.
  • Establish efficient modeling standards, workflows, and quality assurance processes.
  • Develop the technical capabilities of entry-level and senior-level modelers.
  • Balance hands-on technical work, team management, customer requests, and product development priorities.
  • Ensure SBS model content supports current and future utility engineering software requirements.

BlueVoyant is seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our enterprise network infrastructure with a focus on security and performance. Working within our Security Engineering team and alongside Security Operations and cloud infrastructure teams, you'll play a critical role in protecting and optimizing the network that powers our global operations.

What You'll Do:

  • Network Design & Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routing and security components, across multiple locations and cloud environments.
  • Palo Alto Networks Management: Manage and optimize Palo Alto Networks firewall deployments and Panorama, including policy configuration, threat prevention, and advanced security features.
  • Cloudflare Services: Implement and maintain Cloudflare services, including CDN, DDoS protection, WAF, and Zero Trust network access (Access and Gateway).

  • Remote Access & Hybrid Connectivity: Manage VPN and remote access technologies, and work with cloud infrastructure teams to ensure secure, efficient hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Monitoring & Assessment: Monitor network performance, availability, and security, conduct regular security assessments, and drive remediation.
  • Incident Response: Collaborate with Security Operations on incident response and forensic analysis of network-related security events.
  • Policy & Compliance: Develop and maintain network security policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with frameworks including NIST, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
  • Automation & Optimization: Implement network automation to improve operational efficiency, and lead capacity planning and performance optimization initiatives.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership, evaluate and implement new network and security technologies, and lead technical projects from design to delivery.
  • Resilience & Support: Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning, maintain detailed network documentation, and participate in an on-call rotation for critical infrastructure.

What You'll Bring:
You're a hands-on, senior network security engineer who combines deep technical expertise with sound judgment. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities, take ownership of complex problems, and can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • 5–10 years of progressive network engineering experience in enterprise environments (1,000+ employees), including large-scale network implementations and migrations.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise networking protocols and services, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, VPN, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, and load balancing.
  • Deep understanding of network security principles, including micro-segmentation, zero-trust architecture, threat detection, and network access control (NAC) with identity integration.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking and hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Proficiency in network automation tools and scripting languages, and experience with network monitoring and management tools.
  • Experience with network security incident response and forensic analysis.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and compliance requirements (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and project management skills, with experience leading technical initiatives.
  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE) or equivalent.

Nice to Have:

  • Cloudflare Certified Professional, Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent vendor certifications.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or SANS/GIAC.
  • Knowledge of emerging network security technologies, including SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).

Education:

You will be part of the team focusing on critical thinking. We're looking for a proactive, forward-thinking individual who can help to unpack and communicate complex technical concepts in simple and accessible ways, keeping learner engagement and motivation front of mind.

This role calls for creativity, initiative, collaboration, and independent judgement. Your primary focus will be new content development, particularly in interactive formats and supporting educator resources that help teachers integrate digital materials into the classroom.

  • High agency and initiative: You are proactive and comfortable taking ownership of the overall project outcome, not just your individual contribution, and stepping in to help unblock or move work forward when needed.
  • Sound judgement: You critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted work, and are able to justify your choices through sharing your thought process.
  • High personal standard of work: You review and check your own work critically before it is sent for stakeholder review.

  • Direct a cross-functional team of subject matter experts, product designers, engineers, multimedia designers, and faculty to deliver cohesive and engaging learning experiences.

  • Collaborate with product design and engineering teams to research, prototype, and evaluate new approaches and content formats for philosophy learning.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in learning design, learning science, analytic philosophy, and logic, contributing to an internal community of practice.

  • Post-secondary education in philosophy, analytic philosophy, logic or mathematics with 3 or more years of work or teaching experience in relevant fields.

  • Strong problem-solving and people skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and engaging manner suitable for the target audience.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Designer with experience designing for technical documentation to join the Tailscale product design team. You will work as a designer dedicated to the Docs team focusing on information architecture of the site, presentation of content, and educational support materials.

At Tailscale, we don’t see Documentation as an afterthought; it’s how users learn, deploy, troubleshoot, and fall in love with Tailscale. It’s both a discovery surface and a place where users look to find answers in stressful situations.

This designer will work closely with dedicated engineers on the Docs site to ensure the quality and delivery of content meets the needs of all users. They will collaborate with technical writers, product designers, engineers, PMs, and customer-facing colleagues to ensure documentation is intuitive, visually compelling, and deeply user centric.

Key Responsibilities

Some examples of projects we anticipate in the near term:

  • Support a transition from our current docs platform to a new one, including appropriate IA changes for a large docs corpus.
  • Establish a brand-appropriate style guide for the new docs site that optimizes for readability.
  • Draft and maintain a library of diagrams to be used as assets within the docs site and educational content.
  • Enable experimentation on docs surfaces through collaboration with the growth team and test-related tooling.
  • Design educational content for LMS materials with attention to classroom usability.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of product design experience, including complex work you've owned end-to-end (portfolio required)

  • A portfolio that shows how you've made technical content clear, usable, and visually engaging
  • Experience adapting brand guidelines to documentation and educational content

Mindset and Approach

Department: People & Culture
Reports to: Director, People & Culture Business Partnerships, Retail
Location: Remote USA

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

You act as a trusted advisor with our Area Retail Leadership team to accomplish short and long-term business objectives, through the application of thoughtful, intentional and innovative people practices. You lead a team of experienced retail business partners to ensure excellence, consistency and discipline in bringing our employee experience to life in our retail stores.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Retail People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner team operates in partnership with the retail business to drive the continuous evolution of people practices and foster a culture of belonging that generates high-performance, strength-based teams, and values-based leadership. As a senior member of the North America Retail P&C team, you will collaborate across the wider People & Culture team and partner with Area Retail leadership to shape and execute people strategies across a large, multi-market retail organization while leading and developing a team of P&C professionals in support of business objectives.

If you were the Manager, People & Culture Business Partnerships, Retail – US now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Serving as the primary P&C partner to Area Retail leadership, supporting a large, multi-market retail business across the United States/Canada.
  • Leading and developing a team of P&C BPs, providing coaching, development, performance management, and strategic direction to ensure exceptional partnership and execution across the retail organization.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to senior retail leaders, influencing business decisions through a people lens while balancing employee experience, organizational effectiveness, and business performance.
  • Partnering with Area leadership to build high-performing teams that exceed business objectives through effective talent planning, leadership development, engagement, and succession strategies.
  • Fostering, nurturing, and evolving relationships to enable credibility, trust, influence, and strong cross-functional partnerships throughout the organization.
  • Providing day-to-day, short and long-term consultation and coaching to leaders on talent identification, succession planning, leadership effectiveness, organizational design, workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, compensation, recognition, learning and development, and complex employee matters.
  • Leading and executing organizational effectiveness initiatives and partnering with senior leaders to evaluate structures, capabilities, and resourcing strategies to support business growth.
  • Leveraging people and business analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translating insights into actionable recommendations and business decisions.
  • Championing leadership development and ensuring employees and leaders have access to the tools, resources, and opportunities needed to support their growth and career development.
  • Leading the implementation and adoption of company-wide P&C programs across the Area, including Talent Reviews, Performance Management, Succession Planning, Employee Engagement, Diversity & Inclusion initiatives, and Leadership Development programs.
  • Partnering with the global P&C team to ensure initiatives, workstreams, and communication flows productively between both teams to ensure consistency.
  • Driving cross-functional and enterprise-wide projects that address organizational priorities, improve employee experience, and enhance business performance.
  • Partnering with Retail, Operations, Asset Protection, Talent Acquisition, and other key stakeholders to support strategic workforce planning and long-term talent strategies.
  • Conducting regular market and store visits to build relationships, assess organizational health, identify emerging trends, and ensure alignment between people strategies and business objectives.
  • Leading change management initiatives associated with organizational transformation, business growth, and evolving retail priorities.

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Partnership with Director, P&C to create and rollout innovative P&C strategies that support the continued growth and evolution of the retail organization.
  • Building and evolving leadership capability programs that strengthen the retail leadership pipeline and succession readiness across the Area.
  • Creating regional talent solutions to ensure regional capabilities meet the requirements of the business
  • Assessing future workforce needs and developing short and long-term regional talent strategies to ensure organizational capability and business readiness.
  • Mentoring and developing the next generation of P&C talent while building a high-performing and engaged P&C team
  • Supporting with large-scale organizational design and workforce transformation initiatives for retail in partnership with senior and executive business leaders.

Are you our next P&C Business Partner, Retail, US?

  • You have 7+ years of progressive HR experience in retail and/or hospitality
  • You have 2+ years of people leadership experience
  • You have a strong understanding of employment law in key US markets we operate in
  • You are comfortable navigating relationships, with expertise in leveraging data to manage a complex group of stakeholders
  • You highly collaborative style and a willingness and demonstrated ability to work in teams as both a leader, and supporting team member
  • You have the ability to coach, mentor, advise team members towards growth and development paths in alignment with business and personal objectives
  • You have strong project management skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, easily able to analyze data, assess people, understand trends, and develop prioritized recommendations
  • You have excellent listening and communication skills, comfortable communicating large complex changes
  • You are comfortable operating in the work, and simultaneously enjoy being part of highly complex business discussions
  • You can quickly build an in depth understanding of the business, key processes, priorities and plans
  • You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity
  • You can balance autonomy and collaboration
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking and continuous improvement
  • You seek the best (but sometimes not the easiest) solutions, with an unwavering commitment to do what is right
  • You are able to travel regularly to markets and stores across your Area; travel costs are reimbursed per company policy
  • Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it

Compensation:

    The salary range for this role is USD$121, 000 - USD$150, 000

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

  • Financial wellbeing - Immediately vested 401(k) retirement savings plan matching, eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), where applicable.

  • Growth, community & gear - Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events), Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).

 *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.
Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.

About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

Mechanical engineering teams rely on a complex ecosystem of CAD, PLM, and enterprise systems to design, review, and manufacture products. At CoLab, we're building software that fits naturally into those workflows.

As a Product Manager for our Build Forge team, you'll own the product direction for how CoLab connects with the systems engineers use every day. Your goal is to make complex engineering workflows simpler, helping customers move seamlessly between CoLab and their existing tools.

This role requires more than traditional SaaS product management experience. We need someone who understands how engineering data moves through an organization, from CAD models and revisions to BOMs, change management, and PLM systems.

You'll work closely with customers, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, set priorities, and deliver solutions that create measurable value. One week you might be defining how CoLab integrates with Siemens Teamcenter, the next, you could be mapping a customer's engineering change workflow to identify where disconnected systems create unnecessary work.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You've spent meaningful time in the CAD, PLM, or engineering software ecosystem. You understand the complexity of enterprise engineering environments and can connect technical details to real customer problems.
  • You're equally comfortable discussing revision management with an engineering team and making product tradeoffs with developers.
  • You bring curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to challenge assumptions respectfully. You don't need every answer upfront, but you know how to find the right people, ask better questions, and make progress.
  • If your product experience is primarily in general-purpose SaaS and you're unfamiliar with mechanical engineering workflows, this likely isn't the right fit.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the product roadmap for Build Forge, prioritizing CAD, PLM, and enterprise integrations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, including revision management, BOMs, engineering changes, and design collaboration.
  • Translate complex customer needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver intuitive, reliable integrations and platform capabilities.
  • Balance customer-specific integration needs with scalable solutions that benefit the broader customer base.
  • Use customer feedback, adoption data, and business priorities to inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and other stakeholders to support adoption and continuously improve the product.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in technical B2B software.
  • Strong domain knowledge of CAD, PLM, or Mechanical Engineering Lifecycle workflows.
  • Experience with platforms such as PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE/ENOVIA, or Autodesk Vault.
  • Understanding of engineering data, BOMs, revision control, and engineering change management.
  • Experience translating technical customer problems into product priorities.
  • Bonus: Experience with CAD plugins, PLM integrations, ERP connectivity, or engineering workflow automation.

Extra Details

  • Compensation: Full-time, permanent position with an attractive compensation package, including stock options.
  • Benefits: Extended health benefits, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP/401K matching.
  • Remote/Hybrid: Flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Canada or the US.

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

Surefire Cyber is redefining the incident response model by delivering a swifter, stronger response to cyber incidents such as ransomware, email compromise, malware, data theft, and other threats. Our client-centric approach reduces stress and provides clients the confidence needed to prepare, respond, and recover from cyber incidents – and fortify their cyber resilience after an event.

Surefire Cyber’s approach and delivery are designed by industry veterans who have worked shoulder-to ­shoulder with law firms, insurance carriers, brokers, law enforcement, and impacted organizations in responding to cyber incidents. We are marshaling this experience to address the industry’s persistent challenges of efficiency, predictability, and transparency.

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Remote (USA)

Role: Full time / Exempt

What Makes You Stand Out

You are an incredibly motivated and driven Project Manager with foundational knowledge and experience in cybersecurity. You enjoy creating structures from disorganization and composing documentation that can be easily accessed and shared with team members.

You have a passion for business process improvements and participating in change management activities that drive efficiencies and deliver swifter first-class results. As a client-facing professional, you serve as a reliable support system to clients and team members to ensure that all action items are followed through on and exceed desired expectations.

You will play a key role in streamlining efficiencies across the Surefire suite of service offerings, ensuring seamless collaboration and alignment. This position is well-suited for someone with a foundational background in cyber incident response management, enabling them to effectively oversee and drive complex cybersecurity projects within our organization.

At times, the Project Manager will represent Surefire Cyber as consulting resource and interact with team members from our DFIR (Digital Forensic and Incident Response) and Advisory teams to ensure engagements are running smoothly and appropriate after-action items are completed in a timely manner.

Your Role In Action

  • Work closely with and seek guidance from the Director of Customer Success and fellow Project Managers as needed to ensure project roadmaps and initiatives are properly prioritized and delivered upon for Surefire Cyber.
  • Build professional relationships and communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and clients to develop and align a first-class strategy with their overall business and incident response objectives.

  • Manage cyber incident response projects from initiation to completion, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

  • Assist with post-incident reviews and lessons learned sessions to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions for future incident response engagements.
  • Learn and stay up to date with the latest cyber threats, attack techniques, incident response technologies, and best practices, and apply them to project management methodologies.
  • Contribute to incident response teams, establishing clear roles and responsibilities, and fostering a collaborative and results-driven work environment.

jobs.description:
Role Description

The Revenue Cycle Denials Representative is responsible for managing and resolving denied Professional Billing (PB/CMS-1500) and/or Hospital Billing (HB/UB-04) claims. This role identifies root causes of denials, executes appeals and corrective actions, and collaborates with internal teams to prevent future denials. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with CARC/RARC denial codes, Epic denial work queues, and payer-specific appeal requirements across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers.

Roles & Responsibilities

Denial Review & Resolution – PB & HB

  • Review and analyze denied PB (CMS-1500 / 837P) and HB (UB-04 / 837I) claims to determine root causes and appropriate resolution strategies.
  • Analyze account history and all previous actions in Epic prior to taking the next action step to resolve the claim.
  • Work claims across all top denial categories including, but not limited to: No Authorization, Timely Filing, Coordination of Benefits (COB), Medical Necessity, Additional Documentation Requests (ADR), Bundling (NCCI edits), and Duplicate Claims.
  • Interpret CARC and RARC codes on 835 ERA / EOB remittance data for both PB and HB claims to determine the correct resolution path.
  • Understand when claim corrections, rebilling (837P or 837I), or void-and-replace actions are appropriate.
  • Escalate claims with payers for resolution when processing is inaccurate or delayed.

Appeals & Reconsiderations

  • Prepare and submit appeals and reconsideration requests in compliance with payer-specific guidelines and deadlines for both PB and HB denied claims.
  • Attach appropriate clinical documentation, medical records, authorization references, and justification letters to support appeal submissions.
  • Meet appeal deadlines for Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers in accordance with payer-specific requirements.

Trend Identification & Prevention

  • Identify denial trends across PB and HB claim types and collaborate with coding, clinical, and billing teams to implement corrective actions.
  • Monitor payer policy and regulatory changes (Medicare LCDs/NCDs, Arkansas Medicaid updates) to proactively prevent denials.
  • Assist in developing best practices and training materials for PB and HB denial management and prevention.

Payer & System Knowledge

  • Navigate Epic denial and underpayment work queues for both HB and PB modules; document all denial actions and resolutions.
  • Utilize payer portals (Availity, Arkansas DHS, Medicare.gov, and commercial payer sites) to research denial reasons and submit appeals.
  • Utilize resources provided by the client to promote accuracy and resolve claims in accordance with client expectations.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain thorough documentation of denial reasons, appeal actions, and resolutions in Epic.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and payer regulations as well as hospital and physician practice policies.

  • Always maintain confidentiality of patient and account information (HIPAA).

  • Maintain awareness of and actively participate in the Corporate Compliance Program.
  • Maintain a confidential and orderly remote work area.
  • Meet specified goals and objectives assigned by management and/or the Client.
  • Assist with other projects as assigned by management.

Expected / Key Results

  • Deliver high levels of client and patient satisfaction (CSAT)

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, denial management, or claims resolution
  • Demonstrated experience working PB (CMS-1500 / 837P) and/or HB (UB-04 / 837I) denials
  • Prior experience with Epic denial work queues strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial payers preferred
  • Experience interpreting CARC/RARC codes and 835 ERA / EOB remittance data
  • Knowledge of NCCI edits, LCD/NCD policies, and authorization/pre-certification workflows

Competencies & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of PB and HB denial workflows, appeal processes, and payer-specific requirements
  • Proficiency with Epic (HB and/or PB modules, denial work queues, claim correction, void-and-replace, and rebilling)
  • Solid understanding of CARC/RARC denial reason codes and how to act on them for PB and HB claims
  • Ability to read and interpret 835 ERA / EOB remittance advice for both PB and HB claims

About this opportunity:

At Freenome, we are seeking a seasoned Staff Computational Biologist to help grow the Freenome Computational Science team. The ideal candidate is an expert in computational biology, genomics, and modeling, with a proven track record in industry settings. In this role, you will apply your background in computational biology and statistics to drive the creation of new applications and enhance algorithms for identifying molecular signatures of cancer. You will collaborate closely with machine learning scientists and computational biologists to iteratively advance computational models and assays, playing a key role in bringing products to the clinic. By joining us, you will have a significant impact on the continued growth of an organization dedicated to changing the entire landscape of cancer.

The role reports to the Manager and Staff Computational Biologist leading genomics modeling within Computational Science. This position can be onsite, hybrid, or remote (US only), based out of our campus in Brisbane, California.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a key thought-leader on the Computational Science team, leading the analysis and interpretation of cancer's molecular signatures and staying current with the field.
  • Guide and contribute to the development of models that characterize biological changes associated with cancer.
  • Execute rigorous computational analyses on data from best-in-class molecular assays, including whole genome sequencing, whole genome bisulfite sequencing, targeted sequencing, RNA sequencing, and protein quantitation.
  • Design novel statistical models for the evaluation, characterization, and modeling of these data types within the context of cancer biology and progression.
  • Identify research hypotheses and potential areas for model improvement; plan, scope, and execute associated research projects with a skilled team of computational biologists.
  • Solve complex analytical challenges inherent to the study of cell-free circulating nucleic acids and proteins.
  • Partner closely with molecular biologists to collaboratively refine wet lab experiments, and with development scientists to turn research models into products.
  • Support the professional development and career growth of talented, cross-functional computational biologists within your team.

Must haves:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in a relevant quantitative field (e.g., computational biology, cancer biology, statistics, bioinformatics).
  • At least 8 years of post-PhD experience applying computational techniques for biological discovery and product development, preferably in cancer or diagnostics within an industry setting.
  • Deep expertise in cancer and molecular biology, with a proven ability to leverage this knowledge for computational biology and diagnostics problems in cancer.
  • Extensive experience analyzing data and developing models for high-throughput, quantitative technologies in genomics, epigenomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, (e.g., Methyl-seq, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq, Hi-C, immunodetection assays).
  • Proficiency in computational and programming skills, including extensive experience with Python statistical packages (Numpy, Matplotlib, Pandas) and modeling packages (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) or equivalents in languages like R or C/C++.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience training, evaluating, or applying biological sequence models—specifically sequence-to-function models that learn and predict functional biology directly from raw DNA, RNA, or protein sequences.
  • Experience developing or applying single-cell genomic or transcriptomic models to translate biological heterogeneity into generalizable regulatory or epigenomic signatures.
  • Experience modeling cell-free DNA (cfDNA) signals specifically for early disease detection and diagnostic applications.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:
  • Own New Products financials: Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported
  • B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.
  • Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights.
  • Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.
  • Drive team standardization and reporting: Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.
  • Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.
  • Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.
What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.
  • B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.
  • Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.
  • Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.
  • Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.
  • Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.
  • Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.
  • Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.
  • Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.
Nice to have:
  • Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization
  • Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment
  • Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.
  • Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.
Success Factors

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

  • Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.
  • Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.
  • Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.
  • Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.
  • See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role:
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: Blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. The Lyra Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) program capitalizes on Lyra Care Therapy to supplement standard individual DBT and DBT skills groups with novel between-session DBT-relevant digital activities—activities that help promote skill generalization and integration into your clients’ daily lives. Lyra DBT clients also have 24/7 access to a team of licensed clinicians who have been trained in DBT skills coaching for around the clock support.

As a Lyra DBT Therapist, you’ll provide individual DBT and DBT skills groups via live video to adult clients. You’ll also assign DBT-relevant digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. Lyra's clients come from a multitude of backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.

Our therapists enjoy connecting with their colleagues who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend weekly consultation team meetings as well as one-on-one consultation meetings with an expert DBT team lead, co-lead DBT skills groups with other DBT providers, and attend robust trainings to enhance your clinical skills. You always have a team behind you if a crisis comes up. You’re never alone, even while working remotely in the US.

This role is a great fit if you’re a NY or MA-licensed DBT clinician who enjoys working with complex clients in a supportive, collaborative, and feedback rich environment. You may also find this role rewarding if:

- You are passionate about helping others improve their lives through skills-based interventions and work to understand your clients through a lens of compassion and curiosity.

- You enjoy evidence-based practice, continual learning, and professional improvement.

- You prefer to work within a collaborative team environment.

- You are accountable for your own outcomes and performance, and are willing to embrace challenges that others may shy away from.

Requirements

  • Unrestricted, active New York or Massachusetts license (able to work independently without supervision from a licensed supervisor) without current or pending disciplinary action

  • Any New York LMFT/LCSW licenses must have diagnostic privilege

  • Formal didactic training in DBT required (e.g., in-house training with consultation team, tape review, 1:1 supervision; Behavioral Tech; DBT Foundational Training; DBT Intensive Training)
