jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:
  • Own New Products financials: Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported
  • B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.
  • Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights.
  • Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.
  • Drive team standardization and reporting: Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.
  • Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.
  • Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.
What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.
  • B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.
  • Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.
  • Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.
  • Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.
  • Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.
  • Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.
  • Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.
  • Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.
Nice to have:
  • Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization
  • Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment
  • Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.
  • Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.
Success Factors

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

  • Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.
  • Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.
  • Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.
  • Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.
  • See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.
What you'll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly wellbeing stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking an experienced Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to support a federal government project. This role is responsible for overseeing information system security compliance, developing and maintaining cybersecurity policies and procedures, and ensuring alignment with Department of War (DoW) security requirements and applicable federal cybersecurity standards.

The ideal candidate possesses strong knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks, exceptional written documentation skills, and the ability to translate complex security requirements into clear, actionable processes and procedures. This individual must be comfortable working directly with government customers, independently managing security compliance activities, and collaborating with technical and program teams to ensure security requirements are effectively implemented.

Job Duties

  • Develop, document, implement, and maintain cybersecurity policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), security plans, and operational processes aligned with DoW directives and federal security requirements.
  • Oversee information system security compliance activities, ensuring adherence to the Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53, and applicable DoW cybersecurity policies.
  • Develop and maintain security authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), risk assessments, and supporting authorization artifacts.
  • Serve as a primary cybersecurity point of contact for government customers, providing security guidance, compliance updates, risk assessments, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), system administrators, engineers, and project leadership to implement and maintain required security controls.
  • Support Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities, continuous monitoring, security assessments, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking.
  • Evaluate existing security processes, identify gaps, and develop practical improvements to strengthen compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare clear, comprehensive security documentation, reports, briefings, and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Independently manage security compliance priorities, track deliverables, and proactively address risks or issues with minimal supervision.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in information systems security, cybersecurity compliance, information assurance, or related federal security roles.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance for DoW/DoD or other federal government information systems.
  • Strong knowledge of DoW/DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements, NIST SP 800-53 rev 5 security controls, and federal information security standards.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining cybersecurity policies, processes, SOPs, security plans, and compliance documentation.
  • Exceptional written communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate complex cybersecurity requirements into clear, actionable procedures.
  • Experience preparing or maintaining SSPs, POA&Ms, security assessment documentation, and ATO-related artifacts.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, including experience working directly with government stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, coordinate security activities, and ensure timely completion of compliance deliverables.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience using eMASS or similar security authorization and compliance management tools.
  • Professional cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CAP/CGRC, or Security+.
  • Active Secret security clearance required.
  • Ability to work remotely within the United States.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience serving as an ISSM or senior ISSO on a DoW/DoD program.
  • Familiarity with DoW/DoD cybersecurity directives, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and security control implementation requirements.
  • Familiarity with DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements.
  • Experience supporting security audits, inspections, vulnerability assessments, and remediation activities.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity governance frameworks, improving compliance processes, or standardizing security documentation across multiple systems.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $90,000-125,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.

Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

  • Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, & vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
  • Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10) federal holidays
  • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
  • Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, & company-sponsored industry certifications!
  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

jobs.excerpt: About Unconventional Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors.
jobs.description:
About Unconventional

Since 2022, AI has entered the mainstream, reshaping entire industries from education and software development to fundamental consumer behaviors. This revolution has created an unprecedented demand for computation - a demand that is now fundamentally limited by energy, not just in the datacenter, but at a global scale.

At Unconventional, our mission is to solve this. We are rethinking computing from the ground up to build a new foundation for AI that is 1000x more efficient. We're doing this by exploiting the rich physics of semiconductors, mapping neural networks directly to the device physics rather than relying on layers of inefficient abstraction.

The Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, you will be a foundational member of our small, multi-disciplinary R&D team. We are looking for 'first principles' thinkers who are excited to tackle the hardest, most ambiguous technical challenges at the intersection of AI, physics, and computer architecture. You will be responsible for driving invention, prototyping, and validation of the core components of our novel computing platform.

Your work will be fluid and could span from theoretical modeling and simulation to algorithm development, hardware/software co-design, or experimental validation in collaboration with other team members. We're hiring exceptional problem-solvers who can navigate deep uncertainty and help chart our technical roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • Exceptional technical ability in a quantitative field (e.g., Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or a related discipline). An MS/PhD or equivalent research/project experience is strongly preferred.
  • A "0-to-1" mindset. You have a demonstrated history of tackling complex, ambiguous R&D problems, often from a blank slate.
  • Deep curiosity. You are comfortable diving into new domains, whether it's semiconductor physics, machine learning theory, or systems-level design.
  • A creative and unconventional approach to problem-solving.

Core Technical Competencies

  • Analytic Foundations: Core competences in the analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems (ODEs, PDEs, SDEs), ideally with experience analyzing the stability, noise robustness, and capacity of such systems. Strong candidates are able to leverage the properties of (or impose constraints on) such systems to develop analytic insights.
  • Practical Eye: The ability to leverageanalytic insights to build practical tools – metrics, algorithmic optimizations, and automated analyses – that can be used to study dynamical systems. Strong candidates are comfortable navigating the tradeoff space between theoretic purity and practicality to realize useful tooling.
  • Programming Proficiency: Strong command of Python and expertise with using numeric computing and visualization libraries, such as numpy, scipy, and matplotlib. Experience with libraries geared toward analysis, such as computer algebra libraries (e.g., sympy) also recommended.
  • ML/AI Familiarity: Familiarity with dynamics-based ML model architectures, such as diffusion models and energy-based models, and general experience with ML model training flows. Experience with using high-level ML model frameworks, such as PyTorch and JAX.

jobs.excerpt: Mozilla Foundationis a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.
jobs.description:
Mozilla Foundationis a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!

Team

One of the ways we are deepening our commitment to building side by side with innovators is Mozilla Studio: where we find promising builders and ideas, select the ones worth backing, and help them become tools and technology actually used by people and institutions. It is where the critical step from promising idea to workable, sustainable tool happens.

Good public-interest technology often fails between prototype and first user, because commercial capital arrives on terms at odds with the mission, and grant capital rarely comes with the help a team needs on sustainment, supply, and operational excellence. Mozilla Studio, building on the work of our Incubator, helps to close that gap. It backs efforts early, gives teams what they need, and connects them to the deployers, buyers, and follow-on funders who help make these alternatives true defaults. Our goal is technology that lasts beyond our funding.

This newly created role of VP, Mozilla Studio will hold the responsibility of building and running the Studio. You'll start with an active portfolio, including our current AI initiatives, and keep that work moving without disruption while you set the Studio's direction.

This role reports directly to the CEO and partners closely with the Operations Team to steward the Studio's legal, compliance, financial, and logistical obligations, keeping handoffs clear so the Studio runs smoothly across the Foundation.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in Canada, Germany, the UK, or the US.

Job responsibilities

As the VP, Mozilla Studio, you will…

  • Take the helm of the Studio’s active portfolio, including our current AI initiatives. You’ll keep it moving while you build trusted relationships with the CEO, teams across the Foundation, and builders.
  • Assess each active bet rigorously to understand who it serves, what early signals it’s showing, and what it will take to reach its next stage.
  • Set the Studio's direction and criteria for what it backs, extends, stops, or declines, and decide how much support each team gets within our agreed investment timelines. Every decision ties back to technology people can use, held by teams that can stand on their own.
  • Hold every bet to a clear standard: a deployer or user named up front, with progress measured in adoption and impact rather than activity.
  • Pressure-test every commitment before capital moves to understand whether we can make a meaningful difference, and whether our risk capital can unblock something uniquely within our reach.
  • Balance early signals across the portfolio against bigger conviction bets. Make disciplined stop decisions at the right moments and document the rationale behind each.
  • Guide each team to a durable structure (a company, nonprofit, cooperative, mission entity, or commons project) with a working sustaining model and at least one named funder beyond us.
  • Build and lead a high-performing Studio team and a bench of talent calibrated to support each team's stage and timeline.
  • Set up clear and dependable handoffs with the Investment Committee and other Foundation teams, so the Studio works seamlessly across the organization and investment cycle.
  • Translate portfolio evidence into clear signals for leadership, the Board and our funders, with candor about what we expected, what happened, and where we fell short.
  • Make the Studio a place serious engineers and founders want to be, and a trusted source of vetted opportunities for deployers and co-funders.

Your Professional Profile

  • Proven track record building or leading a studio, incubator, lab, accelerator or early-stage founder program at a senior level, working hands-on with the teams you backed
  • Technical lens to engage engineers, open source and internet infrastructure, and can rigorously test the claims teams make
  • Deep, active network of deployers, buyers, co-funders and builders across sectors and regions, with the discernment to know which ideas merit their attention
  • Fluency with capital classes. Knowledge across grants, recoverable grants, PRI, and beyond
  • Experience with at least one model beyond venture equity, such as cooperatives or public-benefit companies
  • Comfort in making the hard calls; stopping bets and saying no
  • Experience building and leading high-performing teams, and drawing in borrowed talent such as residents and advisors
  • Demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation's mission and to an open, trustworthy internet
  • Flexibility to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard hours

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With:

  • Nonprofit governance and Board reporting
  • Fundraising and building funder relationships
  • Depth in one or more of Mozilla Foundation's focus areas
  • Helping teams get their technology adopted by public institutions or large organizations

How We Work

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role:

  • Move toward the hard thing. Stopping a bet, or turning down a builder you like, is part of this job. Name it early, explain your reasoning to the team directly, and raise concerns in the room rather than after it.
  • Stay curious and current. Keep close to what's moving in open source, internet infrastructure and the communities our tools are meant to serve. Bring what you learn back, and test your own conviction as hard as you test a team's claims.
  • Work in the open. Document why we backed, extended or stopped each bet so leadership, the Board and funders can follow the reasoning. Share portfolio progress while it's still in progress, not only once it's polished.
  • Focus and finish. A lean Studio can't back everything. Be clear about which bets get support and why, then see each one through to a sustainable form or a well-made stop.
  • Flex with purpose. A cooperative at month four needs something different from a commons project at year two. Adjust your support as teams and context change, without drifting from the mission or the timelines agreed on.
  • Lead with care. Hold builders to high standards while remembering they're people taking real risks. Talk directly with whoever can fix a problem, and keep enough lightness in the room that people can be human.

Salary and Benefits Information

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below.

  • Germany: €222,088.00 – €249,848.22
  • UK: £195,534.00 – £219,975.06
  • Canada: $383,400.00 – $431,323.65
  • US: $284,000 – $319,499

We also offer the following benefits:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Extended Sick Leave
  • Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement Plan contributions
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday
  • Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown
  • Wellness budget
  • Professional Development budget
  • Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves

Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation.

Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.

jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

The Digital Data Networks (DDN) Business Unit is seeking a highly skilled and driven PRINCIPAL R&D/PRODUCT DVL ENGINEER within the Advanced Development (AD) team. In this key technical role, you will be responsible for spearheading structural mechanics, thermal-mechanical coupling, and multi-physics modeling to rapidly screen, evaluate, and down-select next-generation high-speed interconnect technology concepts. You will tackle critical engineering challenges across switches, servers, data storage systems, and AI hardware platforms—pushing the boundaries of density, signal integrity, and mechanical reliability.

As a senior technical contributor in the DDN Advanced Development team, you will establish first-principles analytical models and high-fidelity simulations to generate decision-quality performance predictions. You will lead simulation-driven design trade-offs, drive model-to-test correlation, and partner closely with cross-functional teams including Signal Integrity, Mechanical Design, Product Management, and Front-Line Product Engineering (PDE/NPI). Additionally, you will play an instrumental role in shaping the team’s Advanced Simulation roadmap and maturing virtual prototyping methodologies.

Key qualifications include a proven track record of superior technical expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), advanced mechanical and thermal-mechanical modeling, and a passion for engineering innovation. You are expected to drive prediction-driven decision-making through rigorous model verification and validation (V&V), clearly communicate engineering trade-offs, and mentor engineering peers in best simulation practices.

Job Requirements

  • Lead the development, application, and continuous improvement of first-principles engineering analysis, FEA modeling, and multi-physics simulation to down-select solution concepts.
  • Build first principles and reduced-order mechanical/thermal models to quickly screen early architectures and identify scaling limits.
  • Execute advanced high-fidelity non-linear structural and thermal-mechanical simulations (e.g., elastoplastic deformation, creep, stress relaxation, thermal expansion/CTE mismatch, contact mechanics, and insertion/retention force).
  • Perform sensitivity studies, tolerance stack-ups, and statistical variation analyses to understand assembly robustness, coplanarity, and risk early in the product lifecycle.
  • Partner with design engineers to define simulation-ready geometry, boundary conditions, and loading scenarios supported by GD&T interpretation.
  • Handle complex FEA models involving hundreds of components in high-speed interconnect systems to build high-fidelity simulation models. Simplify models as appropriate to balance simulation accuracy, computational efficiency, and delivery timelines.
  • Deliver comprehensive simulation reports, actionable design recommendations, and technical presentations to drive executive and architectural down-selection.
  • Define and lead physical prototype test plans; actively partner with test labs to execute model verification and validation (V&V), correlate experimental data with simulation results, and calibrate constitutive material models.
  • Collaborate with PDE/NPI teams to ensure smooth handoff of validated simulation models, design guidelines, and predictive methodologies for commercialization.
  • Champion simulation process automation, script development, and methodology standardization across the engineering group.
  • Maintain deep awareness of cutting-edge simulation tools, high-performance computing (HPC/Cloud), advanced material systems, and emerging packaging/interconnect technologies.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or related field; Master’s Degree or Ph.D. strongly preferred.
  • Generally requires 8–10+ years of progressive engineering experience in high-fidelity FEA and structural/thermal-mechanical analysis in high-tech electromechanical products, connectors, high-speed interconnects, or electronic packaging.
  • Recognized technical expert in commercial FEA platforms (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, preferred) with demonstrated mastery in non-linear materials, complex contact interfaces, dynamic response, and thermal-stress coupling.
  • Strong practical experience in test correlation and model calibration (e.g., strain gauge testing, displacement/force measurement, thermal warpage profiling).
  • Deep understanding of high-speed interconnect architecture, micro-contact physics, spring pin design, socket/cable assemblies, and CTE management in AI/compute hardware environments.
  • Working knowledge of 3D CAD platforms (Creo and SpaceClaim preferred) for geometric defeaturing, parameterization, and simulation prep.
  • Experience with cloud/HPC simulation environments (e.g., Rescale) and automation scripting (Python, MATLAB) is a plus.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, global R&D environment, translating complex technical findings into actionable engineering guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Competencies

  • Values: Integrity, Accountability, Teamwork, Innovation
  • Technical Leadership & Influence (Individual Contributor track)
  • Problem Solving & Analytical Rigor

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $158,200 – 197,800 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
• Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.

We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.

Job Title: Senior UX Researcher & Design (Remote)

Job Location: Wayne, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Senior UX Researcher & Designer

About IQVIA

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services to the life sciences and healthcare industries. Through the integration of healthcare data, domain expertise, transformative technology, and AI-driven innovation, IQVIA helps customers accelerate the development and commercialization of medical treatments, improve patient outcomes, and drive healthcare forward.

Within IQVIA's Applied Data Science Center, multidisciplinary teams work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, clinical research, data science, and product development to create innovative solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and patient experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

Role Summary

IQVIA is seeking a Senior UX Researcher & Designer to lead end-to-end user experience research and design initiatives for AI-enabled clinical technology solutions within the Applied Data Science Center.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role requiring a practitioner who can operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across product, engineering, data science, clinical, and business teams. The successful candidate will drive evidence-based, user-centered design practices that enable the delivery of intuitive, trusted, and scalable product experiences.

The role will contribute to emerging Tiny Teams operating within the IQVIA Agentic Operating Model, a derivation of the Delta-Echo/FDE process. The successful candidate will help translate complex clinical, operational, and AI-assisted workflows into meaningful digital experiences that improve user adoption, efficiency, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead UX research and design activities throughout the product lifecycle, including discovery, problem framing, research planning, synthesis, ideation, prototyping, validation, delivery, and continuous improvement.
  • Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research to understand user needs, behaviors, workflows, pain points, and decision-making contexts.
  • Translate research findings into actionable insights, product recommendations, design direction, and requirements that support business, technical, and user objectives.
  • Design and evaluate user experiences for AI-enabled products, including Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications, agentic systems, intelligent automation workflows, and human-in-the-loop decision-support solutions.
  • Create and maintain UX artifacts, including personas, journey maps, service blueprints, workflow models, wireframes, prototypes, usability reports, and design specifications.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, clinicians, and business stakeholders to align priorities and drive user-centered decision-making.
  • Operate effectively within small, agile Tiny Teams, contributing to rapid experimentation, iterative delivery, measurement, and continuous learning.
  • Provide leadership in ambiguous environments by facilitating discussions, driving clarity, and influencing product direction through data and research-driven insights.
  • Mentor UX professionals and cross-functional team members by promoting best practices in research, design thinking, usability, validation, and collaboration.
  • Advocate for accessibility, usability, ethical AI principles, and human-centered design across all stages of product development.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Design, Cognitive Science, Human Factors, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in UX research, product design, usability evaluation, and user-centered design for complex digital products.
  • Proven ability to independently lead end-to-end UX initiatives from discovery through implementation and ongoing optimization.
  • Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, workflow analysis, and research synthesis.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, wireframing, prototyping, visual communication, and design systems.
  • Experience partnering with multidisciplinary teams across product management, software engineering, data science, clinical operations, and business functions.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and storytelling capabilities with the ability to influence decisions through evidence-based recommendations.
  • Proficiency with modern UX and AI-enabled productivity tools, including Figma, FigJam, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, AI-assisted research synthesis platforms, and related technologies.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for understanding user behavior and improving product outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing, researching, or evaluating AI-enabled products, LLM-powered workflows, agentic systems, intelligent automation solutions, or decision-support applications.
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, biotech, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with agentic operating models, rapid experimentation frameworks, systems thinking, and AI-assisted product development practices.
  • Experience designing enterprise software, analytics platforms, data visualization products, or operational workflow applications.
  • Experience mentoring UX practitioners and helping cross-functional teams mature research, design, and validation capabilities.
  • Advanced training, certification, or specialization in UX research, human factors, product design, AI product development, service design, or related disciplines.
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup-like environments or small cross-functional teams.

Key Competencies

  • End-to-End UX Leadership
  • Human-Centered Research & Design
  • Strategic Problem Framing
  • Independent Judgment & Decision-Making
  • Ambiguity Management
  • Evidence-Based Product Thinking
  • AI Fluency & Responsible AI Mindset
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence
  • Executive-Level Communication & Storytelling
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation
  • Mentorship & Team Development
  • Outcome-Oriented Execution
  • Design Thinking & Systems Thinking
  • Adaptability in Rapidly Evolving Environments

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources and building rewarding careers along the way.


The Opportunity

Veralto (www.veralto.com / NYSE: VLTO) is a global leader in essential technology solutions, comprising a portfolio of international businesses. We’re big enough to offer real resources and global reach, and focused enough that what you do here genuinely matters.


The Director, Digital Program Management & AI Enablement is a remote role based in the United States and reports directly to the Senior Vice President and Chief Digital and Information Officer (CDIO). The jobholder will 1) bring consistent program management discipline and consolidated executive visibility to the enterprise’s major digital and ERP programs; 2) build and scale the standard work, training, and governance that move AI from isolated pilots to measurable value across Veralto’s operating companies and corporate functions; and 3) partner with Procurement to capture scale synergies across software, engineering, and talent.


This position begins as an individual-contributor leadership role, with the opportunity to build a team as the mandate grows. It collaborates widely across an expanding, diverse group of operating companies and offers stimulating challenges, personal growth, and the opportunity to build something substantial.


Key Responsibilities

Digital Program Management & Executive Reporting

  • Provide program management oversight and independent evaluation of the multiple ERP programs underway across operating companies, assessing scope, timeline, budget, risk, and business outcomes.
  • Consolidate program status, risks, and financials into clear, executive-ready reporting, including materials for Board of Directors and senior leadership meetings.
  • Define and roll out program management standard work, templates, governance structures, and reporting cadences, anchored in best practices and the Veralto Enterprise System (VES).
  • Establish intake, prioritization, and stage-gate processes for enterprise digital initiatives; coach program and project leaders across the operating companies on their use.
  • Hold programs and external consulting firms and systems integrators accountable for commitments, quality, and measurable outcomes; coordinate escalation and remediation as needed.

AI Enablement & Workflow Transformation

  • Develop and deploy standard work for AI training, so that associates across operating companies and corporate functions build practical, role-relevant AI capability.
  • Create repeatable playbooks for AI deployment, including use case selection, data readiness, risk and governance review, change management, and scale-up.
  • Build and maintain an enterprise view of AI use cases across operating companies, tracking status, owners, adoption, and realized value, and use it to reduce duplication and identify opportunities to scale.
  • Partner with Human Resources to drive the same enablement, deployment, and tracking approach for HR use cases and for workforce AI skill development.
  • Lead the transformation of selected business workflows into AI-enabled workflows, applying Lean thinking to redesign the process rather than automate the waste.
  • Share leading practices from the operating companies and from the external market, and connect teams working on similar problemsware, engineering tools and services, and technology talent.
  • Support vendor rationalization, enterprise agreements, and renewal strategy, using program and use case data to inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track synergy commitments and report realized savings and avoided cost to the CDIO and functional partners.

Leadership & Influence

  • Drive alignment and accountability across business, IT, operations, finance, and external partners without direct authority.
  • Support KPI development and operating rhythms that give leaders a single, trustworthy picture of digital and AI execution.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Advanced degree or MBA preferred.
  • 12-15+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or transformation initiatives, ideally across a decentralized or multi-business organization.
  • Strong engineering and technology background, with hands-on understanding of AI, including generative and agentic AI, and how it moves from experiment to production value.
  • Experience delivering this type of work in an innovation setting, such as an innovation group, new ventures team, or technology incubator.
  • Strong understanding of Lean principles and continuous improvement, with working knowledge of the Veralto Enterprise System (VES) or a comparable Lean operating system such as the Danaher Business System.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing program governance, standard work, and executive reporting.
  • Executive-level communication, diplomacy, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to drive execution and accountability across stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-evolving environment and dealing with ambiguity.
  • Ability to undertake 25-30% travel, including to Veralto headquarters and operating company sites.
  • Must reside in the United States.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Oversight or evaluation of large-scale ERP programs, including work with consulting firms or systems integrators.

  • Partnering with Procurement on software or technology category strategy.

jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role overview

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.

In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.

You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.

Responsibilities

Security Tool Rollout

  • Take key part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company
  • Evaluate tools and present recommendations to the CTO and IT Director
  • Apply security baselines across tools and devices

Identity & Access Management

  • Own the administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA and integrations with our tools
  • Manage access to new software and AI tools through Okta
  • Run regular access reviews and fix permissions that don’t match current roles

Tool Administration

  • Administer Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp and AI assistant tools, including users, permissions and security settings
  • Track licences and flag unused or underused accounts
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of tools, accounts and admin roles

Automation

  • Automate onboarding so new joiners get the right access on day one
  • Automate offboarding so leavers lose access promptly and their data is handled correctly
  • Build integrations and workflows between tools using automation platforms or scripting

Security Monitoring & Support

  • Monitor security alerts, sign-in activity and admin logs, and act on issues
  • Work with our security and DevOps colleagues on infrastructure hardening
  • Handle first-line access requests and support tickets from colleagues
  • Investigate incidents, then record causes and fixes

Documentation

  • Document every tool, automation and process so others can understand and run it
  • Write clear guides for colleagues on access and security practices
  • Share regular progress updates and agree priorities with your manager

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering tools for organisations of 50+ people
  • Hands-on experience administering Okta (or equivalent IAM solution) and Google Workspace
  • A track record of driving IT or security initiatives, not only handling tickets
  • Willingness to handle requests from the team, helping keep tools and infrastructure running smoothly

Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of identity and access management, including SSO, MFA and role-based access
  • Working knowledge of device management and endpoint protection
  • Ability to build workflows with automation platforms, APIs or scripting
  • Understanding of security good practice for SaaS tools and BYOD environments
  • Cybersecurity experience is a strong plus
  • An engineering degree is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

  • Takes ownership and works independently in a less structured environment
  • Coachable and open to feedback
  • Explains technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Organised, prioritises well and follows through
  • Collaborative and low-ego team player

What we offer

  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid Vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff.

  • Provide strategic updates on clients’ performance to SailPoint Senior Management. Provide regular status updates to account teams and Sales Managers

  • Ability to communicate technical details to a non-technical audience. Ability to foster credibility with a technical audience

jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre de l’évolution d’un environnement CRM centré sur Salesforce Marketing Cloud, le rôle consiste à reprendre la maintenance et à assurer le développement continu de la plateforme.

Objectifs de la mission

Garantir la stabilité, l’évolutivité et les performances des campagnes marketing digitales, tout en développant de nouveaux parcours clients, en optimisant les traitements de données et en assurant l’intégration avec l’écosystème Salesforce.

Responsabilités principales

  • Assurer la maintenance évolutive et corrective de la plateforme Marketing Cloud.
  • Concevoir, développer et mettre en œuvre des parcours clients personnalisés.
  • Créer des requêtes, des scripts, des composants dynamiques et des automatisations complexes.
  • Optimiser les campagnes sur la base de leurs performances et des retours utilisateurs.
  • Contribuer à l’intégration et à la fiabilité des flux de données avec les autres composants de l’écosystème Salesforce.

La personne rejoindra une équipe pluridisciplinaire et travaillera de manière collaborative, avec une attention portée à la qualité, à la performance et à l’expérience client.

Soft skills attendus

  • Travail en équipe : collaborer étroitement avec les équipes CRM et marketing.
  • Adaptabilité : s’intégrer rapidement dans un environnement structuré et en évolution constante.
  • Curiosité technique : proposer de nouvelles solutions et explorer de bonnes pratiques de manière autonome.
  • Rigueur : produire un code propre, documenté, performant et facile à maintenir.

Compétences techniques indispensables

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud : maîtriser Email Studio, Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder et Cloud Pages.
  • SQL avancé : gérer et manipuler des Data Extensions complexes.
  • Développement front-end : utiliser HTML et CSS pour créer des emails responsives et dynamiques.
  • Scripting : maîtriser AMPscript et SSJS pour la personnalisation et l’automatisation des campagnes.
  • JavaScript : développer des fonctionnalités pour les Cloud Pages et des traitements personnalisés.
  • Connaître MC Connect ainsi que la gestion des Data Extensions synchronisées.
  • Connaître le SDK Mobile pour l’intégration avec des applications mobiles Android et iOS.
  • Maîtriser le développement Salesforce Marketing Cloud et les différents composants de la plateforme.

Salesforce Sales Cloud

  • Bonne connaissance des objets standards et personnalisés.
  • Capacité à gérer les flux, les déclencheurs, les flows et l’intégration des données via API ou batch.

Développement front-end des emails

  • Très bonne maîtrise de HTML et CSS pour le développement d’emails responsives.
  • Compréhension des contraintes de rendu entre les différents clients de messagerie, notamment pour le Dark Mode et la compatibilité.

Connaissances complémentaires attendues

  • Bonne compréhension de Salesforce Core, notamment des échanges de données entre systèmes.
  • Expérience dans l’utilisation et l’optimisation d’Automation Studio et de Journey Builder.
  • Bonne maîtrise des API Marketing Cloud pour les intégrations de données externes.

Tâches à réaliser plus en détail

  • Définir les spécifications techniques sur la base des besoins métiers.
  • Développer les modules techniques et implémenter les user stories.
  • Concevoir et implémenter des journeys complexes dans Journey Builder, avec SQL, ciblages et triggers.
  • Créer et optimiser des templates d’emails HTML et CSS compatibles avec les différents clients de messagerie, y compris le Dark Mode.
  • Intégrer de nouvelles sources de données dans Sales Cloud.
  • Implémenter de nouveaux modèles de consentement opt-in et opt-out conformes au RGPD.
  • Auditer et améliorer la synchronisation entre Sales Cloud et Marketing Cloud.
  • Élaborer et exécuter des tests unitaires et d’intégration.
  • Assurer le support des tests E2E, SIT et UAT.
  • Gérer les déploiements et le release management.
  • Corriger les anomalies détectées pendant les campagnes de test.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique liée aux développements.

📝 Votre profil

  • Expérience en tant que Senior CRM Developer.
  • Maîtrise de Salesforce Marketing Cloud, notamment Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio et Cloud Pages.
  • Maîtrise avancée de SQL, AMPscript, SSJS et JavaScript.
  • Très bonne maîtrise de HTML et CSS pour les emails responsives.
  • Connaissance de Salesforce Sales Cloud, de ses objets standards et personnalisés, ainsi que des flux et intégrations de données.
  • La connaissance du néerlandais ou du français, ainsi que de l’anglais, est requise.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

jobs.description:
About the job

We are looking for a sales-oriented Alliance & Channel Professional with experience and expertise in cybersecurity to lead, expand, and manage Onapsis’ Global Systems Integrator (GSI) partner ecosystem across EMEA. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building, driving, and scaling joint go-to-market strategies with top-tier GSIs and global consulting firms, specifically Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, Capgemini, IBM.

In this role, you will be responsible for shaping our EMEA GSI alliance as a major commercial growth engine - translating partner relationships into co-sell pipeline, deal velocity, and measurable revenue contribution across European markets. The Director, Alliances EMEA (GSI) will work closely with Onapsis field sales teams, regional leadership, and partner practice leads to align partner-led activities to the company’s strategic goals.

What you will be doing, your legacy:

  • Lead and coordinate all commercial, executive, and business development aspects of Onapsis’ strategic GSI alliance partners across EMEA (Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, CAPGemini, IBM), facilitating joint planning and aligning resources internally and externally.
  • Build a portfolio of joint solution offerings and repeatable use cases with GSI partners, embedding Onapsis into partner-led SAP digital transformation practices (S/4HANA migrations, RISE with SAP) and driving GTM execution.
  • Drive and manage partner-sourced and partner-influenced co-sell pipelines with GSI partners and Onapsis field sales teams, tracked and managed through Salesforce CRM.
  • Enable partner-led implementation and managed services delivery models (MSSP / QuickStart packages), maximizing GSI service revenue opportunities around Onapsis platform deployments.
  • Coordinate and execute joint marketing initiatives, executive roundtables, and ABM campaigns with GSI partner marketing teams across target EMEA regions.
  • Contract negotiations

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, business development, or alliance management at a cybersecurity or enterprise software company, with at least 5+ years directly managing GSIs (Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, CAPGemini, IBM) across EMEA.
  • Deep existing network and executive relationships within the cybersecurity and SAP practices of major GSIs across key EMEA markets (UK&I, DACH, France, Nordics).
  • Proven track record of building joint GTM playbooks and driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in co-sell models.
  • Expertise and acumen in forging initiatives, go-to-market and pipeline development plans with business partners.
  • Experience in selling in an overlay role in conjunction with field sales teams
  • Familiarity with the SAP ecosystem (S/4HANA migrations, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP) and partner-led services delivery frameworks.
  • Past relationships with top national and regional VARs
  • Demonstrated success in exceeding revenue targets with partners
  • Exceptional communication skills (both verbal and written). Able to position technical solutions as business value to ‘owners’ of Security Services offering portfolio in partner organizations.
  • Experience with Solution Selling/Consultative Selling methodologies.
  • Delivery of comprehensive business plans with a multi-year outlook.
  • Strong analytical competencies and ability to communicate and present at an executive level.
  • Self-disciplined team player that can work in a fast-paced dynamic start-up environment remotely.
  • B.S. or equivalent experience. Masters or MBA a plus.

Location: Remote in Germany.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Compensation & Perks: An attractive salary package and extensive lifestyle benefits, including JobRad, Focus Fridays, and more.
  • Ultimate Flexibility & Balance: 30 days of paid vacation, flexible working hours, and the ability to work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • Family-First Support: Dedicated backing for parents, including subsidized childcare (up to primary school age) and 5 fully paid sick days per child.
  • Continuous Growth & Development: A tailored onboarding experience with a dedicated buddy program, alongside comprehensive professional training and English language courses.
  • Empowering Culture: High autonomy and creative freedom within a solution-oriented environment, featuring flat hierarchies, respectful communication, and an innovative workplace.

About Onapsis:

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Heidelberg, Germany and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

For more information, connect with Onapsis on LinkedIn or visit.

Job Title: Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO,

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility)


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility) coordinates the integration of privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements across Amgen’s global web experiences. The role translates approved standards and expert guidance into practical requirements, reusable capabilities, risk-based readiness practices, and ongoing monitoring throughout the digital lifecycle. It partners with Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility, business, and technology teams; formal legal interpretations and policy decisions remain with the appropriate subject matter owners.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Privacy, Legal, GEO and Accessibility Standards: Coordinate the application of global privacy regulations, consent requirements, GEO playbook, accessibility standards, legal content, disclosures, and data collection and retention policies across digital properties and markets.
  • Requirements across the Lifecycle: Work with business, design, and technology teams to incorporate privacy, legal, GEO and accessibility requirements into strategy, experience design, requirements, development acceptance criteria, platform components, templates, and forms.
  • Consent, Data, and Third-Party Governance: Support cookie and tracker governance, consent and preference experiences, data minimization, transparent collection and use, retention requirements, vendor privacy compliance, and data-processing obligations.
  • Risk-Based Readiness and Remediation: Coordinate practical, risk-based readiness reviews across web experiences. Identify gaps and affected markets or properties, document accountable owners and timelines, and track remediation without treating governance as a final approval checkpoint.
  • Monitoring, Audit, and Regulatory Change: Support compliance and consent monitoring, audit evidence, regulatory change management, issue escalation, and remediation in partnership with Privacy, Legal, Accessibility, and technology stakeholders.
  • Lifecycle Controls and Measures: Coordinate privacy and legal controls through ongoing changes and retirement, including data retention or deletion, tracker removal, vendor termination, and regulatory records. Track compliance health, exceptions, remediation aging, privacy incidents, and consent effectiveness.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. For the Manager, Global Web Ecosystem Governance Lead (Privacy, Legal, GEO, Accessibility), we seek a professional with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

Or

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

Or

Associate’s degree and 8 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience

Or

High school diploma / GED and 10 years of digital governance, web ecosystem, privacy, legal, GEO, accessibility, cybersecurity, identity and access management, or related digital technology experience


Preferred Experience:

  • Privacy, GEO and Consent Governance: Experience supporting privacy operations, consent management, cookie, and GEO governance, data minimization, retention, and global digital experiences.
  • Accessibility and Legal Content: Experience coordinating accessibility requirements and legal content such as privacy notices, disclosures, and terms across websites or digital products.
  • Digital Delivery Integration: Success incorporating governance requirements into user experience, requirements, development, reusable components, forms, launch readiness, and ongoing operations.
  • Regulatory and Vendor Readiness: Experience supporting regulatory change management, audit readiness, third-party privacy reviews, data-processing requirements, and remediation in a regulated environment.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to work effectively with Privacy, Legal, Accessibility, GEO, business, vendor, and technology teams and explain requirements in clear, actionable language.
  • Monitoring and Improvement: Experience tracking compliance health, exceptions, remediation, incidents, or consent performance and using findings to improve processes.

Preferred Competencies:

  • Leadership and Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across global and local teams and helps partners resolve issues with clear ownership.
  • Problem-Solving and Quality Focus: Applies care and sound judgment when identifying gaps, documenting evidence, and coordinating practical remediation.
  • Adaptability and Growth Mindset: Responds constructively to evolving regulations, GEO, accessibility needs, technologies, and business priorities.

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan comprising health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities including:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns
  • Flexible work models, including remote work arrangements, where possible.

Apply now

for a career that defies imagination

Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.
