jobs.description:
Remote24-32 uur€5.294 - €6.918 per maandDigitale PoliOnline

Online behandelen, zonder afstand te voelen.
Bij de Digitale poli bied je specialistische GGZ volledig online. Juist doordat behandeling plaatsvindt in de eigen leefomgeving van de cliënt en je verschillende digitale contactvormen combineert, kun je dichtbij zijn op de momenten die ertoe doen.

Dit maakt werken als GZ-psycholoog bij GGZ Oost Brabant bijzonder

  • Je behandelt complexe problematiek binnen de specialistische GGZ volledig digitaal

  • Je combineert beeldbellen met e-health, online opdrachten en intensief contact gedurende het behandeltraject

  • Je behandelt cliënten in hun eigen leefomgeving, daar waar verandering ook daadwerkelijk plaatsvindt

  • Je werkt zowel individueel als met groepen, waaronder SFT (schematherapie)

  • Je werkt met verschillende evidence-based behandelmethodieken en verricht waar nodig diagnostiek

  • Je werkt op het snijvlak van vakinhoud, herstelgerichte zorg en digitale innovatie

  • Je denkt mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van specialistische digitale GGZ

  • Wil je digitaal én op locatie behandelen? Dan kun je deze functie combineren met werken binnen een reguliere poli

Je kunt rekenen op

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 5.294,- en € 6.918,- o.b.v. 36 uur (cao GGZ, FWG 65)

  • Tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten woon-werkverkeer. Voor dienstreizen ontvang je € 0,50 per kilometer!

  • Een volledige 13e maand (8,33% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en jaarlijks €1000 balansbudget om in te zetten voor opleiden, extra verlof of extra salaris.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PFZW (Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn), FiscFree, TicketsforGood en meer!

  • Lees hier meer over onze aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Jouw rol als GZ-Psycholoog

Als GZ-psycholoog binnen de Digitale poli behandel je volwassenen met complexe problematiek op het gebied van onder andere angst, stemming, dwang, trauma en persoonlijkheid.

Digitale behandeling betekent bij ons niet dat je simpelweg hetzelfde gesprek via een beeldscherm voert. Je combineert videogesprekken met online opdrachten en e-health en stemt de behandeling af op wat jouw cliënt nodig heeft. Doordat cliënten vanuit hun eigen omgeving aan hun herstel werken, krijg je zicht op wat daar speelt en kunnen zij nieuw gedrag direct toepassen waar de verandering moet plaatsvinden.

Je voert intake, diagnostiek en behandeling uit en maakt inhoudelijke keuzes over het behandeltraject. Daarbij werk je onder andere met CGT en EMDR en, afhankelijk van jouw expertise en de hulpvraag, met behandelvormen zoals schematherapie, ACT, GIT-PD, IE of IMRS. Naast individuele behandeling werk je ook met groepen, waaronder SFT (schematherapie).

Jouw taken op een rij

  • Je voert intake, diagnostiek en psychologische behandeling uit

  • Je behandelt cliënten met complexe problematiek binnen de specialistische GGZ

  • Je zet verschillende digitale behandelvormen bewust naast elkaar in

  • Je ondersteunt cliënten bij het versterken van eigen regie, herstel en kwaliteit van leven

  • Je betrekt waar passend naasten en de leefomgeving bij de behandeling

  • Je volgt de voortgang van het behandeltraject en stuurt waar nodig bij

  • Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines binnen de Digitale poli

  • Je schakelt met collega's op locatie wanneer aanvullende diagnostiek of ondersteuning nodig is

  • Je draagt vanuit jouw vakinhoud bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandeling

Je werkt zelfstandig en hebt veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid, maar staat niet alleen. Je werkt intensief samen binnen een multidisciplinair behandelteam.

Samen sterk, maak kennis met de Digitale poli

De Digitale poli is volop in ontwikkeling en richt zich op cliënten met complexe angst-, stemmings-, trauma- en persoonlijkheidsproblematiek binnen het verzorgingsgebied van GGZ Oost Brabant.

Hier bouwen we aan een andere manier van behandelen: toegankelijk, flexibel en zoveel mogelijk verweven met het dagelijks leven van de cliënt. We werken vanuit het gedachtegoed vanpositieve gezondheid, combineren evidence-based behandelen met een transdiagnostische benadering en zetten digitale mogelijkheden bewust in om herstel en eigen regie te versterken.

Dat betekent dat we niet simpelweg bestaande zorg online aanbieden, maar samen onderzoeken hoe digitale behandeling écht van meerwaarde kan zijn. Wat werkt goed, wat kan slimmer en wat vraagt juist om een andere aanpak?

Als GZ-psycholoog krijg je de ruimte om daarin mee te bouwen. Met jouw vakinhoudelijke kennis draag je niet alleen bij aan goede behandeling van cliënten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale specialistische GGZ binnen GGZ Oost Brabant én daarbuiten.

“Het mooie is dat we hier niet alleen online behandelen, maar echt opnieuw kijken naar hoe behandeling het beste kan werken. Als GZ-psycholoog krijg je veel ruimte om daar inhoudelijk over mee te denken.”
– GZ-psycholoog Digitale poli

Dit breng je mee

  • Je bent BIG-geregistreerd als GZ-psycholoog

  • Je hebt ervaring met diagnostiek en behandeling binnen de specialistische GGZ, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van angst en stemming, trauma of persoonlijkheidsproblematiek

  • Je hebt kennis van CGT en EMDR; ervaring met bijvoorbeeld schematherapie is een pre

  • Je hebt affiniteit met digitale zorg en bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe je online behandeling inhoudelijk optimaal kunt inzetten. Ervaring met online behandelen is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste

  • Je woont in Nederland

  • Idealiter ben je beschikbaar op maandag, woensdag en vrijdag. Dit is onze voorkeur; we kijken graag samen wat binnen jouw beschikbaarheid en het aantal uren passend is

Wil je het online behandelen combineren met werken op locatie? Ook een combinatie met een reguliere poli behoort tot de mogelijkheden.

Zo werk jij: Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de moed om de juiste keuzes te maken. Met je daadkracht bereik je resultaten. En je bent steeds verbindend, omdat we het samen doen. Je schakelt makkelijk, luistert goed en weet ook via een beeldscherm een sterke behandelrelatie op te bouwen.

Heb je interesse of wil je meer weten?

Zolang deze vacature online staat, kun je reageren. We gaan doorlopend in gesprek met geschikte kandidaten.

Wil je eerst even sparren of kennismaken? Je bent welkom voor een (virtueel) gesprek om een beter beeld te krijgen van het werk.

Functie omschrijving

Als Senior External Manufacturing Quality Lead sta je in voor de kwaliteitsopvolging van externe laboratoria en productiepartners binnen een internationale farmaceutische omgeving. Je volgt er de release- en stabiliteitstesten voor biologische geneesmiddelen op en werkt daarvoor samen met Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs en Manufacturing Sciences & Technology.

Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, GMP-compliance en leverbetrouwbaarheid binnen een internationale supply chain. Zo help je garanderen dat de producten aan de farmaceutische vereisten voldoen en tijdig beschikbaar zijn voor patiënten wereldwijd.

Je verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je beheert externe laboratoria en productiepartners voor kwaliteitsactiviteiten.
  • Je coördineert stabiliteitsprogramma's en release testing voor meerdere producten.
  • Je leidt afwijkingen, CAPA's, change controls en initiatieven voor kwaliteitsverbetering.
  • Je ondersteunt method transfers, kwalificaties en PPQ-projecten.
  • Je stelt stabiliteitsprotocollen, rapporten en andere kwaliteitsdocumentatie op.
  • Je bewaakt de beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van reagentia, referentiestandaarden en testmaterialen.
  • Je werkt samen met internationale stakeholders rond GMP-compliance en de supply chain.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je communiceert vlot met verschillende stakeholders en kunt prioriteiten bepalen in een complexe omgeving. Dankzij je analytische ingesteldheid behoud je het overzicht over meerdere projecten. Je bouwt bovendien gemakkelijk vertrouwen op binnen een internationale matrixorganisatie.

Hard skills

  • Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een wetenschappelijke richting.
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een farmaceutische of biotechomgeving.
  • Je beschikt over minstens 3 jaar ervaring in een Quality-gerelateerde functie.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Quality Control (QC) en met externe partners, waaronder labo's.
  • Je hebt kennis van FDA, EMA, GMP, deviations, CAPA en change control.
  • Je hebt een professionele kennis van het Engels.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

Job Summary

The Principal Technologist serves as a senior technical leader responsible for designing, engineering, and implementing innovative technology solutions across Amtrak's enterprise environment. The role combines deep technical expertise with a strong focus on innovation, automation, problem prevention, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

This position partners with Digital Technology teams and Amtrak business organizations to understand current processes, identify technology and end-user experience gaps, and develop solutions that improve how work is performed. jobs.excerpt: Build your Career at Cooper Equipment Rentals Please note, to be considered for this position applicants should currently be residing in Canada and legally entitled to work.
jobs.description:
Build your Career at Cooper Equipment Rentals

Please note, to be considered for this position applicants should currently be residing in Canada and legally entitled to work.

Why Work with Us? Perks!


  • Flexible remote work arrangement in Canada, with competitive compensation (base + bonus), benefits & RRSP match.
  • Own analytics solutions end to end, from business problem through semantic model to the reports executives and branch leaders use every day, on an enterprise Fabric platform that is already in production.
  • Work the way analytics will be done from here on: AI will handle the bulk of the implementation, and your time will go to modelling judgement, business understanding, and making sure what ships is right and clear.
  • Join a data team that values rigour and modern tooling over report factories.

Location: Canada (Remote)


About Us

Cooper Equipment Rentals is Canada’s leading, Canadian-owned rental company, offering a wide range of compact, aerial, and heavy construction and industrial equipment to contractors nationwide. With over 85 branches and a commitment to safety, reliability, and exceptional service, we’re dedicated to supporting our clients’ success on every jobsite.

Our enterprise analytics platform runs on Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, Bronze/Silver/Gold Lakehouses, Direct Lake semantic models, and a shared semantic layer that supports enterprise reporting and AI-assisted analytics across the business.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Analytics Solutions Lead to design and own the semantic models and Power BI solutions that the business runs on. This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role with end-to-end ownership of analytics solutions; it is not a people-management position.


AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT will write most of the DAX, SQL, and PySpark on our platform. The value you bring is knowing what to build and whether what was built is right: defining the model, the grain, the measures, and the business rules precisely enough that the solution can be generated quickly, then validating the result from three angles. Does it match how the business actually works and the decision it is meant to support? Does the report present it clearly, so a branch manager or executive can read it correctly at a glance? And is it technically sound, so a generated measure behaves correctly under every filter context it will meet? You should be able to look at a generated solution and answer all three, and fix it when the answer is no.


You will work directly with stakeholders to understand the decisions they need to make, shape the analytical approach, and deliver solutions across lakehouse transformation, semantic modelling, and Power BI reporting on a Direct Lake platform that is already in production.


Key Responsibilities


  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand their problems and decision needs, and translate them into well-defined measures, dimensions, business rules, and report designs.
  • Design and own enterprise semantic models on Direct Lake, including star-schema and grain decisions, relationship design, and reusable measure definitions aligned to clear business definitions.
  • Direct AI tools to generate, refactor, document, and test DAX, SQL, and PySpark, supplying the context and requirements they need and critically validating everything they produce before it reaches production.
  • Validate every solution against the business before release: reconcile results to known figures and source systems, test edge cases and business rules with stakeholders, and confirm the numbers mean what users will assume they mean.
  • Own the visual quality of reports: choose the right visuals and layouts for the decision at hand, apply consistent design conventions, and review reports as the end user will experience them, not just as the model behind them.
  • Diagnose and resolve incorrect results, performance problems, and usability issues in semantic models and reports, including those introduced by AI-generated implementations.
  • Build and investigate analytical datasets in Fabric notebooks using SQL and PySpark, following the Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion pattern in partnership with data engineering.
  • Design and test row-level security so that models remain correct and performant for every audience.
  • Work within the team’s source-controlled development and deployment practices for Power BI and Fabric content.
  • Raise standards for solution design, semantic modelling, documentation, and testing across the analytics function.

Qualifications & Skills


  • 5+ years delivering enterprise Power BI solutions, with deep hands-on experience designing and maintaining semantic models rather than only authoring reports against existing ones.
  • Strong DAX understanding. You may no longer write most of it by hand, but you can read it fluently, reason about filter context and context transition, and explain why a measure returns the number it does.
  • Strong dimensional modelling skills: grain, relationships, role-playing dimensions, bridge tables, and the trade-offs between model simplicity and flexibility.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Direct Lake semantic models, and notebooks.
  • Solid SQL plus practical PySpark or Spark SQL experience for building and investigating analytical datasets.
  • Proven, effective use of AI coding assistants for analytics development, with the judgement to catch and correct their mistakes.
  • Excellent business and analytical problem-solving skills, including turning loosely defined questions into decision-oriented analytical products.
  • A habit of validating results against the business, not just against the code: you reconcile, you test the rules, and you are not satisfied until the numbers can be trusted by the people who use them.
  • Strong report design judgement: clear visual hierarchy, sensible use of visuals, consistent conventions, and an eye for whether a report actually communicates what it is supposed to.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the confidence to challenge assumptions and explain trade-offs.
  • Familiarity with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and working with Power BI content in source control.

Nice to Have

  • Microsoft certifications such as PL-300 or DP-600.
  • Experience with Fabric Data Agents, Copilot in Power BI, or preparing semantic models for AI consumption.
  • Exposure to equipment rental, construction, distribution, or other asset-intensive operational businesses.

Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality. Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs), Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. Develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development.
  • May be assigned to larger, more complex trials or may coordinate clinical activities for a team of CTMs across a portfolio of projects
  • May coach and mentor CTMs regarding functional clinical delivery, evaluation of project risks, and action implementation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

jobs.title: eCOA Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases.
jobs.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

Supports the execution of core electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) management activities across assigned clinical
projects, ensuring alignment with sponsor requirements, regulatory standards, and industry best practices. Provides eCOA-
specific support to study teams within Data Sciences, working under the direction of the eCOA Manager. Collaborates cross-
functionally to maintain system integrity, support study timelines, and contribute to the successful delivery of project
milestones. Supports departmental initiatives and company-wide strategic objectives through continuous process
improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Study Documentation: Prepare and draft eCOA documentation from templates (user guides, test scripts), revise based on feedback, and maintain approved documents in the eTMF

  • Testing and Validation: Perform basic testing of eCOA databases, support User Acceptance Testing with cross-functional teams, and document results while reporting issues for resolution

  • Study Deliverables: Support translation activities including screenshot reports, track translation and data transfer timelines, and generate and review report outputs for accuracy

  • Study Team Support: Perform administrative tasks, schedule meetings, provide user support by answering eCOA questions, and troubleshoot issues with escalation to the eCOA Manager when needed

  • Department Support: Contribute to continuous improvement through knowledge sharing and training, advocate for eCOA best practices, and participate in cross-functional working groups

  • Training Compliance: Complete all required training on time and maintain a minimum of 90% training compliance at all times

Skills & Qualifications

  • A minimum of a post-secondary certificate/diploma (college, Training Institute, etc.) + 1-3 years related experience.
  • Basic understanding of clinical trial processes, eCOA solutions, PRO questionnaires, and data collection within eCOA systems.
  • Familiarity with GxP, ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP), and regulatory requirements for eCOA in multi-region clinical trials.
  • Working knowledge of study start-up procedures, questionnaire translation, screenshot review workflows, device/licensing logistics, and report/data transfer tracking.
  • Foundational experience with eCOA systems including routine data entry, running standard reports, system updates, and documentation (user requirements, UAT scripts, validation records).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with cross-functional teams (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, sponsors) and vendors across different time zones.
  • Ability to track timelines and issues on assigned studies effectively

What We Offer

    In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

    To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

    Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
    Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to .
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

jobs.title: Senior Data Migration Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Who we are At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling, patient care.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling, patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

WELLSTAR Clinical Platform Group brings together the EMR technology that supports clinics and healthcare providers across Canada, including OSCAR Pro, Juno, HealthQuest, and Cerebrum. As part of the broader WELL Health ecosystem, we are focused on helping providers adopt modern, scalable, and connected technology that supports better care delivery and reduces administrative complexity.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Director of Implementations, we are hiring a Senior Data Migration Specialist to join our Implementations team. As our new Senior Data Migration Specialist, you will be the senior technical resource for EMR data migrations, helping clinics and healthcare organizations move from legacy systems to WELLSTAR platforms accurately, securely, and with minimal disruption.

You will support high-profile enterprise migrations across OSCAR Pro and Juno to start, with broader exposure across WELLSTAR’s clinical platform group as the organization continues to grow. You will work across test migrations, data validation, final migrations, issue resolution, and go-live readiness, partnering with implementation team members, vendors, clinic administrators, physicians, and technical customer contacts.

This is a full-time remote role open to candidates across Canada. Flexibility is required to support migration windows that may occasionally fall outside standard business hours, including early Eastern or later Pacific time, to minimize disruption to clinics during operating hours.

What is in it for you

Influence. You will shape a high-impact function at a pivotal time. WELLSTAR is operating at a pivotal moment in Canadian healthcare technology, with increasing demand for secure, scalable, connected clinical platforms. This is an opportunity to directly influence migration speed, data accuracy, customer readiness, and go-live success. By improving how data is mapped, validated, migrated, and supported, you will reduce rework, lower risk, and help clinics maintain access to the historical information they rely on to deliver care.

Impact. You will create leverage through better tools and processes. You will improve the scripts, tools, workflows, and repeatable approaches that support migration work. Your contributions will help the team move faster, work more consistently, and scale migration volume without compromising quality or privacy. This is a chance to apply deep technical expertise to work that matters: making healthcare technology easier to adopt, trust, and use.

A meaningful mission. WELLSTAR is part of a healthcare technology ecosystem serving a significant portion of practitioners across Canada. You will join a specialized team focused on solving practical, high-value problems in healthcare technology, where your expertise will be visible and valued. As migration needs evolve, you will have the opportunity to mentor others, strengthen team practices, and contribute to the future structure of the migration function.

How you will make an impact:

  • Help set the technical direction for complex migrations. You will lead complex, high-value EMR conversions for multi-location practices and enterprise healthcare organizations. You will identify risks early, guide data strategy, and serve as the escalation point when migration complexity threatens timelines, accuracy, or go-live readiness.
  • Create more scalable migration infrastructure. You will help design and maintain the scripts, tools, reusable approaches, and validation standards that support WELLSTAR’s conversion work. You will focus on the big picture, building repeatable approaches that reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and increase confidence across every stage of the migration lifecycle.
  • Influence product and implementation outcomes. You will bring the voice of Implementation into Product and Engineering conversations, advocating for import capabilities, integrations, and platform improvements that reduce friction for customers and internal teams. Your insight into the complexity of real-world healthcare data will help shape decisions that improve implementation quality and platform scalability.
  • Raise the bar for migration quality and governance. You will evolve the team’s migration playbook, including mapping standards, validation methods, cutover planning, documentation, and compliance-conscious data handling. You will ensure tools and processes support secure, accurate, and auditable migration work aligned with PHI, HIPAA, SOC 2, and internal expectations.
  • Develop capability across the team. You will mentor junior and mid-level specialists, support stronger technical practices, and help build a shared standard for how migration work is scoped, delivered, reviewed, and improved. As the function grows, you will help shape the team’s capacity, operating model, and future leadership structure.
  • Measure and improve migration performance. You will track and report on migration outcomes, including data accuracy, timeline adherence, rework, automation gains, and delivery risk. You will use those insights to improve processes, strengthen planning, and help implementation leadership make informed decisions about priorities and capacity.

What you bring:

  • The EMR data migration experience. You have strong experience working with EMR, EHR, practice management, healthcare data, or similar data migration environments. Direct EMR migration experience is highly preferred, especially with platforms such as TELUS Health PSS, CHR, Med Access, Avaros, Accuro, Oscar Pro, Juno, or similar Canadian EMR systems.
  • The migration mindset. You understand how data moves from one system to another, including extraction, transformation, mapping, validation, and final load processes. You can balance technical detail with customer timelines, vendor coordination, implementation delivery, and go-live readiness.
  • The technical depth. You are comfortable getting into systems, understanding back-end structures, manipulating data, and solving complex migration problems. You bring strong SQL skills and experience with scripts, tools, or technical processes that support accurate, efficient data movement.
  • The customer-facing confidence. You can communicate clearly with internal teams, vendors, clinic administrators, physicians, and technical customer stakeholders. You ask good questions, explain issues in practical terms, and help customers feel supported through complex transitions.
  • The tooling and automation capability. You have experience working with, improving, or building tools that support data migration, validation, reporting, or repeatable data processes. Experience with Python or a comparable language, Git, ETL tooling, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines would be an asset.
  • The regulated data judgement. You understand the responsibility that comes with handling sensitive information in healthcare or another highly regulated industry. You approach data access, privacy, validation, documentation, and secure handling with care and sound judgement.
  • The leadership potential. You bring ownership, maturity, and a collaborative approach. You may have mentored others, supported junior team members, led project work, or acted as an escalation point, and you are interested in growing your impact as the team evolves.

Why join us?

WELLSTAR is a leading healthcare technology company dedicated to reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. We provide a comprehensive, holistic solution for healthcare providers across Canada, with over 40% of practitioners currently using our products and services. Our solutions serve primary care physicians, specialist physicians, health systems, and public sector organizations through a complete suite of solutions, including billing and practice management systems, electronic medical records (EMRs), digital health applications, and digital health network solutions.

In October 2026, WELLSTAR reached an important milestone, becoming a publicly traded company on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol WSTR. As a majority-owned subsidiary of WELL Health, we enter this next stage of growth with the backing of an established healthcare leader and the focus and opportunity of an independent public company. We continue to invest in innovation and technology that reduce administrative burden and empower healthcare providers to deliver better patient outcomes.

What you can expect from our interview process:

The US is one of Wellhub's largest, most dynamic, and most socially engaged markets—and we're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our social media strategy locally. About Sezzle:


With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Shopper Risk Fraud Operations analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work one of the shifts listed below full-time:
  • Monday -Friday between 9:00 am and 5:30 pm - local time (Central time zone).
This will be a non-exempt/hourly position. Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

Compensation:

For this Fraud Operations Analyst the compensation range is $1,500 - $2,000 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

What You'll Do:

  • Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents
  • Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training
  • Able to work through holidays
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents
  • Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus
  • Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus
  • Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus

Our customers are faced with a constant stream of decisions every day to meet the commitments they have made to their own customers: which orders need to be delivered when, which driver is equipped to drive which truck, and how to balance delivering every order against fleet utilization and the profitability of their business..

As an engineer on the Route Planning team, you might work on a product that helps customers recover efficiency in their plans that has degraded with the addition of new customers or deal with the sudden influx of orders on the day of delivery. You will also help measure efficiency of the plans across our Routing products, including route execution and commercial navigation.

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build features end to end, from frontend to backend, that work across our diverse customer base, from grocery delivery to oil and gas
  • Leverage AI with strong judgement, knowing when to build a prototype to unblock a stalled customer deal or accelerate a refactor that reduces risk of incidents in our products
  • Partner with the engineering manager and staff engineers to advocate for technical excellence on the team
  • Work with the product manager and designer to build interfaces and APIs that make a planner’s work more efficient
  • Mentor junior engineers on the team and help build a strong technical bench

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of experience as a software engineer
  • Demonstrated ability executing in ambiguous environments
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal navigating conversations with a technical audience or a customer

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Proven experience shaping and improving routing and navigation products
  • A passion for mentoring and helping junior engineers grow
  • A track record of thriving in 0→1 teams and scaling them through the post–startup phase
  • Experience operating as a tech lead or in a similar technical role directly impacting output of other engineers.
  • Willingness to engage directly with customers when needed

Total Rewards

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

  • Drive Complex Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Resolution by serving as the direct technical escalation bridge between field teams and core engineering to diagnose, reproduce, and resolve critical L2/L3 networking escalations, network segmentation challenges, and packet-level anomalies during active customer pilots

  • Author Technical Documentation, Deployment Guides, and Reference Architectures by developing production-ready technical collateral, including step-by-step deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers, competitive test plans, and solution briefs to standardize best practices and accelerate post-sales time-to-value

  • Deliver Field Readiness & Enablement Training by creating and conducting high-impact technical training programs, interactive workshops, and technical webinars for Systems Engineers (SEs), professional services, and channel partner architects to scale deployment self-sufficiency across distributed enterprise environments

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Operate with a strong ownership mindset, combining a passion for the mission with high integrity and the ability to navigate seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

  • Maintain a customer-obsessed approach, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to solve real-world problems and champion their success.

  • Move with a strong sense of urgency, focusing on execution and delivering high-impact, high-quality results rapidly in a growth-oriented environment.

  • Drive innovation through deep curiosity, enjoying complex technical challenges and leveraging technology to build secure, scalable solutions.

  • Lead with integrity and accountability, consistently aligning actions with words to build trust across teams.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical marketing, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering with deep subject matter expertise in enterprise routing, switching, TCP/IP, L2/L3 network segmentation, and tunneling protocols (WireGuard, IPsec, VxLAN)

  • Proven track record of leading and winning hands-on customer Proof of Value (POV) pilots and executive architectural evaluations within complex enterprise and distributed edge networking environments

  • Hands-on proficiency in building and maintaining multi-vendor physical and virtual network lab topologies using bare-metal appliances, hypervisors (ESXi, KVM), and network emulation platforms (EVE-NG, GNS3)

  • Advanced packet analysis and troubleshooting expertise using Wireshark, tcpdump, and traffic generation tools to diagnose real-time routing anomalies, latency/jitter, MTU issues, and NAT/firewall traversal

  • Demonstrated track record of authoring production-grade technical collateral (deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers) and delivering technical enablement sessions to sales engineering, professional services, and partner teams

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

  • Working knowledge of public cloud networking architectures (AWS VPCs/Transit Gateways, Azure Virtual WAN, GCP Cloud Routers) or container networking environments (Docker, Kubernetes) connecting distributed branch edges to cloud workloads

  • Recognized networking or security certifications (e.g., CCIE/CCNP Enterprise or Security, JNCIP, PCNSE) or direct architectural experience with retail, kiosk, IoT/OT, or cellular WAN/5G failover deployments

Your job is to build the product knowledge layer that gives those teams the context and content they need, when they need it.

  • Design and maintain a product knowledge repository with typed, sourced, and versioned content that keeps verified facts, decisions, ideas, and internal-only detail apart
  • Design and build role-scoped delivery through our internal AI harness, so Marketing, Sales, Enablement, and Customer teams get launch messaging, battlecards, help content, and training from verified sources, including inside the tools they already use, such as Salesforce, Gainsight, and Intercom
  • Automate repetitive PDLC work, such as go-live checklists, release notifications triggered by deploys and feature flag changes, and status roll-ups, so program and product managers can spend their time on decisions instead of coordination
  • Prototype several approaches quickly, test them with the people who will use them, and iterate or discard based on what you learn
  • Extend and improve our internal apps and dashboards built on tools such as Replit, including portfolio and capacity planning and delivery health metrics
  • Build AI-assisted workflows, Claude skills, and Slack bots that answer questions about work in flight from the product knowledge repository
  • Work with Product, Engineering, Program Management, Product Analytics, and go-to-market teams to understand their needs and turn them into simple tools
  • Build securely and responsibly, respecting access controls, data handling standards, and audit requirements such as SOC 2 traceability between code and work items
  • Document what you build so others can use, support, and maintain it

What You Need to Succeed

  • Experience building and maintaining web applications, APIs, and integrations in a modern language such as Python or TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Comfortability working with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication for third-party tools
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, debugging, and Git-based workflows with code review
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and LLMs, such as Claude Code, and the ability to build and use agent harnesses and automated workflows to build and iterate quickly
  • A bias toward shipping: you're happy to build a quick first version, learn from it, and start over without attachment when a better approach appears
  • Curiosity about how teams work, and the habit of understanding the problem before building the solution
  • Clear communication with non-technical partners, including explaining tradeoffs in plain language
  • Effective collaboration with a manager who owns the vision, while bringing your own ideas and pushing back when something won't work
  • Ability to actively explore, learn, and responsibly integrate AI tools into daily tasks to drive efficiency and support Bloomerang's mission.
  • Experience with content models, metadata, or knowledge graphs, and with provenance and versioning of content in Git

Nice to Haves But Not Required

  • Experience with LLM-assisted classification, and evaluation of AI answer quality
  • Familiarity Atlassian, GitHub, Notion, or Slack APIs; Salesforce, Gainsight, Intercom, or Pendo APIs
  • Previous experience with MCP servers; Replit; or SQL and data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, etc)

Benefits

You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off
You'll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Duke University:

Duke University was created in 1924 through an indenture of trust by James Buchanan Duke. Today, Duke is regarded as one of America’s leading research universities. Located in Durham, North Carolina, Duke is positioned in the heart of the Research Triangle, which is ranked annually as one of the best places in the country to work and live. Duke has more than 15,000 students who study and conduct research in its 10 undergraduate, graduate and professional schools. With about 40,000 employees, Duke is the third largest private employer in North Carolina, and it now has international programs in more than 150 countries.

Be You.

The Thomas Lord Department of Mechanical Engineering & Materials Science is seeking a Grants and Contracts Administrator to join our research administration team. In this role, you will provide comprehensive pre-award and post-award support to faculty and Principal Investigators, helping advance groundbreaking research through expert grants management, financial oversight, and regulatory compliance.

You will serve as a trusted partner to researchers throughout the entire sponsored project lifecycle, from proposal development and submission through award management and closeout. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, financial acumen, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while ensuring compliance with sponsor, federal, and university requirements.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to analyze financial and operational data and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to learn and apply sponsor regulations, university policies, and research administration best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three or more years of research administration, grants management, or sponsored research experience.
  • Experience supporting both pre-award and post-award activities.
  • Knowledge of federal regulations governing sponsored research.
  • Experience working in an academic medical center, research university, or similar complex environment.

  • Prepare financial and administrative reports for investigators, department leadership, and university stakeholders.

  • Facilitate the issuance, monitoring, reconciliation, and closeout of subawards in collaboration with institutional partners.

jobs.description:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

About the Role

Gatik is looking for a Maintenance Planner to play a pivotal role in maintaining operational excellence, vehicle reliability, and fleet readiness across commercial and R&D operations. In this role, you will lead maintenance activity prioritization, recall and service campaign management, and vehicle logistics orchestration. Reporting to the Director of Fleet and Maintenance Strategy, you will partner closely with commercial, R&D, and transport vendor teams to achieve maximum fleet uptime and operational readiness. You will be instrumental in maintaining strict quality control through Work Order (WO) auditing while driving continuous fleet performance and safety.

This role is remote, but travel is necessary to our sites throughout North America.

What You'll Do

  • Set and effectively communicate truck repair priorities based on dynamic schedules and operational requirements for commercial and R&D teams.
  • Balance competing operational demands to maximize fleet uptime and strategic availability.
  • Optimize base vehicle repair and maintenance scheduling with AV maintenance scheduling and upfits to minimize vehicle downtime.
  • Coordinate factory recalls and campaign service initiatives across the entire fleet, authorizing and approving campaigns to ensure regulatory compliance and vehicle safety.
  • Coordinate truck moves across manufacturers, build sites, up-fitters, and operational markets, maintaining alignment between transport vendors, regional hubs, and internal stakeholders.
  • Schedule maintenance, campaigns, recalls, and updates against bay capacity, specialized tooling, and technician availability.

jobs.description:
Convera is seeking a commercially driven Senior Business Development Manager to generate net-new pipeline and win strategic channel partnerships across North America. This is a dedicated proactive new business development role, focused on creating and converting new opportunities rather than managing established partner portfolios.

The near-term priority is workforce payments, with primary emphasis on payroll and pension and selected opportunities across travel and expense and global mobility. The role will target partners with recurring cross-border payment flows and a strong strategic fit with Convera’s network reach, compliance capabilities, foreign exchange expertise, local payout rails, and relationship-led service model.

Key responsibilities

  • Net-new pipeline generation: Build a continuously growing, high-quality pipeline across payroll, pension, travel and expense, and global mobility partners, with primary focus on payroll and pension.
  • Territory strategy: Develop and execute a North American account and territory plan based on addressable whitespace, strategic fit, corridor opportunity, competitive position, and route to revenue.
  • Ideal partner targeting: Prioritise partners with a large customer book, recurring cross-border flows, attractive corridor mix, mature KYC practices, limited high-risk exposure, and influence over payables or receivables.
  • Prospecting and market development: Create opportunities through targeted outbound activity, executive networking, referrals, advisers, technology ecosystems, conferences, and coordinated marketing.
  • Consultative discovery: Understand the partner model, end-customer journey, payment flows, statutory-payment needs, FX economics, technical requirements, implementation dependencies, and commercial value.
  • Value proposition: Lead with Convera’s strengths in global network and currency coverage, compliance, FX expertise, local payout rails, hedging capabilities, and relationship management.
  • Complex sales leadership: Own opportunities from initial engagement through qualification, business-case development, solution design, commercial negotiation, contracting, and internal approval.
  • Anchor partnerships: Identify strategically important partners that can provide brand value, market credibility, learning, or co-development potential in addition to direct revenue.
  • Cross-functional orchestration: Mobilise Product, Solutions Consulting, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Pricing, Finance, Operations, Implementation, and Marketing to progress opportunities and resolve barriers.
  • Disciplined handover: Transition signed partners to the appropriate implementation, partner activation, and account-management teams with clear commercial commitments, success measures, and ownership.
  • Selective future-vertical development: Maintain informed coverage of marketplace and AP automation opportunities, but pursue selectively and in line with product and technology readiness.
  • Sales discipline: Maintainaccurate CRM data, next steps, qualification, forecasting, risks, and commercial assumptions; use insight to improve conversion and sales velocity.

Measures of success

  • Pipeline creation: Value, quality, coverage, and progression of net-new qualified pipeline.
  • New partner wins: Signed partnerships and contracted revenue potential in priority workforce-payment verticals.
  • Strategic fit: Proportion of pipeline aligned to the target partner profile, priority verticals, and North American growth agenda.
  • Commercial quality: Sustainable economics, FX capture opportunity, scalable operating model, and clear route to downstream customer adoption.
  • Execution: Forecast accuracy, stage progression, internal alignment, and clean handover after signature.

What you bring

  • Experience: 7+ years in B2B business development or enterprise sales, ideally within payments, fintech, payroll, pension, HR technology, SaaS, or financial services.
  • Proactive new business development track record: Demonstrated success creating pipeline from the ground up and closing complex net-new business.
  • Channel sales: Experience selling through partnerships, platforms, intermediaries, or embedded distribution models, including an understanding of downstream customer economics.
  • Payments knowledge: Understanding of cross-border payments, mass payments, local payout rails, foreign exchange, hedging, compliance, and partner-led payment models.
  • Technical confidence: Ability to sell integrated and API-enabled solutions credibly while matching the solution to current product capability and implementation readiness.
  • Commercial acumen: Strong skills in qualification, opportunity sizing, business cases, pricing, negotiation, and multi-party deal structuring.
  • Executive influence: Confidence engaging senior commercial, product, technology, finance, treasury, compliance, and operations stakeholders.
  • Ways of working: High ownership, persistence, sound judgement, curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • An established network across North American payroll, pension, HR technology, workforce management, travel and expense, global mobility, or enterprise payments.
  • Experience with complex partner models involving end-customer onboarding, activation, revenue sharing, FX capture, or joint go-to-market activity.
  • Experience working across the United States and Canada.

Role boundaries

  • The role is accountable for net-new partner acquisition and is distinct from the ongoing account management and development of established partner portfolios.
  • Post-signature end-customer activation, ongoing cross-sell, joint partner marketing, and operational issue management will be led by the designated activation and account-management owners, with the Senior Business Development Manager supporting an effective transition.
  • Aggressive pursuit of marketplace and AP automation partnerships is not the immediate core mandate and should remain selective until the required technology capabilities are ready.

About Convera

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. As experts in foreign exchange, risk and compliance, with an unrivaled regulatory footprint, Convera’s financial network spans more than 140 currencies and 200 countries and territories.

Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. 

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.  

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including: 

  • Competitive salary
  • Opportunity to earn a bonus (dependent on performance)
  • Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization 
  • Corporate benefits 

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform global B2B payments.

Pay Transparency Statement

Convera is committed to pay transparency and equity in accordance with applicable U.S. state and local laws. For this position, the expected base salary range is [$125,000 - $148,000] per year + commission, depending on factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographic location. We use a tiered geographic pay system to ensure fairness across regions. Candidates in high-cost areas may receive higher offers within the posted range.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

About the Role

Globalli is seeking an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team and support hiring across our growing, multinational organization. This role will report to the HR Manager and partner closely with hiring managers across Technology, Go-to-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.

This is a hands-on talent acquisition role for someone who is comfortable working across different functions, seniority levels, countries, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands how recruiting works in a multinational environment and can adapt sourcing and hiring practices to different talent markets while maintaining a consistent, high-quality candidate experience.

You will manage the recruiting process from role intake and sourcing through interviews, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff, while keeping hiring managers informed and ensuring our ATS and recruiting data remain accurate and current.

What You’ll Do

Global Talent Acquisition

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for roles across Technology, Go-to-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop realistic hiring timelines.
  • Develop sourcing strategies based on the role, location, seniority, and local talent market.
  • Source both active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
  • Conduct candidate screening and initial interviews, assess qualifications against established requirements, and provide clear candidate feedback to hiring managers.
  • Coordinate interviews and maintain momentum throughout the hiring process.
  • Manage offer processes in partnership with the HR Manager and hiring managers.
  • Complete recruiting activities and provide a clear handoff to HR for onboarding and new hire setup.
  • Maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the process and help deliver a strong candidate experience.

Global & Multinational Recruiting

  • Recruit across multiple countries and regions, including North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Understand how recruiting practices, talent availability, compensation expectations, employment considerations, and time zones can differ by market.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines in both established and emerging hiring markets.
  • Coordinate effectively with candidates and hiring managers across multiple time zones.
  • Develop practical sourcing strategies that balance talent quality, location, and cost considerations.

Recruiting Operations & Process

  • Manage candidate activity and workflows in Greenhouse, ensuring accurate candidate records, stage movement, interview feedback, and data hygiene.
  • Create and maintain job postings, candidate outreach, interview plans, and scorecards.
  • Track recruiting activity and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time-to-fill, offers, hiring activity, and sourcing effectiveness.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring manager effectiveness.
  • Maintain organized recruiting documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
  • Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the company and hiring needs evolve.

Employer Branding & Talent Engagement

  • Develop compelling candidate outreach and job postings that accurately represent Globalli and the opportunity.
  • Help strengthen Globalli's presence in relevant talent markets and professional communities.
  • Support employee referrals, social sourcing, and other initiatives that expand our talent pipeline.

What You’ll Bring

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full-cycle talent acquisition/recruiting experience, preferably in a fast-paced technology, SaaS, startup, or multinational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple functions, such as Technology, GTM/Sales, HR/Operations, Finance, or other professional roles.
  • Experience managing the recruiting lifecycle from intake through onboarding handoff.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple countries or international talent markets.
  • Strong sourcing experience, including hands-on use of LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Experience working with an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, including candidate tracking, workflow management, reporting, and data hygiene.
  • Strong candidate assessment, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple open requisitions and competing priorities.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working directly with hiring managers and clarifying or challenging requirements when needed.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable internet and a professional home-office environment.
  • Ability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the New York/Eastern Time zone.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting for a global technology, SaaS, fintech, HR-tech, payroll, or workforce management company.
  • Technical recruiting experience, including engineering, SRE/infrastructure, data, or cloud roles.
  • Experience recruiting GTM roles, including Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, or Marketing.
  • Experience recruiting HR, payroll, implementation, workforce management, or other operational roles.
  • Experience recruiting across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and/or APAC.
  • Spanish or another widely spoken business language.
  • Experience recruiting in a remote-first or distributed organization.
  • Experience working with compensation benchmarks and adapting recruiting strategies to different geographic markets.
  • Experience supporting employer branding, talent communities, or recruiting analytics.
