jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.


A day in the life:

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads the paid social creative strategy for 8-10 clients
  • Using data insights along with consumer and brand research to design high performing creative assets
  • Collaborating closely with team members across internal departments and roles
  • Maintaining client communications and sentiment
  • Driven to iterate and ideate towards stated performance goals
  • Develops rapport with client to build a foundation of open discussion, including understanding client product and goals, as well as explaining Power Digital processes
  • Researches client brand, competitors, and industry trends, and effectively implements performance creative best practices by platform
  • Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
  • Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
  • Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
  • Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
  • Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
  • Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
  • Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
  • Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, and/or similar performance data tools (TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc)
  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
  • Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
  • Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
  • Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 5% or lower client churn
  • Manage 8-10 mid level clients
  • Maintain $22,000 RPE

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends and insights and inform the creative roadmap.
  • Responsible for using data insights along with consumer and brand research to orchestrate a sales/messaging/visual strategy.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . About Qevlar AI

Qevlar is a B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to boost the productivity of cybersecurity teams with Artificial Intelligence. We build an AI platform that transitions Security Operations Centres from reactive to proactive units through autonomous security alert investigations.

In just three years, we have:

  • Raised a total of $44m in series-A & seed rounds from EQT Ventures, Forgepoint Capital and Partech

  • Deployed our solution with major Enterprises such as Sodexo and GlobalConnect, and leading MSSPs like Orange Cyberdefense

  • Grown to 1,500+ clients across the US and EMEA

  • Ended 2025 with a strong multi-million dollar ARR, and we're targeting $25M by the end of 2027

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how Qevlar is deployed, governed and trusted inside the world's most demanding organisations.

What you'll actually do

  • Own the deployment portfolio. Define what we offer across multi-tenant, regional, dedicated, customer-hosted (BYOC) and on-premise deployments, the rules for when each applies, and what we decline. Give sales, solutions engineering and pricing a clear playbook so the right model is chosen early in every deal.

  • Turn bespoke into repeatable. Every enterprise deal brings new asks: a new region, key management, network allowlisting, a model upgrade. Decide which become standard capabilities, which become premium options, and which stay out of scope, then drive them into the product.

  • Run the enterprise release. Own the monthly release and patch process for customer-hosted deployments with engineering and DevOps: feature readiness, go/no-go, release notes and customer communication. Make sure features ship compatible with every deployment model by default.

  • Ship the enterprise controls roadmap. Own a roadmap so that Qevlar continues to service its customer base with excellence.

  • Shape packaging and pricing inputs. Work with commercial leadership on what each deployment tier and enterprise package includes, so what we sell matches what we can support at scale.

  • Be the enterprise voice in the room. Join security reviews, procurement and technical calls with CISOs, platform teams and MSSP partners. Bring what you learn back into the roadmap and give customer success the documentation they need to run accounts confidently.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 6+ years in product management, with 3+ owning an enterprise, platform or infrastructure product at a B2B SaaS company

  • You have run a product across more than one deployment model (for example multi-tenant and single-tenant SaaS, regional hosting, or customer-hosted) and made the trade-offs between them

  • You have shipped enterprise controls such as RBAC, SSO/SAML, SCIM, audit logging or entitlements, and taken them through customer security reviews

  • You have owned or shaped a release process for customers who do not take continuous delivery

  • Experience in cybersecurity, regulated industries or MSSP and multi-tenant businesses is a strong plus

Technical depth

  • You reason confidently about cloud infrastructure, tenancy, identity, encryption and release engineering, and hold your own with staff engineers and DevOps

  • You understand how a deployment decision cascades into support load, cost to serve, pricing and sales cycle

  • An engineering, DevOps or solutions background is a plus

Approach

  • Commercial: you filter platform decisions through revenue, margin and customer trust, not technical elegance

  • Structured: you turn one-off customer asks into rules, tiers and processes others can follow without you

  • Customer facing: comfortable in front of CISOs, procurement and partner technical teams

  • At home in a startup: you work with autonomy and pace, make clear calls with incomplete information and write them down

Why join us

  • Own a surface that directly unlocks enterprise and MSSP revenue

  • Shape how a fast-growing security AI company packages and scales its platform

  • Work with an experienced DevOps and platform engineering team on real infrastructure problems

  • Strong career growth in a scaling business

  • Opportunity for equity and early ownership

  • We’re flexible on location.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Hiring Manager interview with our VP Product

  3. Panel: a live working session on an enterprise deployment case, AI tools welcome

  4. Culture fit

  5. References & Offer

Emerald Zebra, on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Senior Product Manager, Trading. The role can be remote, or hybrid from one of the group's offices in Cyprus, the UAE or the UK.

The Role

Do you know why traders use stop losses, or ignore them? Could you rebuild a trading platform to compete with the best in the category? Then we'd like you to own our trading product.

Our client has its own trading platform and is taking it to the next generation: a full overhaul of the experience, broader market and instrument coverage, new ways to monetise and a wider audience. The foundation is built. What it needs is someone to decide what it becomes.

You'll own the trading experience itself: how a client chooses what to trade, places an order, manages risk and tracks performance. You'll lead one squad, report to the Group Product Manager for Engagement and work with the VP of Product on where the platform goes next.

What You'll Do

  • Own the trading domain and its key results outright.
  • Decide what the next generation of the platform becomes, who it is for and what gets built first.
  • Expand coverage and monetisation through new instruments, order types and account structures, and decide what is charged for and what is not.
  • Widen the audience without breaking the product for anyone, from occasional traders to those running strategies every day.
  • Set a two to three year direction for trading rather than waiting for a roadmap.
  • Spend real time with traders and bring back what they say.
  • Validate before building: test whether people want it, whether it changes behaviour and whether it is worth money.
  • Ship in increments within the quarter, working with engineering early to split, cut and sequence the work.
  • Own release readiness and set the standard the domain works to.
  • Bring dealing, risk, compliance and commercial teams in early enough to shape what ships.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 4+ years in product, with a B2C background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.
  • Experience working on the trading product itself at a CFD brokerage. Options platforms or crypto exchanges will also be considered. Investment and wealth platforms will not.
  • A deep understanding of leveraged traders.
  • Real depth in the product: order entry, stop losses and take profits, charting, watchlists, signals, market data and pricing, leverage, margin and liquidation.
  • Has owned an area with a number attached and can talk openly about a period when it went the wrong way.
  • Talks to traders directly and often.
  • Launching or relaunching a proprietary platform, or building experimentation into a trading product, is an asset.

The Type of Person We're Looking For

  • Sets direction and doesn't wait to be handed a roadmap.
  • Commercially minded, thinking about what is worth building as well as what is possible.
  • Hands-on, and close enough to traders to know what they actually do.

Package and Benefits

  • Annual performance bonus
  • Monthly cash flex benefit (taxable)
  • Hybrid working for office-based hires: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home
  • 30 days per year remote working policy
  • 40 days annual leave including public holidays
  • Private medical insurance, 100% covered for the employee and 50% for dependents
  • Work permit support and costs covered for candidates based in Cyprus who need one

We’re early, funded and moving fast. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us.

You'll design the visual creative for our 2027 launch, across player campaigns, social content, brand idents and motion. You'll also design marketing for the developers and publishers we work with, from pitch decks and case studies to a partner toolkit, and show their games in a way that keeps Entity recognisable. Beyond digital, you'll create booth graphics, print and merchandise for industry events.

Where it genuinely helps, you'll use AI to support and enhance our creative workflows, always thoughtfully and with care, and help shape how Entity approaches AI in its creative work. For us, AI is a tool that supports human creativity, never a replacement for it. As an early member of the team, you'll own projects end to end, build things from scratch and help define what Entity becomes.

You'll report to the Art Director, who sets overall creative direction and signs off major brand decisions.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As an HRIS & People Technology Operations Specialist, you will own and optimize our People tech stack. This role goes well beyond HRIS administration: you’ll work across our HRIS and the wider set of people-related tools and integrations, using automation and AI to keep data accurate, remove manual work and give teams the reports and tools they need to work independently.

You’ll work closely with the People Operations team to make sure our systems, workflows and data support a fast-growing, global, contractor-based workforce. You’ll thrive here if you’re tech-savvy, highly organised and energised by a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the go-to administrator for our HRIS and other people related tools managing fields, tables, permission groups and access levels.

  • Manage data imports, mass uploads and regular data audits to keep records accurate and up to date.

  • Build and maintain hiring, onboarding and offboarding flows, task lists, reminders and approval workflows.

  • Create reports and dashboards for teams and leadership across the full employee lifecycle, from candidate to exit.

  • Identify manual processes and automate them, using HRIS and other features, integration and automation platforms and AI tools to reduce repetitive work for the HR team and managers.

  • Explore, evaluate and introduce new people-related tools and integrations to speed up People Operations tasks, such as data checks, documentation, reporting and support.

  • Be the first point of contact for technical questions on People systems, and create guides and short training videos for teams and admins.

  • Work with vendors’ customer success teams on escalations, new features and best practices.

  • Manage multiple priorities with tight deadlines, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Proven, hands-on expertise as an administrator or system owner of an HRIS (workflows, reports, permissions, imports, performance cycles) and an ATS (job pipelines, hiring workflows, scorecards, candidate data). Experience with HiBob is highly preferred.

  • Strong working knowledge of the broader people-tech ecosystem and of connecting these tools through integrations and automation.

  • Practical, hands-on experience using automation and AI tools to streamline workflows, with examples of processes you have automated.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and confidence working with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Highly organised, with the ability to work independently, prioritise and meet deadlines.

  • Comfortable in, and genuinely enjoys, a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Tech-savvy, a quick learner, and able to pick up new tools and processes fast.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in HR or People Operations, such as recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, contracts or time off.

  • Experience with automation or integration platforms or light scripting.

  • Experience supporting multiple entities or international, contractor-based teams.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Confluence or Google Workspace.

  • A passion for technology and innovation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.excerpt: ⌘Role Overview The Data Scientist is the first hire on the team whose job is to put machine learning into production, not just into a notebook.
jobs.description:
⌘Role Overview

The Data Scientist is the first hire on the team whose job is to put machine learning into production, not just into a notebook. You'll build models that power product and other live flows sometimes surfaced to users in real time, not just reported on in a dashboard a week later.

The first flagship project is about personalization across the user journey: a model that decides, per user, what offer to show, wired directly into the product and lifecycle experience rather than sitting in a warehouse table. From there, you'll extend the same muscle: model → API → product surface to other high-leverage moments in the user journey.

You'll work hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering and Lifecycle marketing to ship models as features, not as reports. This is also a foundational role for the team's infrastructure: most of what Data does today is batch (dbt, Lightdash, BigQuery); you'll help establish our first real-time low-latency serving patterns on GCP and work closely with engineering on this.

⌘Key Responsibilities

1. Production ML Development

  • Build, validate, and ship ML models (propensity, pricing/discount optimization, personalization, churn/LTV) that go live in the product, not just proof-of-concept notebooks.
  • Own the full lifecycle: problem framing, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
  • Write production-grade code (tested, versioned, reviewed) — you'll be shipping alongside Engineering, held to their bar.

2. Personalization across the journey: from paywall to lifecycle

  • Design and ship the personalized discounting model: who gets what offer, and why, served at the moment of the paywall decision.
  • Partner with product on machine learning experiment design (A/B, holdouts) to prove causal lift of the models, not just correlation.
  • Build the measurement framework so pricing/discount decisions are defensible to finance and leadership.

3. ML Infrastructure & MLOps (GCP)

  • Stand up our first low-latency model serving pattern on GCP (e.g., Vertex AI endpoints, Cloud Run, or equivalent)
  • Define the feature pipeline pattern: what's precomputed in BigQuery/dbt vs. what needs to be fresh/real-time via Pub/Sub or similar.
  • Set up model monitoring: drift, staleness, prediction quality so a live model doesn't silently degrade.

4. Product & Engineering Partnership

  • Sit close to Product and Engineering, not just Data this role is measured by what ships to actual users, not just notebooks
  • Translate a product problem ("how might we reactive lapsed payers") into a modeling problem, and a model output into an API contract Engineering can build against.
  • Document handoffs clearly enough that Engineering can own the serving layer long-term without you as a bottleneck.

5. Experimentation & Causal Inference

  • Design uplift/causal models where "who responds to a discount" matters more than "who churns" .
  • Run and interpret experiments that isolate the model's actual incremental impact on revenue/retention.
  • Design the experimentation program for improving data science and machine learning models with the same rigour we use across our already ongoing experimentation programs

⌘Expected Outcomes

  • Personalized discounting model live in production, serving real paywall decisions to real users: shipped end-to-end, not a prototype sitting in staging.
  • A documented, reusable low-latency serving pattern established on GCP (Vertex AI endpoints or Cloud Run) — the next model doesn't require rebuilding this from scratch.
  • Proven incremental lift on a core business metric (paywall conversion, discount margin efficiency, or lapsed-payer reactivation — pick the one you want as the flagship KPI), demonstrated through a controlled experiment, not just before/after comparison.
  • Model monitoring in place — drift and staleness alerts mean the team knows within days, not months, if a live model silently degrades.
  • A repeatable model-to-production playbook that others in the team can follow

⌘Skills & Competencies

Must have (hard skills)

  • Strong Python for data science and ML (scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM; PyTorch or TensorFlow a plus if deep learning is relevant to future use cases).
  • Proven track record shipping models to production, not just modeling in a notebook. Can talk through at least one model that served live traffic.
  • Hands-on experience with a cloud ML platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, Cloud Run/Functions) or fast ability to translate equivalent AWS/Azure experience.
  • Solid SQL; comfortable working against a dbt/BigQuery warehouse.
  • Software engineering fundamentals: git, code review, testing, CI/CD: You'll be shipping code Engineering has to trust.
  • Causal inference / uplift modelling or applied experimentation experience: pricing and discounting need "what if we hadn't," not just "who churns."

Nice to have

  • Experience with streaming/event pipelines (Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Kafka): useful as we move off pure batch.
  • Experience with pricing, discounting, personalization specifically.
  • Familiarity with feature stores or the DIY equivalent (versioned feature pipelines).
  • Multi-armed bandits or reinforcement learning for pricing/personalization.
  • Startup experience: comfortable being the first person to build something rather than joining an existing ML platform team.

Soft skills

  • Genuinely energised by "does this move the metric," not just "is this model accurate."
  • Can hold their own in a room with Engineering and with Business: Speaks commercial as well as the language of engineering
  • Explains modeling tradeoffs in plain business terms to Product/leadership without dumbing it down or using too much jargon
  • Comfortable owning ambiguity — this role is defining the pattern, not following one.

⌘Required experience

  • 4–7 years in a data scientist / ML engineer role, with at least one model you personally took from prototype to live production serving real users or real traffic.
  • Quantitative background (CS, stats, engineering or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • B2C, subscription, or marketplace experience is a strong plus
  • Fluent English.

⌘Recruitment process

Introduction Call - 30min with Talent Acquisition Manager

Business Interview - 30min with VP Data

Case Study - Async assessment

Panel Interview - Case study Q&A

Final interview - Interview with Product Manager

jobs.excerpt: EmploymentFull TimeCompensation$80,000-$105,000, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capabilityTeamTax, with a PracticeDen market specializationReports toLiz Sandstrom, EA, Tax ManagerStart dateFlexible, as early as September 22, 2026 and as late as January 4, 2027LocationRemote within approved U.
jobs.description:
EmploymentFull TimeCompensation$80,000-$105,000, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capabilityTeamTax, with a PracticeDen market specializationReports toLiz Sandstrom, EA, Tax ManagerStart dateFlexible, as early as September 22, 2026 and as late as January 4, 2027LocationRemote within approved U.S. work locationsTravelPossible quarterly all-hands meetings and occasional destination CPE, fully reimbursed within firm policy

Sharp tax work. An accounting brain. A soft spot for better systems.

Job postings are funny

They are often part wish list, part sales pitch, and part collection of phrases no human has ever used in conversation. That does not tell you what the work feels like, who you will work with, or whether you will actually enjoy being here. We would rather be honest, so here is the real story.

About PracticeDen and R.D. Barnett PLLC

PracticeDen grew out of R.D. Barnett PLLC, the tax, accounting, and advisory firm Dean Barnett founded to help entrepreneurs and privately held businesses make smarter financial decisions. Years of sitting beside business owners - not just filing returns for them - made one thing clear: independent veterinary practice owners deserved an advisor who understood both the numbers and the wonderfully complicated business behind them.

That is where PracticeDen comes in. We connect the entire financial picture, from the operating practice and related real estate to the owner's individual tax situation. We work with veterinary owners as they start, buy, operate, grow, and eventually transition their practices. The goal is bigger than accurate filings. We want our clients to understand their numbers, spot opportunities earlier, make confident decisions, and spend less time wondering what their accountant is talking about.

PracticeDen is the veterinary-focused brand of R.D. Barnett PLLC. It is not a separate firm or a tax-only team. This role has a functional home in Tax and works across PracticeDen with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates so the practice, related real estate, and owner return tell one coherent story.

The Role (and Why It's Interesting)

We are looking for an experienced, hard-working, and self-motivated Senior Tax Associate who can prepare a wide variety of returns, hand off thoughtful, reviewer-ready work, and help us make tax season run a little smarter. You will work across entity and individual clients, often following the numbers across a veterinary practice, related real estate, and the owner's personal return.

This role reports to Liz Sandstrom, EA, Tax Manager. Liz leads the tax side of PracticeDen and will be your primary coach, reviewer, supervisor, and escalation point. You will own day-to-day execution, workpaper quality, status visibility, and early issue identification. Liz will set technical direction, approve material positions, and help you grow toward greater independence, planning exposure, client leadership, and review responsibility.

Tax preparation is the main event. You will gather information, build workpapers, prepare calculations and returns, support planning, handle e-filing and delivery, research unusual issues, and help resolve notices or other technical projects. In other words: you will do real tax work from beginning to end, not spend your days moving numbers from one box to another without understanding why.

This is also not a stay-in-your-lane-forever role. While traditional accounting work won’t be your primary responsibility, a strong accounting brain is essential. You should be able to read a trial balance, understand the financial statements, reconcile important accounts, propose adjustments, and recognize when the accounting needs attention before a return can move forward. Recurring bookkeeping is not part of this role unless separately assigned and scoped.

As PracticeDen grows, this role can grow with it. We do not expect you to know every answer. We do expect you to be genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose: ask better questions, trace the issue to its source, and move toward a sensible answer. Prior veterinary-industry experience is welcome but not required. Curiosity about independent veterinary ownership is.

What You'll Actually Do

Make tax work look easy

  • Prepare the returns. All kinds of them. That includes federal, state, and local returns for individuals and closely held entities, with a core mix of Forms 1040, 1065, 1120-S, and 1120. It may also include trusts and estates, related real estate entities, and other returns as assigned.
  • Make review a pleasant experience. Build clean, complete workpapers with clear support, reconciliations, calculations, notes, and tie-outs. Your reviewer should not need detective training to follow your work.
  • Follow the financial trail. Connect practice, real estate, and individual filings so every related return tells the same story.
  • Bring an accounting brain to the return. Reconcile balance-sheet accounts, retained earnings, fixed assets, basis, owner activity, payroll, sales or excise tax, and other book-to-tax items that are part of the engagement.
  • Know what went into the software. Enter and validate tax data, carryforwards, fixed assets, prior-year items, and current-year activity in UltraTax CS or a comparable platform.
  • Raise your hand early. Spot missing information, inconsistencies, unusual issues, capacity concerns, and potential deadline problems before they become deadline-day surprises.
  • See the process through. Help with extensions, estimates, e-filing, secure delivery, tax notices, and the less-glamorous details that still have to be right.
  • Know when the work has changed. Recognize services outside the agreed scope and bring them to Liz before committing to additional work, fees, or timing.
  • Support planning without freelancing. Identify potential planning opportunities, research assigned questions, document the facts and authority, and bring clear recommendations and unresolved questions to Liz.

Use technology like you mean it

  • Make Excel earn its keep. Build traceable workpapers and useful analyses, clean up data, review trial balances, and propose journal entries without turning the workbook into a haunted house.
  • Pick up new tools quickly. Tax software, workflow platforms, portals, collaboration tools-if it makes the work better, you should be comfortable learning it.
  • Use AI thoughtfully, not blindly. Look for responsible ways to improve research, documentation, data handling, and repetitive workflows. Use only firm-approved systems, protect client information, verify every output, and remain accountable for the final work.
  • Notice when a process is clunky, then improve it. Test practical fixes, document what works, and help us scale without trading accuracy for speed.

Be a great human to work with

  • Keep people out of the dark. Communicate about status, open items, scope, risks, and deadlines before someone has to chase you.
  • Write like a person. Draft clear, professional client emails and explain requests without burying the point in tax jargon.
  • Treat review notes as fuel. Ask thoughtful questions, apply the feedback, and make the next engagement better.
  • Help shape the Den. Contribute to documentation, training, and the systems and habits our growing team will rely on.
  • Work across the team. Coordinate with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates when the tax return exposes an accounting issue, planning opportunity, or client need.

What You Bring to the Den

The must-haves

  • Real tax experience. You have at least three years of recent public accounting tax experience, including at least two busy seasons owning returns from client intake through reviewer submission. You can prepare a varied return mix, understand what the numbers mean, and deliver work that is truly ready for review.
  • Individual and entity experience. You have meaningful experience with individual and closely held business returns, not just one narrow slice of a return.
  • A strong accounting brain. You can read financial statements, reconcile accounts, understand journal entries, and trace activity into a tax return without losing the plot.
  • Excel power-user energy. Formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and well-organized workpapers should feel familiar, not frightening.
  • An eye for the tiny things. You catch the transposed number, the missing support, and the line that does not tie before someone else does.
  • AI and automation curiosity. When you see a repetitive process, you naturally wonder whether a robot should be doing the boring part. You are excited to test better ways of working, but you do not hand the robot the keys and walk away. Approved tools, client privacy, professional judgment, and verified outputs are nonnegotiable.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You write well, think before you act, and can receive feedback without turning it into a courtroom drama.
  • Busy-season stamina. You are prepared for 55+ hours during the heaviest filing-deadline stretches, typically February through April 15 and September through October 15. We hope that is reserved for the worst of times, not the regular rhythm. Busy season should be a season, not a year-round personality.
  • Remote-work reliability. You maintain a secure, professional workspace, dependable internet, and availability for Pacific Time collaboration during agreed working hours.
  • Professional references from prior employers, supervisors, or clients.

CPA or Enrolled Agent credential is not required. We value demonstrated capability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continued learning.

Bonus points for:

  • CPA license, EA certification, CPA eligibility, or active progress toward a credential
  • Experience reviewing simpler returns or training less-experienced preparers
  • Tax-tech fluency with UltraTax CS or another professional preparation platform, e-file and portal workflows, or digital delivery tools
  • A useful AI or automation story: something you improved, sped up, or made less painful in a tax or accounting workflow
  • Comfort around the broader accounting stack, such as QuickBooks, Workpapers CS, Practice CS, SurePrep, SafeSend, SharePoint, Notion, Missive, , Gusto, Double, or similar systems
  • Experience with wonderfully complicated owners: closely held businesses, multi-entity structures, real estate, professional practices, or veterinary-industry clients
  • Multistate, pass-through entity tax, basis, fixed asset, owner compensation, or closely held business planning experience

You'll probably thrive here if...

  • You keep the details on a short leash. Projects, files, open questions, and deadlines do not mysteriously disappear on your watch.
  • You communicate before people have to ask. A clear update today is better than a heroic explanation tomorrow.
  • You care about service. You want clients and teammates to have a genuinely good experience, and you are willing to take out the trash - literally or figuratively - when that is what helps.
  • You can be trusted. You use discretion, exercise good judgment, and protect sensitive client information as if it were your own.
  • You are genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose. You ask why, research and test what you do not know, and turn curiosity into a practical next step instead of collecting interesting questions for sport.
  • You own your work. Mistakes happen; hiding them or repeating them is the problem. You speak up, fix the issue, and learn from it.
  • You can handle change. PracticeDen is growing, technology keeps moving, and the perfect process may not exist yet.
  • You take the work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. Public accounting is demanding. A sense of humor makes the hard days better.
  • You build momentum as a form of mutual appreciation. You follow through, communicate early, and move work forward because making teammates chase you is nobody's love language.

How You'll Know You're Crushing It

  • Your reviewer can follow your work without a scavenger hunt. Returns tie, support is clear, and avoidable review notes become rare.
  • There are fewer surprises. Missing information, odd activity, planning ideas, scope changes, and potential problems surface early.
  • People trust your follow-through. Client requests make sense, deadlines stay visible, and projects do not vanish into a status-update black hole.
  • The systems get smarter. You adopt new tools thoughtfully and improve processes without weakening accuracy, controls, or confidentiality.
  • The numbers work too. You meet the production, realization, timekeeping, and project-delivery expectations assigned to your role and portfolio.
  • You get better every cycle. Feedback shows up in the next engagement, and your confidence, judgment, and independence keep growing.

The Practical Stuff: Pay, Benefits, and Where You'll Work

Now, let's talk about the part of the job everyone scrolls for.

  • Compensation: Full-time, exempt position with a base salary of $80,000-$105,000 annually, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capability.
  • Flexible start: The position may begin as early as September 22, 2026 or as late as January 4, 2027.
  • Remote work: This is a remote position within U.S. states and localities approved by the firm. Changes in primary work location or regular work from another state or locality require advance approval.
  • Working hours: The role must maintain dependable availability for Pacific Time collaboration, client needs, training, and scheduled team meetings. The heaviest filing-deadline stretches may require 55+ hours, but that should describe the worst of times, not most of the time.
  • Travel: Travel may be requested for quarterly all-hands firm meetings and occasional destination continuing professional education. The firm will fully reimburse approved business travel in accordance with firm travel and expense policies.
  • Equipment: The firm provides the computer and standard technology equipment needed for the role, including monitors, keyboard, mouse, headset, and related accessories.
  • Medical, dental, and vision: The firm currently pays 100% of the employee premium for its medical plan (BCBS PPO) and dental and vision plans (Delta Dental PPO). Coverage begins on the first day of the month following the employee's start date. Dependents may be added at the employee's cost. Benefits remain subject to plan terms.
  • 401(k): The firm currently matches employee contributions up to 3% of eligible pay. Eligibility begins on the employee's start date, subject to plan terms and the applicable vesting schedule.
  • Paid holidays: Six current firm holidays - New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day - plus four floating holidays. Tax-season blackout dates apply.
  • Vacation: Fifteen vacation days per calendar year, prorated based on the official start date. Vacation is subject to the firm calendar and busy-season blackout periods.
  • Paid sick and safe time: Accrual begins on the first day of employment. The firm uses Seattle's paid sick and safe time requirements as its minimum standard and applies any more protective law required by the employee's work location.
  • Volunteer time: Two paid volunteer days.
  • Professional development: Continuing education and growth opportunities, including reimbursement for approved certification, licensing, professional membership, and destination CPE expenses within firm policy.
  • Optional cell-phone coverage: Participation in the firm's Verizon plan is available under the current cell-phone policy. The firm does not subsidize or reimburse the purchase of the device.
  • Personal tax support: Employees may use firm software to prepare their personal income tax returns and may request reasonable tax guidance from the firm's principals at no charge, subject to firm policy.

Ready to Join the Den?

If you are a strong tax preparer with an accounting mind, a sharp eye, and genuine curiosity about better technology, we would love to hear from you. Bring your judgment, your Excel shortcuts, and your best ideas for making tax work better. We will bring interesting clients, meaningful work, and a team that cares about doing both well!

Come join us in the Den.

How to Apply and How to Stand Out

Apply through the official job posting once it is live. We will consider complete applications in the following order:

  1. Introductory video: Candidates who submit a thoughtful 30-second to 3-minute introductory video will move to the top of the review list. Tell us who you are, why the role caught your attention, and what you would bring to PracticeDen. Production quality is not the point. We want to meet the human behind the resume.
  2. Thoughtful cover letter: Candidates who write a specific, genuine cover letter will be considered next.
  3. Standard application: We will also consider candidates who submit the application without a video or cover letter.

We notice thoughtful follow-up. A respectful LinkedIn message or direct email to a member of our team after applying can help us understand your interest and how you communicate. Please keep it human, specific, and concise.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

R.D. Barnett PLLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship or immigration status, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. Applicants who require an accommodation may contact .

jobs.excerpt: Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager to support the successful delivery of large-scale data center construction projects.
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Cost Manager to support the successful delivery of large-scale data center construction projects. This role will serve as a key day-to-day client interface, ensuring project objectives are achieved through the delivery of a best-in-class cost management service across the full project lifecycle.

This is a remote position, with an expectation to travel to project sites and client meetings in Texas approximately once per month.

To be successful in this role, you will have strong communication and stakeholder management skills and be comfortable operating in a client-facing environment. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, driven, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with project teams. In this significant position, you will provide leadership and direction while promoting the purpose, values, and vision of Turner & Townsend.


Responsibilities:

  • Estimating and negotiating change orders throughout the construction lifecycle.
  • Provide estimate and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan.
  • Review and participate with the design services team and general contractor in the development of cost estimates.
  • Reconcile changes and assist the general contractor to ensure that their data is accurate.
  • Communicate or meet with the general contractor and owner of project manager to gather status information to prepare a cost estimate update.
  • Prepare written comments to the general contractor’s submissions, including the executive summary.
  • Coordinate all sources of cost information for cost discussions and suppliers direct from NPA, subs, quantities from A/Es.
  • Inform and drive engineering priorities based on cost impact.
  • Work proactively with minimal supervision to resolve scheduling issues.
  • Manage cost checks and carry out valuations on larger projects. Complete timely, accurate cost checking and valuation processes.
  • Participate effectively with post-contract cost variances and the change of control processes.
  • Manage Cost impact / contingency management and commitment tracking logs.
  • Prepare funding data presentations and coordinate VE sessions with stakeholders.
  • Developing cost plans and estimates through the design phase, delivering updated cost plans at appropriate design milestones.
  • Providing commercial input to design optioneering and input into value engineering exercises.
  • Reviewing contractor and subcontractor pricing and leading negotiations on behalf of the client to drive fair contract prices.
  • Performing quantity surveying, cost controls, and change management activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensuring that post-contract cost variances and change control processes are managed effectively.
  • Ensuring that cost auditing and valuation work is managed effectively and that a robust process for cost validation is in place.
  • Carrying out the production of monthly cost reports for presentation to the client.
  • Ensuring that final accounts are negotiated and agreed upon in a timely manner.
  • Compiling built cost estimate records for benchmarking purposes.
  • Identify, coach and mentor talent to realize their potential and celebrate the success of others.
  • Display excellence in leadership and service delivery on commissions is in line with the conditions of appointment
  • Financial Management - Utilize internal software to track ongoing margin levels and monthly fee/resource forecasts for each commission and financial reports
  • Implement and maintain the use of internal Business Management Systems and company delivery methodologies and tools in the office to ensure consistent delivery of best practice for Clients and the company
  • Be a role model that drives a one business culture that achieves great outcomes by striking the right balance for our people, clients, stakeholders, and society.
  • SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.
  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience working in a cost management role in the construction industry.
  • RICS accredited or working towards it is preferred.
  • Experience of leading cost management on medium or large sized construction projects of medium to high complexity.
  • Construction consultancy experience is strongly preferred.
  • Good knowledge of construction industry technical matters, such as different procurement routes, value management, and value engineering.
  • Excellent communication skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $145K-$165K USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

jobs.description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Business Development Representative to join our expanding Sales team!

In this role (remote-first), you will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and qualifying target accounts, then converting qualified prospects into meetings for the Account Executive team. You will use phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement cadences to connect with prospective customers, explain the value of Case IQ, and build early-stage pipeline with organizations that align to our ideal customer profile.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond promptly to inbound leads—including demo requests, webinar attendees, event leads, and other marketing-generated inquiries—to create a strong first impression and maximize conversion opportunities.
  • Lead thoughtful qualification conversations to understand each prospect’s business needs, challenges, priorities, and fit with the Case IQ suite of products.
  • Identify high-potential opportunities, route qualified prospects to the appropriate Account Executive, and ensure a seamless, well-documented handoff.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date lead and activity records in Salesforce to support effective pipeline management and reporting.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to share actionable feedback on lead quality, campaign effectiveness, prospect trends, and messaging.
  • Execute consistent follow-up strategies to nurture early-stage leads and re-engage inactive prospects.
  • Meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.
  • Continuously strengthen knowledge of Case IQ’s products, target markets, customer needs, and competitive positioning to deliver relevant and compelling messaging.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Learn Case IQ's product positioning, ICP, target personas, sales process, outreach tools, and activity expectations while beginning to build prospect lists, complete onboarding activities, and shadow effective outreach.
  • 60 Days: Execute outbound cadences with increasing independence, make consistent cold calls and follow-up touches, maintain clean Salesforce activity records, and begin booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.
  • 90 Days: Consistently manage daily and monthly KPIs, demonstrate strong call quality and concise communication, use feedback to improve outreach, and contribute to qualified pipeline generation.
  • 6 Months: Own a repeatable outbound workflow, maintain reliable activity and meeting performance, understand priority segments and personas, and collaborate effectively with Account Executives and Marketing on targeted campaigns.
  • 1 Year: Operate as a high-performing BDR who consistently contributes to pipeline, demonstrates resilience and competitiveness, shares useful market feedback, and helps strengthen the team's outbound playbook.

Who You Are

  • 1+ year experience with prospecting, ideally in a SaaS, technology, or B2B sales environment.
  • Comfortable making cold calls, writing concise emails, using LinkedIn, and following structured sales cadences.
  • Experience handling inbound leads and converting “warm” leads from webinars & tradeshows
  • Quota- and metrics-driven, with the motivation and discipline to work toward daily, monthly, and team targets.
  • Resilient and able to stay motivated through rejection, low-response periods, and changing priorities.
  • Coachability and willingness to learn from feedback, call reviews, performance data, and missed opportunities.
  • Proactive, curious, and able to work independently while collaborating with Account Executives, Marketing, and Sales Operations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and listening skills, and the ability to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Interest in learning Case IQ's market, including HR, Ethics & Compliance, investigations, and governance, risk, and compliance audiences.
  • Competitive spirit, strong money motivation, and ambition to learn, improve, and exceed individual and team goals.
  • Experience with Salesloft, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Qualified chatbot, RollWorks, or other ABM / intent data tools (asset)

Perks and Benefits

  • Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 Countries!).
  • Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
  • Generous professional development budget.
  • RRSP/ 401k matching program and company stock options.
  • Half-day Fridays in the summer.

Selected candidates will be contacted through our BambooHR system (please check your junk mail).

Elemica, an award-winning digital supply chain SaaS company, is seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter to lead Talent Acquisition across North America and EMEA. Join a growing team committed to exceeding client expectations.


Our Values


At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community:

  • Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them
  • Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners

  • Health & Voluntary/Pet Insurance Options
  • Retirement savings and bonus programs
  • Employee engagement events
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Generous Employee Referral Program
  • Global, hybrid/remote work environment

Role & Responsibilities


The Senior Recruiter develops and executes global recruiting strategy for a private equity-backed SaaS organization, partnering with HR Business Partners, Executives, and Senior Business Leaders across North America and EMEA. This highly visible role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of the full recruiting lifecycle, operations, technology, vendors, reporting, and candidate experience.

Core Talent Acquisition Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruiting lifecycle from requisition intake through candidate acceptance and onboarding handoff, including revenue-generating roles
  • Engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach
  • Screen candidates for qualifications, capabilities, cultural alignment, overall fit, and compensation expectations; coordinate complex, multi-region interview processes

Senior-Level Recruiting

  • Lead senior-level and occasional executive searches across commercial, professional services, product, marketing, finance, legal, technology, engineering, IT, and other corporate functions
  • Conduct confidential searches and protect sensitive candidate information

Hiring Manager Partnership

  • Serve as the strategic Talent Acquisition advisor to hiring managers and executive leaders
  • Provide regular search updates to hiring managers and executive leaders
  • Reinforce expectations for timely interview feedback and hiring decisions

Recruiting Operations

  • Manage requisition creation, approval, prioritization, tracking, and closure across business functions
  • Track recruiting activity, pipeline health, aging requisitions, and hiring progress

ATS & Recruiting Technology

  • Administer and optimize Workday ATS technology, integrations, and enhancements
  • Partner with internal and external resources on workflow design, testing, communications, implementation, and process improvement
  • Standardize system processes and automate repetitive recruiting activities where practical

Recruiting Process Design

  • Build and optimize standardized end-to-end recruiting processes that reduce unnecessary steps and delays
  • Create consistent frameworks for candidate screening, interview scheduling, communication, evaluation, and feedback

Candidate Experience

  • Provide clear, timely, and professional communication to every candidate, regardless of hiring outcome

Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Development

  • Develop sourcing strategies and campaigns for difficult-to-fill roles using LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels
  • Maintain evergreen pipelines for recurring and strategically important roles

Agency & Vendor Management

  • Manage external search partners, determine when agency support is appropriate, and negotiate contracts, fees, terms, and service expectations
  • Build internal sourcing capabilities to reduce unnecessary agency dependence

Global Recruiting

  • Develop recruiting approaches that reflect regional talent markets, candidate expectations, and requirements
  • Coordinate interviews across time zones and partner with stakeholders in Germany, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands while maintaining consistent global processes

Employer Brand & Talent Attraction

  • Partner with Marketing on social media posts, calendar, and strategy
  • Develop compelling candidate messages that communicate the company's mission, culture, products, technology, growth opportunities, and employee value proposition to candidates
  • Create and brand job descriptions

Offer Management & Closing

  • Develop competitive and compelling offers in partnership with Finance, HRBPs, and hiring managers/budget owners
  • Create and understand employment contracts for Germany, The Netherlands, and The United Kingdom and employment offers for the United States
  • Present and explain offers to candidates, negotiate compensation and other employment terms within established parameters

What You’ll Need


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience, including executive recruiting or recruiting leadership
  • Experience recruiting revenue-generating Account Executives and other critical go-to-market roles across North America and EMEA
  • Demonstrated success independently managing full-cycle recruiting and passive candidate sourcing
  • In-house recruiting experience within a SaaS, technology, software, or B2B company
  • Experience advising senior executives and recruiting across multiple corporate functions
  • Proficiency with Workday ATS operations, recruiting processes, interview frameworks, metrics, and reporting
  • Experience managing agencies and vendors
  • Ability to manage concurrent searches and competing priorities during organizational transformation

Preferred Experience

  • Private equity-backed or sponsor-backed company experience
  • Demonstrated understanding of the digital supply chain industry, including key market trends, technologies, and solutions that drive supply chain visibility, connectivity, automation, and operational efficiency
  • Experience recruiting technical Product, Engineering, and Technology talent
  • Experience developing global recruiting programs
  • Experience reducing recruiting costs and external agency dependence

Leadership Attributes

  • Strategic, commercially minded recruiter who moves fluidly between planning and hands-on search execution
  • Highly organized, data-driven, consultative, and influential without relying on formal authority
  • Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who works effectively with executives and frontline hiring managers
  • Responsive and adaptable in a fast-paced private equity environment
  • Comfortable constructively challenging stakeholders

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.
