Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Under limited supervision:

  • Build and maintain curated tables and semantic models, in partnership with the data science team, making CX data consistent and easy to use for dashboards and analysis. Use SQL and tools like dbt to transform and combine warehouse data, then validate it for accuracy and usability.
  • Partner with teams across the organization, including Service, Sales, Product, Claims, and Underwriting Analytics, to identify data sources of truth and align on definitions, metrics, and datasets. Define how to connect, interpret, and use data across sources and data types including surveys, contact center metrics, digital interactions, policy / pricing / underwriting / claims data, and business outcomes.
  • Develop reports and Power BI dashboards that help stakeholders track CX trends and identify customer pain points and opportunities to improve experiences. Partner with business stakeholders to understand context and build actionable dashboards and datasets efficiently.
  • Develop a high-level data strategy that keeps customer experience data accurate and usable. Establish processes for ongoing documentation and maintenance of new data sources and metrics. Share information about new CX-owned data with relevant users and answer questions about its use.
  • Coach analysts on SQL and Power BI fundamentals. Advise on data structures and hygiene, storytelling through data visualization, the trade-offs of different approaches, practical tips, and best practices.
  • Create reusable templates for recurring data requests, such as contact lists, and develop data structures and visualizations to evaluate pilots, A/B tests, and new programs.
  • Support ongoing and ad hoc analysis through statistical analysis, alerts, email digests, or reports, as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to automate data preparation, analysis, and visualization. Evaluate the effectiveness and reliability of AI tools for cleaning and analyzing data.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, data engineering, analytics, economics, mathematics, statistics, finance, computer science, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience:

Minimum:

  • At least 4 years in data analytics, data engineering, data visualization, data science, business intelligence, or a related field, including understanding the business context behind the data.

• At least 2 years writing SQL.

  • At least 2 years using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

Preferred:

  • Experience with property and casualty insurance, contact centers, customer experience, and/or survey data.

Knowledge and Skills:

Minimum:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing inputs and presenting reasoning clearly and persuasively.
  • Strong data storytelling; ability to explain complex data and insights clearly and concisely.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills.
  • Initiative and ability to drive projects to completion; attention to detail and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills; experience analyzing complex datasets and applying analytics and visualization to business challenges.
  • Strong SQL programming skills; strong understanding of cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Expertise in Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools in analytical or business contexts and evaluating AI-generated outputs for accuracy, bias, and appropriateness; awareness of data privacy, responsible AI, and AI limitations in regulated industries such as insurance.

Preferred:

jobs.excerpt: About Us Chess. com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.
jobs.description:
About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About The Role

Chess.com is building a media organization around chess: original shows, documentaries, creator-led programming, video, and live broadcasts that bring more people into the game and keep them here. Media & Content now has five teams: International, Social and Audience Growth, Content Production, IRL Events, and Broadcast.

Content Production makes the shows that tell our stories. As its head, you will set the strategy, the creative bar, and the production standards for the group, and our existing video, editorial, and production teams will report to you. You will also shape how the team is organized as the slate grows.

About You

You are the person who turns great ideas into finished content.

You came up through production, so you know how to tell an amazing story and what it takes to get it finished. Whether it’s a live broadcast, a studio show, a one-off docu-style video, or a brand-new IP idea that would thrive on YouTube, you understand how creative, editorial, post, talent, and distribution all need to work together. Somewhere along the way, you also discovered you’re just as good at seeing the whole picture, setting the direction, and getting a big team moving toward the same outcome as you are in the weeds of things.

You have strong creative instincts and real taste. You can protect what makes an idea special while still making it deliverable. You know when to push for something better, when to simplify, and when someone just needs to make the call.

You are in touch with the community. You know what chess fans, gamers, and creators are watching, what they love, and what they're tired of. You make content that feels like it was made by someone who is part of that world, because you are.

You are comfortable leading managers and holding the slate, the budget, and the schedule. When a shoot falls through, a creator's calendar changes, and a cut needs to ship by Friday, you solve the problem without losing sight of why the project exists.

You are equally comfortable building a multi-year content strategy and sitting in an edit bay giving notes. You have high standards, good judgment, a low ego, and the ability to stay calm when the plan changes.

What you'll do

  • Set our content production strategy. Build a clear long-term vision for our slate of shows, series, documentaries, and creator collaborations, and define how each one drives audience growth, community, brand, and the path from watching to playing.
  • Own the slate. Create an annual roadmap across franchises, new formats, and one-off projects. Make smart decisions about where to invest, what to grow, and what to stop making.
  • Lead and develop the team. Manage managers and individual contributors across production, editing, and creative. Set clear lanes, ownership, and decision rights, and build a team that makes strong calls without waiting for you.
  • Set the creative bar. Own the quality of what we put out. Give clear, specific feedback, protect the strongest ideas, and know when something is ready to ship.
  • Own production operations. Build and hold the production calendar, budgets, vendor relationships, and delivery standards. Know where a project is at risk before it slips.
  • Stay close to the community. Follow what's working on YouTube, Twitch, Discord, Reddit, and Chess.com itself, and turn that into content decisions. Keep the work true to how chess fans actually talk and watch.
  • Work with creators and talent. Be a trusted partner to creators, players, and personalities. Bring their ideas and audience insight into what we make, and set them up to do their best work.
  • Partner across Media & Content. Work with Social and Audience Growth to make content built for how people watch, with Broadcast and IRL Events to share formats, assets, and talent, and with International to make what we create work globally.
  • Define what success looks like. Measure content across viewership, audience growth, engagement, brand impact, and conversion to play. Use those insights to make each project better than the last.
  • Build our operating system. Establish the tools, roles, approval processes, budget models, and post-project reviews that let us make bigger and better content with less friction each year.
  • Explore what comes next. Evaluate new formats, platforms, and technology, including AI, where they improve speed or quality without flattening our voice.

Must-Have Skills

  • More than 10 years of experience in content production across digital video, entertainment, gaming, sports, or media, with a track record of shipping work people watched.
  • A hands-on production background. You have produced, directed, or run production on shows, series, or documentaries and understand the craft from development through post and delivery.
  • More than 5 years of experience leading teams, including managers. You have built teams, hired well, handled performance issues, and developed people.
  • The ability to move comfortably between long-term strategy, executive communication, and detailed delivery.
  • Strong creative judgment and the production experience to know what is possible, what needs to change, and what is worth fighting for.
  • A genuine connection to community and fandom, and the instinct to make content that resonates with it.
  • Experience working with creators and talent, and respect for how they work and what their audiences expect.
  • A track record of owning production budgets, including forecasting, vendor negotiation, and contracting.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to create alignment in a fully distributed company.
  • Calm and decisive leadership when conditions change and information is incomplete.
  • A strong sense of ownership and genuine care for the people doing the work.

Nice-To-Have Skills

  • Experience in esports, gaming, sports, music, or creator-driven media.
  • Experience with documentary or long-form episodic storytelling.
  • Experience building or scaling a content team inside a fast-growing digital company.
  • Experience producing across multiple languages or regions.
  • An understanding of how content, broadcast, social, creators, live events, and community growth work together.
  • You do not need to be a strong chess player. You do need to be curious about why hundreds of millions of people love this game and excited about creating new ways for them to experience it.

About the Opportunity

  • This is a Full-Time opportunity
  • We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)
  • This role is open to candidates who can work in USA, CAN, UK, or ES (preferably)

---

  • Chess Is For Everyone!

jobs.excerpt: About Snowplow Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning.
jobs.description:
About Snowplow

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow’s event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.


More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.


How we work

  • High agency. When you see a problem or an opportunity we’re missing, you act on it. Managers build alongside their teams.

  • Make it count. Every piece of work points at a goal that matters, with a number that shows whether it’s working.

  • Move fast. We work at the pace AI makes possible and improve as we go, except where customers trust us with their data, service, security and contracts. Those we get right the first time.

  • Challenge, and be open to challenge. Say what you think, with evidence, to the person who can act on it, and expect the same back.


This Opportunity

Snowplow’s customers run event pipelines inside their own AWS, GCP, and Azure accounts, and products like Snowplow Signals are pulling them into AI and personalization work, which only works as well as the behavioral data underneath it. More of them now need more than a fast answer to a ticket. They need someone who understands their setup and their data, spots problems before they become cases, and helps them get more out of what they’ve bought.


That’s the Support Solutions Consultant. It’s one of two specialist tracks we’re building inside Support, and this is one of its first senior seats. Everyone on the team keeps our 24x7 service running, so roughly 75-80% of your time is core support: first response against our SLAs, complex technical cases, and incident management. The other 20-25% is your focus, which is going above and beyond the normal scope of support to help customers achieve their end goals with the product and the behavioral data it creates.


You’ll be a calm, trusted technical voice for customers in EMEA during their working day, with real autonomy and a direct say in how we support them.


What you will own

Core support (roughly 75-80% of your time)

  • Complex technical escalations. Investigate and resolve the hardest cases: pipeline failures, failed events, enrichment and schema issues, loader and warehouse problems, and cloud infrastructure faults across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

  • The customer relationship during an incident. Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates when their data is at stake, and work with Engineering to restore service and recover data.

  • Root cause, not just resolution. Go past the immediate fix and turn what you learn into bug reports and enhancement requests Engineering can act on.

  • AI in your everyday toolkit. Use AI assistants and agents to investigate issues, analyze logs and data, and draft responses, while keeping your own judgment on accuracy and customer impact.

Consultative focus (roughly 20-25% of your time)


  • Support beyond the ticket. Give customers deeper, proactive time, not just a reply to the case in front of you. Learn their setup, their data, their goals, and what they’re building next.

  • Tracking and data design. Review customers’ tracking plans, schemas, and implementation, and help them design behavioral data that answers the questions they actually have.

  • Proactive data health checks. Run consult-and-activate check-ins on the quality of their behavioral data: failed events, schema drift, enrichment configuration, and gaps in what they track. Find real issues and real opportunities, not box-ticking reviews.

  • Getting more from their data. Understand what a customer is building, whether that’s AI agents, personalization, or real-time analytics, and show them how to get there with the data they already collect, from modeling it in the warehouse to new capabilities like Signals.

  • Knowing where the line sits. Work alongside Customer Success and the wider customer team. Recognize when an account needs more than light-touch help and hand it over cleanly.

  • Sharing what you know. Answer in our community channels, write knowledge base articles and runbooks on tracking and data quality that serve both people and the AI tools that draw on them, and mentor colleagues on consultative work.


We would love to hear from you if you have

  • A track record in technical support. Several years in technical support, support engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role, ideally for a B2B SaaS or data infrastructure product.

  • Consultative instincts. You’ve worked with customers beyond the ticket, in an education, solutions engineering, customer success, onboarding, or similar customer-facing role. You ask what the customer is trying to achieve before you answer what they asked.

  • Credibility with customers. You can run a call with a senior technical stakeholder, explain complex issues clearly and empathetically, and follow through on what you said you’d do.

  • Commercial awareness without the sales hat. You can tell when a customer’s needs go beyond support and bring in the right colleague.

  • Technical depth to back it up. Hands-on with AWS or GCP (Azure is a plus), strong troubleshooting instincts, and comfort reading JavaScript.

  • Data and tracking fluency. You understand how behavioral data gets created, from tracker implementation and schema design to enrichment and warehouse modeling. You write SQL against large datasets, and you can tell when the data isn’t telling the truth.

  • Real fluency with AI tools. You use LLMs and agent tools every day, and you know where they work well, where they get things wrong, and how to check the difference.

  • Calm under pressure. You can prioritize when several things are urgent, stay steady during incidents, and know when to escalate.

  • A share-by-default attitude. You document, demo, and teach.

  • Availability for our coverage window. Monday to Friday, [EMEA coverage hours to confirm].


Bonus points for

  • Experience as a solutions engineer or consultant for a data or SaaS product

  • Experience with event tracking, tracking plans, or data modeling, such as analytics engineering

  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or dbt

  • Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or MCP-style tool integrations

  • Greek or another European language, which will help with some of our EMEA customers


Where this role can take you

The Support Solutions Consultant track grows toward wider customer-facing and solutions roles at Snowplow. Moving between our two tracks later stays open as an internal move.


We know some of you will read this and think you need to tick every box before applying. You don’t. We value diversity and hire for potential as much as for experience. If you think you can help solve our challenges, we’d love to hear from you.


What you get in return for being awesome

  • Meaningful equity stake

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Flexible working

  • Generous PTO

  • MacBook and home office equipment allowance

Value Creation Plan and Operating Cadence

Customer Journey Design and Reporting

  • Connect journey data to NRR and GRR, and surface leading indicators of churn and expansion early enough to change the outcome.

RevOps Strategy and Roadmap

  • Build TrueComp’s operating playbook: how we plan, run, measure, and improve the business, from the planning calendar and decision rights to core cross-functional processes.

Role Overview

IMI are seeking a Customs Origin Analyst to work with our UK and wider European operations, as well as Suppliers, Customers and Customs authorities.

The candidate will need to have experience of working with origin and preferential agreements, along with data analysis skills all bolstered by a solid base of Customs knowledge. European language (German, Polish, Czech, Italian) skills useful although not essential. Travel is required in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

  • Determine the customs origin of goods in accordance with EU and UK origin rules, including preferential and non-preferential origin regimes.
  • Analyse and classify products under the relevant tariff nomenclature (Combined Nomenclature / Harmonised System) to support accurate origin determinations.
  • Assess whether goods satisfy the applicable rules of origin criteria (e.g. change of tariff classification, value-added thresholds, specific processing requirements) under EU free trade agreements, the EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA), and other preferential arrangements.
  • Prepare, review, and maintain origin documentation, including supplier declarations, long-term supplier declarations, statements on origin, etc.
  • Conduct origin verification and due diligence checks to ensure compliance with binding origin information (BOI) decisions and customs authority requirements.

Trade Agreements & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Monitor and interpret EU and UK customs legislation, including the Union Customs Code (UCC), its Delegated and Implementing Acts, and the UK equivalents (Taxation (Cross-border Trade) Act 2018 and related secondary legislation).
  • Stay abreast of developments in free trade agreements (e.g. EU–Canada CETA, EU–Japan EPA, Pan-Euro-Mediterranean Convention) and advise on their origin protocols.
  • Evaluate the impact of cumulation rules (bilateral, diagonal, full) on origin determinations across multiple preferential regimes.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Support internal and external customs audits by maintaining clear audit trails for all origin determinations.
  • Identify and escalate origin-related risks, including potential misclassification, insufficient processing, and documentary deficiencies.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for origin management across the European supply chain.
  • Advise business units on the customs origin implications of supply chain restructuring, sourcing changes, and new product introductions.

Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory

  • Liaise with customs authorities across EU Member States and the UK on origin queries, rulings, and verification requests.
  • Collaborate with procurement, logistics, trade compliance, and finance teams to embed origin considerations into commercial decision-making.
  • Provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on origin rules, documentation requirements, and best practices.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Utilise systems and origin determination tools to track and document origin assessments.
  • Perform cost and bill-of-materials analyses to verify value-added and material-content thresholds.
  • Prepare clear, well-reasoned origin opinions and advisory memoranda for senior management and external advisers.

Critical Competencies for Success

Customs & Origin Expertise – Significant experience applying UK/EU customs rules, origin requirements and preferential trade agreements.

Analytical Skills – Strong ability to analyse tariff classifications, bills of materials, cost data and origin criteria accurately.

Compliance & Risk Management – Experience identifying customs risks, maintaining audit-ready documentation and supporting compliance reviews.

Problem Solving & Judgement – Able to interpret complex customs requirements and provide practical, well-reasoned solutions.

Stakeholder Management – Experience working effectively with suppliers, customs authorities and internal teams including Procurement, Logistics and Finance.

Communication & Influencing – Able to explain complex customs requirements clearly and provide guidance to different audiences.

Education/Experience – Relevant qualification or equivalent significant practical experience in Customs, International Trade, Supply Chain, Logistics or Trade Compliance. European language skills are advantageous but not essential.

Travel – Willingness and ability to travel within the UK and Europe as required.

Join Papier as a Financial Accountant!
Location:Remote, based in South Africa
Duration:12 Month Fixed-Term Contract
Reports to: Finance Manager
Team:Finance
Salary:Competitive, with comprehensive benefits

About Papier
At Papier, we make analogue living more beautiful. We started in London in 2015 making beautifully designed stationery, and over the past ten years that’s grown into something bigger: a dedicated community of customers and fans, and collaborations with incredible design partners around the world. In a fast, digital-first world, analogue rituals help us think, feel, connect and create. Today we design tactile, made-to-be-kept products that invite people to write, play and gather: from journals, planners and photo books to games and accessories. With over £60 million raised and a growing presence in the UK, US and beyond, we’re building the modern brand for analogue living.

About the Role
Our Finance Team is small, hands-on and already using AI to change how we work - and we’re looking for a Financial Accountant to help us go further. You’ll focus on our operational finance processes, building on the automations we’ve already put in place and finding new ways to make them faster, smarter and more reliable.

You’ll own our day-to-day finance operations - AP and payment runs, credit control with retail partners like Target and Walmart, month-end reporting and tax compliance - and keep automating them as you go. Working with AI tools like Claude alongside NetSuite, you’ll take the workflows we’ve started and turn more of the downloading, matching and spreadsheet building into reliable, repeatable processes.

If you love a perfectly balanced reconciliation, get a real kick out of making a process faster and want to be part of a team that’s genuinely changing how finance works - this one’s for you!

Responsibilities

What You'll Do
You’ll join a small, close-knit Finance Team where everyone is bringing AI into the way we work. You’ll report into our Finance Manager and partner with teams across the business, especially Sales, Sourcing and Operations.

• You’ll build on the automations we already have, taking the AI workflows we’ve set up for things like bank uploads, payment platform reconciliations and supplier invoice posting, and making them more robust, reliable and widely used.
• You’ll automate more of our operational finance processes, spotting where manual work still sits across AP, AR and month end, then building, testing and rolling out new workflows using tools like Claude and NetSuite.
• You’ll run our accounts payable and payment runs, posting supplier invoices, preparing the twice-monthly payment run, reviewing payment listings against our cashflow forecast and being the friendly voice behind our finance inbox - with automation taking the heavy lifting out of each step.
• You’ll look after credit control and cash collection, posting customer receipts, keeping our AR ledger tidy and chasing overdue invoices with partners like Target, Walmart and Faire, collaborating closely with our Sales team.
• You’ll play a key role in our month-end close, completing balance sheet reconciliations (accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, provisions) and helping automate more of them, so we close faster and have more time for detailed analytical review of the P&L.
• You’ll support our tax compliance and reporting, preparing our UK VAT, Australian GST and European VAT returns, using AI to pull and organise the data from NetSuite and Looker.
• You’ll share what you learn with the team, swapping ideas on what’s working as we collaboratively work towards being a modern finance team

Requirements

About You
You'll be a great fit if...

• You’re an experienced, qualified finance professional with a solid grounding in AP, AR, month-end reporting and tax compliance. You’ll hold a recognised finance qualification (CA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), have strong working knowledge of UK GAAP / FRS 102 and at least three years of practical UK accounting experience.
• You’re excited by automation - you’ve used AI tools like Claude, Excel automation, Power Query or similar to make a finance process faster, and you’d love to do more of it alongside a team that feels the same.
• You think in processes, breaking a task into clear steps, spotting the bottlenecks and finding a better way - without ever losing sight of accuracy and controls.
• You’re confident working with large data sets and systems- strong Excel skills are a must, and NetSuite or Looker experience is a big plus (but we’ll happily teach you).
• You’re brilliantly organised and able to work to deadlines, keeping payment runs, month end and tax deadlines on track without dropping a plate.
• You have excellent spoken and written English and communicate clearly and kindly, whether you’re talking a teammate, chasing a retailer for payment or explaining a variance to someone outside of finance.
• You’ve got some indirect tax experience- especially UK VAT, Australian GST and European VAT. If you don’t, you’ll have a willingness to learn and we’ll happily provide the training and support!

Benefits

Life at Papier
🌴 Annual leave package
✨ A weekly wellness hour to log off & do whatever restores you
🎟️ Monthly cultural allowance for gigs, galleries, cinema, exhibitions & more
✏️ Personal stationery allowance every year
🛍️ 40% staff discount (and 20% for friends & family)
🌱 2 paid days a year to volunteer for a cause you care about
💚 Access to mental wellbeing resources and support
🫶 An inclusive, friendly team who'll make you feel welcome from day one!

Joining our Team
Your experience matters to us, but it’s not the whole story. If this role excites you and feels like the right fit, even if you don’t tick every bullet point, we’d still love to hear from you - after all, we believe in the power of a blank page!

jobs.description:
Description

Remote US - (frequent customer travel and regular communication time with R&D in Israel)

﻿About DriveNets

DriveNets is a leader in large-scale networking solutions for AI infrastructure and service providers. Founded in 2016, the company created a radical new way to build networks that substantially improves the network’s economic model and optimizes its utilization and efficiency.

DriveNets Network Cloud powers production networks for global tier-1 operators such as AT&T, Comcast and KDDI, and carries the majority of AT&T’s core backbone traffic. DriveNets AI Fabric, introduced in 2023, provides the highest-performance Ethernet-based AI networking solutions and the best Ethernet alternative to InfiniBand. It is used by hyperscalers, NeoClouds, and foundation model labs, and is sold in collaboration with partners like AMD and Broadcom. In June 2026, DriveNets closed a $410 million Series D round, bringing its total capital raised to $1 billion. The company has more than $1 billion in secured business.

Join us to build the infrastructure of the largest AI Factories in the world and the networks behind the world’s leading telecom operators. We are looking for talented people with experience in networking architecture, AI infrastructure, and Cybersecurity, who want to make a real impact. Learn more at drivenets.com.

DriveNets and AMD are now taking the next step together. Neoclouds that want AMD capacity can buy a complete AI Factory from DriveNets, built on AMD’s Helios rack-scale platform. DriveNets is accountable for the whole thing: every network in the data center (front-end, back-end scale-out and the connection to the in-rack scale-up network), cluster bring-up and installation, the operating software, and multi-year maintenance and support (M&S) across the entire estate, including the GPU compute trays.

Our premise is simple: AMD + DriveNets ≥ NVIDIA. NVIDIA sells a vertically integrated stack. We compete as the open, multi-vendor alternative, and AMD silicon plus a DriveNets fabric, software layer and service organization has to give customers the same confidence. The hard part is operations, not specs:

  • Helios is brand new. It is a first-generation rack-scale platform with no installed base, no field history and no library of known failures. We have to build that knowledge ourselves, together with AMD, while the first customers go live.
  • Neoclouds expect hyperscale uptime. Their customers are AI labs and inference companies that measure us by availability, time to first token and how quickly a degraded node is found and fixed. Every idle GPU costs them money.
  • We are accountable for components we did not build. GPUs, compute trays and scale-up switches come from AMD and its manufacturing partners. When something breaks, the customer calls DriveNets. We triage, coordinate the vendors and own the outcome.
  • Hardware faults are expensive. A failed GPU means swapping a whole compute tray. Every no-fault-found return ties up spares and leaves the real problem in the customer’s cluster, so finding the correct root cause quickly is critical.
  • Deployments are on-prem and often air-gapped. Data reaches us only with customer approval, so tooling, diagnostics and processes have to work under that constraint.

Our answer is the AI Cluster Orchestrator, DriveNets’ operations platform for the AI Factory. Foundation covers inventory, topology, day-zero validation and lifecycle. Performance & Reliability detects, triages and pinpoints faults and is backed by a shared Diagnostics library of failure modes. Care handles support cases, phone-home and evidence collection with customer approval. Security covers estate security and drift. It is meant to turn monitoring data into action, and the people in these roles will shape it as its first and most demanding users.

The first production AI Factory deployments, where DriveNets owns the whole stack, are planned for early 2027. We are building the support and customer-facing organization now, from scratch, to be ready for them.

The Role

We are looking for a customer facing product manager who lives with customers. Reporting to the CTO of the AI, you will be the voice of our neocloud customers inside the AI group and the product owner on the ground for the first AI Factory deployments. You will make sure that what we build in our AI Factory matches how neoclouds actually run their clusters. You will drive adoption from first rack to production, and you will support sales in proving that AMD + DriveNets is a credible alternative. The ideal candidate has already built and shipped an AI operations or cluster management product and knows what operators need on day two.

In this role you will work with: AI BU product managers and engineering, Chief Architect, Advanced Support and TAMs, sales and solution architects, AMD alliance team, and customers’ operations and platform teams.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Voice of the customer

  • Build deep relationships with the operations, SRE and platform teams at our AI Factory and design-partner customers, and understand their data centers, software stacks, tooling and what they build themselves.
  • Turn field input into clear problem statements, prioritized requirements and validated use cases for the AI Ops solution’s modules (Foundation, Performance & Reliability, Care, Security) and for tenant-facing tools.
  • Run structured validation: discovery interviews, demos of upcoming capabilities, design reviews and beta programs with design partners.

First-customer rollout and adoption

  • Own the product side of each early deployment, from day-zero validation through production, including success criteria, rollout plans, configuration and integration with the customer’s ticketing, scheduling and monitoring tools.
  • Track adoption and value (time to detect and pinpoint issues, uptime, NFF reduction, operator time saved) and turn the results into references and case studies.
  • Work with Advanced Support and TAMs so that product gaps found in the field reach the roadmap quickly and are fixed in the release cycle.

Pre-sales and go-to-market

  • Support sales and solution architects in customer meetings with demos, technical deep dives and answers on roadmap and competitive positioning (including NVIDIA’s integrated stack).
  • Help shape packaging, pricing inputs and messaging for the AI Factory with product marketing.
  • Represent Drivenets with AMD customer-facing teams and in joint customer engagements.

Product partnership

  • Work with the module PMs and Head of Product on roadmap priorities, and bring customer evidence to every major trade-off.
  • Write crisp customer-backed PRDs and acceptance criteria for the features you drive, and join architecture and UX reviews.

What success looks like in the first year

  • Every early AI Factory customer has a named product owner, a rollout plan and measurable success criteria, and reaches production successfully on Drivenets.
  • Roadmap decisions trace back to documented customer evidence, and design partners can say their input changed the product.
  • At least two customers are willing to act as public or private references for Drivenets.
  • Sales cycles get shorter because customers’ operational questions are answered with credible demos and data.

Requirements

Required

  • 7+ years in product management, solutions or technical field roles, including 3+ years as a PM for infrastructure software used by operators (cluster management, AIOps, observability, data-center or network management).
  • Shipped a product used to run GPU/AI clusters or large data-center fleets, ideally at a company like NVIDIA, Dell, HPE, Supermicro, a network vendor or a GPU cloud.
  • Solid technical grounding in AI infrastructure: GPU servers, high-performance networking, schedulers (Slurm, Kubernetes), telemetry and monitoring stacks.
  • Proven skill running customer discovery and turning messy field input into prioritized, testable requirements.
  • Comfortable in front of customers, from hands-on engineers to executives, including in pre-sales settings.
  • Strong writer, and able to work closely with a remote R&D team across time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AMD Instinct, ROCm or rack-scale AI systems.
  • Background in SRE or operations at a neocloud, hyperscaler or HPC center.
  • Experience with agentic/AI-driven operations products, MCP or LLM-based assistants.
  • Experience working with a strategic silicon or OEM partner on joint go-to-market.

Why join

This is a ground-floor role in a new business. You will help define how AI factories built on AMD are operated and supported, work with AMD’s engineering teams on a brand-new platform, and have direct influence on a product that is designed around the work you do.

More About DriveNets

Based in Israel with locations in Romania, US, India and Japan as well as extended teams, DriveNets operations cover more than twelve countries. With recognition by industry analysts and through partnerships with market leaders such as AMD, Broadcom, Dell and others, DriveNets is pushing market momentum, delivering the scale and efficiency that modern AI workloads demand. World Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced Quality Engineering & Test Automation Manager to lead a blended Quality Engineering team and build an AI-enabled, automation-first quality capability for World Travel Holdings (WTH). World Travel Holdings, headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a blended Quality Engineering team spanning manual, exploratory, regression, API, performance, accessibility, and automated testing.
  • Manage Quality Engineering team capacity, priorities, and delivery across active initiatives while simplifying, standardizing, and modernizing team processes.
  • Establish an onboarding process that helps Quality Engineering team members ramp quickly and consistently.
  • Build strong working partnerships across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering to establish shared ownership of quality throughout planning, design, development, delivery, and operation.

Automation Framework Strategy

  • Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a modern, scalable automation framework supporting web, mobile, accessibility, API, integration, performance, and regression testing.
  • Define the automation framework architecture, technical standards, tool selection criteria, coding patterns, and governance practices needed to create a consistent enterprise Quality Engineering approach.
  • Assess existing Quality Engineering tools, test suites, environments, and processes to identify modernization, consolidation, and automation opportunities.
  • Build a roadmap for migrating current testing practices into the future-state automation framework, balancing near-term delivery needs with long-term scalability and maintainability.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure Quality Engineering strategies, automation frameworks, test environments, and quality controls support modernization initiatives, cloud readiness, platform resiliency, and long-term technical health.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Transformation

  • Develop responsible adoption standards, measurement practices, and team skills for applying AI across Quality Engineering.
  • Design and evolve agentic Quality Engineering workflows that improve consistency, accelerate feedback, and reduce repetitive work while maintaining appropriate engineering oversight.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted test generation, execution, maintenance, optimization, coverage analysis, and quality insight capabilities.

Delivery Integration and Shift-Left Quality

  • Partner with Product Management and Business Analysts to improve requirement quality, acceptance criteria, maturity, testability, and shared understanding of business risk before development begins.

Engineering Productivity and Business Outcomes

  • Partner with engineering leaders to identify quality improvements that increase development throughput and support faster, more confident release cycles.
  • Reduce developer feedback cycles by improving quality visibility earlier in the software development lifecycle and making results timely, reliable, and actionable.

Quality Metrics and Continuous Improvement

Choose To Make A Difference

The part-time Medical Director serves as a member of the faculty to provide continuous, competent medical guidance to the Program Director and faculty. The Medical Director will assist the Program Director with development and ARC-PA accreditation for the program, and will assist in ensuring that both didactic instruction and supervised clinical practice experiences meet current practice standards as they relate to the PA role in providing patient care. The Medical Director will be involved in evaluating student performance; designing, implementing, coordinating and evaluating curriculum; participation in, and the development and routine review of, the program's curriculum and competencies; and accreditation related activities. The Medical Director will also serve as an advocate for the program within the medical and academic communities through active participation in the program. The Medical Director may be involved in providing instruction and clinical site development, as directed by the Program Director.

General Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Collaborate as a member of the programmatic leadership team to achieve a shared vision for the program.
  • Must be an active participant in the program and support the development of the program competencies to meet current practice standards as they relate to the PA role.
  • Serve as a strong advocate for the MPA program and the PA profession.
  • Foster relationships with key stakeholders and community partners to strengthen the MPA program.
  • Collaborate with the Program Director and MPA faculty to develop, review, and revise the program’s mission statement, program goals, and competencies as necessary.
  • Provide competent medical oversight to ensure the curriculum and supervised clinical practice experiences (SCPEs) reflect current standards of medical care and scope of PA practice.
  • May participate in the recruitment, development, and retention of high-quality clinical sites and preceptors to ensure quality and sufficiency of clinical slots.
  • Actively participate in the program’s evaluation process, self-study, and accreditation activities as required by the Accreditation Review Commission on Education for the Physician Assistant, Inc. (ARC-PA).
  • Advocate for the program within the medical community and promote interprofessional collaboration.

  • Perform administrative duties related to the Medical Director role, including assisting with faculty recruitment as needed.

jobs.title: Customer Engagement Associate - Phone Support
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT AGELESSRX Our mission is radical life extension.
jobs.description:
ABOUT AGELESSRX
Our mission is radical life extension. We’re here to beat death.

At AgelessRx, we’re building the infrastructure to accelerate breakthroughs in longevity and fundamentally change how people approach their health. At the center is a profitable, high-eight-figure telehealth business serving tens of thousands of paying members who want to improve their energy, sleep, strength, hormonal health, and overall quality of life.

We’re building something much bigger than a telehealth company. By helping people achieve their health goals, we’re also creating something researchers rarely have access to: real-world data from people using real interventions, tracked over time, with opportunities to participate in future clinical research.

We’ve intentionally built capabilities that many companies outsource, including our own decentralized clinical trial platform, an in-house clinical network, and an AI-native technology stack. Our research includes PEARL, a clinical trial studying rapamycin, and we’ve been recognized as an XPRIZE Healthspan finalist.

We think big. Growing from eight to nine figures in revenue is an important milestone, but it’s not the end goal. We believe healthcare will look fundamentally different in five years, and we intend to help drive that transformation.

We keep our team small by design. We look for people who take ownership, move quickly, embrace AI, pay attention to the details, and aren’t afraid to tackle difficult problems. You’ll have the autonomy, tools, and opportunity to make a meaningful impact without layers of bureaucracy. We’re building a team of people who want to do the work, not just oversee it.

OVERVIEW

As a Customer Engagement Associate, you will play a key role in delivering a positive patient experience through responsive phone support, proactive outreach, and effective problem-solving. Your primary responsibility will be handling inbound and outbound calls to address patient inquiries, resolve concerns, and provide updates on orders, prescriptions, and refills. Between calls, you will manage patient communications through our Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system and Zendesk, while prioritizing inbound phone coverage. You will also proactively engage with patients to address potential concerns before they escalate, collaborating with internal teams and external partners to provide timely resolutions and a seamless patient experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Phone Support & Patient Inquiries

  • Provide professional and accurate support through inbound and outbound phone calls, prioritizing inbound phone coverage throughout the workday.
  • Respond to patient inquiries, resolve concerns, and coordinate necessary follow-ups to maintain a high level of patient satisfaction.
  • Manage patient communications through the EMR and Zendesk between calls, remaining available for inbound phone support.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of AgelessRx products and services to effectively educate patients and address nonclinical questions.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation of patient interactions, outreach attempts, follow-ups, and outcomes across internal systems.

Proactive Outreach

  • Conduct scheduled proactive outreach through phone calls, messages, and email to address potential concerns, including product availability, shipping delays, replacements, and order changes.
  • Follow up on pending prescriptions and orders, including outstanding patient information, verification requirements, and shipping confirmations.
  • Engage with patients considering pausing or canceling services, using approved communication guidelines to address concerns, explain applicable processes, and confirm upcoming refill dates.
  • Support patient onboarding through proactive check-ins at key milestones, including initial orders and first shipments.
  • Complete assigned outreach activities within established timelines, providing clear updates and next steps to patients.

Escalation & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with the Medical Team and pharmacy partners to support prescription fulfillment, resolve patient concerns, and appropriately escalate clinical questions.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to resolve complex patient concerns while following established workflows, policies, and compliance requirements.
  • Meet established performance expectations related to service quality, productivity, responsiveness, turnaround times, and patient satisfaction.
  • Identify recurring patient concerns and recommend improvements to outreach strategies, internal workflows, and support resources, including help center content and AI-assisted tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least two years in a client-facing role; strong spoken and written communication and active listening.
  • Comfort with a primarily phone-based workday, consecutive calls, and unexpected outbound outreach.
  • Reliable follow-up, detailed documentation, multitasking, and independent work.
  • Ability to use approved scripts with judgment, solve nonclinical problems, and recognize when to escalate.
  • Interest in longevity and patient experience.
  • Phone support/contact-center experience; proactive outreach, retention or patient engagement.
  • Zendesk/help desk and EMR/patient-record experience.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and protected health information.
  • Ability to learn approved AI-assisted tools and give useful feedback.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Fintech Counsel will serve as the primary legal advisor supporting RealPage’s payment processing, money transmission, and consumer lending operations. This role works closely with the SVP, Legal & Compliance to execute product development and compliance strategies across RealPage Payments (ClientDirect), ResidentDirect, ClickPay, and Livble. The Fintech Counsel is responsible for delivering practical, business-oriented legal guidance on financial product design, regulatory compliance, consumer protection, banking and service provider relationships, regulatory examination support, and data rights, ensuring each business unit operates within applicable legal and regulatory frameworks while advancing strategic growth objectives.

Responsibilities

Product Design & Development Counsel

  • Provide legal review and guidance on the design and launch of new and modified financial products and features across RealPage Payments (ClientDirect), ResidentDirect, ClickPay, and Livble.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and business teams from ideation through go-to-market to identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risk.
  • Advise on payment network rules, card brand requirements, ACH operating rules, and applicable state and federal payment regulations.
  • Support development of consumer-facing disclosures, agreements, terms of service, and product documentation for payment and lending products.
  • Evaluate product changes for licensing, regulatory filing, and change notification obligations.
  • Legal and regulatory due diligence to assess risk and advise corporate development and executive leadership in connection with M&A transactions and related strategic planning and execution.

Compliance Program Support

  • Advise on compliance program requirements applicable to money services businesses (MSBs), payment processors, and consumer lenders, including BSA/AML, OFAC, and state money transmission laws.
  • Support development, review, and maintenance of policies, procedures, and controls designed to satisfy federal and state regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor and analyze emerging laws, regulations, agency guidance, and enforcement actions affecting fintech, payments, and consumer lending; communicate implications to leadership and affected business units.
  • Provide legal guidance on Livble’s consumer lending activities, including compliance with applicable federal consumer financial laws (e.g., TILA, ECOA, FCRA) and applicable state lending laws.
  • Assist in maintaining the compliance management system for in-scope business units.

Consumer Protection

  • Advise on consumer protection requirements applicable to payment processing and consumer lending, including UDAAP, Regulation E, Regulation Z, and applicable state consumer protection statutes.
  • Review marketing materials, disclosures, and consumer-facing communications for compliance with consumer protection standards.
  • Support complaint management processes, including analysis of consumer complaint data and identification of remediation measures.
  • Advise on fair lending and fair banking obligations applicable to Livble and other in-scope business units.
  • Assist in preparation of consumer compliance risk assessments and periodic self-assessments.

Banking & Service Provider Relationships

  • Negotiate and draft agreements with banking partners, payment networks, processors, program managers, and other financial services vendors.
  • Advise on bank-fintech partnership structures, including BaaS arrangements, agent relationships, and program management agreements.
  • Review and analyze sponsor bank agreements, operating procedures, and compliance requirements applicable to each in-scope business unit.
  • Support ongoing management of banking and service provider relationships, including compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory expectations applicable to third-party risk management.
  • Assist with due diligence for prospective banking, payments, and lending partners.

Regulatory Examination & Agency Relationship Support

  • Coordinate and support regulatory examinations, supervisory inquiries, and information requests from federal and state financial regulators (e.g., FTC, CFPB, NYDFS, state banking departments, FinCEN).
  • Assist in preparation of examination responses, management presentations, and supporting documentation.
  • Track examination findings and support implementation of required corrective actions and remediation plans.
  • Maintain awareness of regulatory priorities and examination trends applicable to payments and consumer lending businesses.
  • Support maintenance of state money transmission licenses and other regulatory authorizations applicable to in-scope business units.

Data Rights & Privacy

  • Advise on data rights, data sharing, and data monetization issues applicable to financial products and consumer financial data.
  • Provide guidance on the application of financial privacy laws (e.g., GLBA, FCRA) and state privacy statutes to payment processing, money transmission, and consumer lending activities.
  • Review data processing agreements, data use policies, and data sharing arrangements with banking partners and service providers.
  • Support compliance with open banking regulations and consumer data rights requirements as applicable to in-scope business units.
  • Partner with the privacy and information security teams to address data governance issues arising from financial product development and operations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an ABA-accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.
  • Minimum five (5) years of legal experience, with substantial focus on financial services, payments, money transmission, or consumer financial products, in a law firm or in-house legal department. Prior experience at relevant governmental or regulatory agencies a plus.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on payment processing, money services business operations, and/or consumer lending programs.
  • Working knowledge of federal consumer financial laws and regulations, including BSA/AML, Regulation E, Regulation Z, TILA, ECOA, FCRA, UDAAP, and GLBA.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating financial services agreements, including bank partnership agreements, payment processing agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations or supervisory inquiries by state or federal financial regulators.
  • Familiarity with state money transmission licensing requirements and NMLS.
  • Proficiency with MS Office and collaboration tools (Teams, SharePoint).

Preferred:

  • In-house legal experience at a fintech company, payment processor, bank, or financial services firm.
  • Experience with BaaS (Banking-as-a-Service) arrangements, program management structures, or sponsoring bank relationships.
  • Familiarity with CFPB supervision and examination processes.
  • Experience advising on consumer lending products, including point-of-sale financing, rent-related credit products, or installment lending.
  • Knowledge of open banking and consumer financial data access requirements.
  • Experience in a PropTech, SaaS, or technology company with embedded financial products.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES

  • Strong analytical and legal research skills with the ability to synthesize complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly present legal and regulatory issues to non-legal business stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive legal and compliance matters.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, finance, and compliance.
  • Self-directed with the ability to manage projects and deliverables with limited supervision.
  • Commitment to staying current on legal and regulatory developments in payments, money transmission, and consumer financial services.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must have the ability to operate a personal computer and express or exchange ideas by means of the spoken word. May be required to sit and/or stand for long periods of time. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. May be required to lift or move 10+ pounds.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.

Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

jobs.description:
Career Category

Corporate Services

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Senior Manager, Corporate Affairs, Oncology


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead U.S. and global communications for key oncology brands, including xaluritamig and BLINCYTO, developing strategies and programs that support brand priorities, key milestones and business objectives.

In this role, reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate Affairs, Oncology, you will lead communications strategies that support business priorities, build understanding of Amgen’s oncology medicines and strengthen our reputation. You will partner with commercial leaders, brand teams and other cross-functional colleagues to develop impactful communications, advise on complex issues and drive measurable results.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute integrated U.S. and global communications strategies for xaluritamig and BLINCYTO, aligned with commercial objectives, audience insights and business priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic communications counselor to brand and cross-functional leaders, identifying communications opportunities, risks and recommendations.
  • Lead communications planning for significant data, regulatory and other milestones, including media strategy, messaging, outreach approach and spokesperson preparation.
  • Drive integrated communications campaigns and content across earned, owned, social, digital and internal channels to engage priority audiences.
  • Collaborate with Commercial, Medical, Legal, Regulatory and other cross-functional partners to ensure communications are accurate, compliant and aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner with Corporate Affairs colleagues, including Enterprise Media and Social Media, Advocacy Relations, to ensure coordinated communications strategies.
  • Anticipate and manage emerging issues, assess business and reputational implications, and recommend appropriate communications responses.
  • Use audience insights, data, social listening and measurement to inform communications strategies, evaluate performance and optimize results.
  • Manage agency partners, budgets and deliverables, ensuring high-quality work, clear accountability and effective use of resources.
  • Identify opportunities to responsibly use AI, digital tools and emerging technologies to improve communications effectiveness and efficiency.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The communications professional we seek is an experienced communicator with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology communications experience.

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology communications experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 6 years pharmaceutical or biotechnology communications experience.

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology communications experience.

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology communications experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology communications, with oncology and marketed product communications experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting U.S. and global brand communications, including clinical data, regulatory milestones and product launches.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate commercial priorities and complex scientific information into integrated communications strategies that deliver measurable results.
  • Experience advising commercial and cross-functional leaders on communications strategy, emerging issues and reputational considerations.
  • Strong understanding of the oncology stakeholder landscape, including healthcare professionals, patients, advocacy organizations and media.
  • Experience applying audience insights, analytics, digital engagement and emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen communications effectiveness.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Many of our team work remotely but we have a London office in Old Street which we use regularly. We are happy to be flexible in terms of where in the country you prefer to be based.

The Role:
We are reshaping our finance function and are adding an experienced, hands-on accountant to keep the finance engine running day to day.

The role involves core accounting, month-end close, billing, payroll and audit support, working alongside our Finance Director to ensure our processes support the wider organisation.

What you'll do:

Core accounting and month-end close
  • Run day-to-day accounting in Xero: journals, accruals and prepayments, fixed asset register, bank and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Deliver the month-end close to timetable and prepare management accounts with supporting analysis
  • Maintain the integrity of the Xero ledger and keep it set up to work well for the business
Billing, credit control and order to cash
  • Run monthly customer billing: platform fee invoices raised in advance on the first working day, then variable usage billing for the prior month
  • Make sure renewals, pricing changes and new customers flow correctly from Salesforce into billing, working with sales and customer success
  • Own credit control and the aged debtors cycle, and process supplier invoices, payments and expenses
Payroll, pensions and tax
  • Run monthly payroll end to end, including pension contributions, HMRC submissions and year-end returns, with full discretion over confidential data
  • Prepare quarterly VAT returns and provide the inputs for corporation tax computations and the R&D claim
  • Statutory, audit and controls
  • Support the statutory audit: prepare year-end schedules and deliverables and respond to auditor queries
  • Apply the internal control framework: payment approvals, authorisation limits, reconciliation discipline and accounting policies
Continuity and improvement
  • Provide cover across finance operations (accounts payable, credit control, payroll) and for parts of the Finance Director's work when needed
  • Document key processes, then help streamline and automate the recurring manual work across order to cash, credit control and expense management

What we're looking for:

Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience, with substantial hands-on experience in a growing business of running each of the following yourself, end to end and without close supervision:
  • the month-end close to timetable, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations;
  • monthly payroll and pensions, including HMRC submissions and the payroll year-end;
  • customer billing and credit control;
  • quarterly VAT returns; and
  • preparing year-end schedules and dealing with auditor queries through at least one statutory audit.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a systems-focused C++ Software Engineer to architect, build, and optimize ultra-low-latency, high-throughput applications where microseconds and nanoseconds directly impact performance.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a systems-focused C++ Software Engineer to architect, build, and optimize ultra-low-latency, high-throughput applications where microseconds and nanoseconds directly impact performance. You will take ownership of mission-critical software across the entire lifecycle—from low-level memory and network optimization to production deployment—working closely with quantitative researchers, infrastructure engineers, and core product teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain deterministic, fault-tolerant C++ (C++17/C++20/C++23) services capable of processing massive volumes of real-time data.
  • Profile, benchmark, and tune critical execution paths to minimize tail latency, jitter, and CPU/memory overhead.
  • Build and optimize low-level networking, messaging, and I/O layers using kernel-bypass technologies and custom protocols.
  • Leverage deep knowledge of CPU architecture, cache locality, branch prediction, and lock-free programming to maximize throughput.
  • Partner directly with cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements into clean, maintainable, and testable production code.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Modern C++ Mastery: 4+ years of hands-on production experience writing modern C++ (C++17/20) with deep knowledge of template metaprogramming, memory management, and the STL.
  • Proven track record building latency-sensitive, multi-threaded, concurrent, or lock-free systems.
  • Strong command of the Linux operating system, including kernel tuning, thread scheduling, virtual memory, and systems programming.
  • Solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/UDP, Multicast) and socket programming.
  • Experience with kernel-bypass networking (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, RDMA).
  • Prior experience in electronic trading, market data feeds, exchange connectivity (FIX/binary protocols), ad-tech, gaming engines, or telecommunications.

jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans cette fonction de consultant senior spécialisé en méthodologie d’archivage et en gouvernance des données, vous :

  • dresserez un état des lieux des pratiques, exigences, contraintes et risques liés à la conservation, à l’archivage et à la suppression des données dans les applications opérationnelles et la data platform ;
  • concevrez et mettrez en œuvre une méthodologie d’archivage de bout en bout, couvrant la classification des données, les règles de rétention, les critères d’éligibilité, les procédures d’archivage et de purge, l’anonymisation ou la pseudonymisation, l’accès aux archives, la restauration, la traçabilité et les contrôles ;
  • veillerez à la conformité de cette méthodologie avec le RGPD, les exigences de confidentialité, les obligations légales et contractuelles de conservation ainsi que les politiques internes de sécurité et de gouvernance des données ;
  • analyserez les flux de données et proposerez des scénarios d’implémentation adaptés aux différents environnements, en tenant compte des architectures applicatives, des dépendances, de la volumétrie, des performances, des coûts et des besoins d’audit ;
  • élaborerez les livrables nécessaires : principes directeurs, matrice de rétention, processus et rôles, exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles, recommandations d’architecture, feuille de route et indicateurs de suivi ;
  • animerez des ateliers avec les parties prenantes des métiers, de la Data, de l’Architecture, de la Sécurité, du Juridique et de la fonction DPO, puis accompagnerez les équipes dans l’appropriation de la méthodologie.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Senior Consultant Archiveringsmethodologie en Data Governance:

  • maakt u een stand van zaken op van de huidige werkwijzen, vereisten, beperkingen en risico’s rond het bewaren, archiveren en verwijderen van gegevens in operationele applicaties en het dataplatform;
  • definieert en implementeert u een end-to-end archiveringsmethodologie voor gegevensclassificatie, bewaarregels, geschiktheidscriteria, archiverings- en verwijderingsprocedures, anonimisering of pseudonimisering, toegang tot archieven, herstel, traceerbaarheid en controles;
  • zorgt u ervoor dat de methodologie voldoet aan de AVG, vertrouwelijkheidsvereisten, wettelijke en contractuele bewaarverplichtingen en interne beleidsregels voor gegevensbeveiliging en governance;
  • analyseert u de dataflows en stelt u implementatiescenario’s voor die zijn afgestemd op verschillende omgevingen, met aandacht voor applicatiearchitecturen, afhankelijkheden, volume, prestaties, kosten en auditvereisten;
  • werkt u de nodige deliverables uit, waaronder leidende principes, een bewaarmatrix, processen en rollen, functionele en niet-functionele vereisten, architectuuraanbevelingen, een roadmap en monitoringindicatoren;
  • leidt u workshops met stakeholders uit de business-, data-, architectuur-, security-, juridische en DPO-teams en ondersteunt u de teams bij de toepassing van de methodologie.

📝 Votre profil

  • Vous maîtrisez couramment l’anglais.
  • Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de bonnes capacités de communication et de proactivité. Ces qualités seront notamment évaluées lors de l’entretien.
  • Vous disposez d’une expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de méthodologies d’archivage.
  • Vous maîtrisez la gestion du cycle de vie des données (Data Lifecycle Management).
  • Vous connaissez l’application du RGPD à la conservation, à l’archivage et à la suppression des données.
  • Vous avez utilisé une plateforme de données pour l’archivage de données.
  • Vous disposez d’une expérience démontrable dans le domaine et avec les technologies concernées.
  • Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de méthodologies d’archivage pour des applications opérationnelles telles que SAP ou Salesforce.
  • Vous avez de l’expérience avec les systèmes de gestion de bases de données relationnelles, notamment Oracle et SQL Server.
  • Une expérience dans le secteur public ou dans un environnement réglementé constitue un atout.
  • Vous maîtrisez l’analyse des flux de données.

Position Overview

Customer Success Managers serve as the customer’s named partner from the point of sale through onboarding, deployment, and ongoing service, coordinating across Sales, Operations, Field Services, Technical Support, Engineering, Product, and Finance to deliver clear ownership, proactive communication, and measurable value.

Strengthen Strategic Customer Management

Standardize Service Reviews and Executive Engagement

Who We Are

NeuroFlow CEO and West Point graduate Christopher Molaro served in the army for five years, including a tour in Iraq as a platoon leader. Coming back home, he experienced firsthand the gaps in the behavioral health system and how veterans and civilians alike face too many barriers when it comes to receiving appropriate, timely care.

While pursuing his MBA at Wharton, Chris met his future co-founder Adam Pardes, and the two agreed – even the most engaging digital mental health apps in the world wouldn’t truly change the problem; only a solution that systematically integrated behavioral health into the full healthcare ecosystem could create meaningful change. And so they created NeuroFlow.

What We Do

We pride ourselves on partnering with healthcare leaders to assist in driving better outcomes, lowering total cost of care, and making behavioral health risk more predictable and transparent. NeuroFlow exists to make sure no one who needs behavioral health support falls through the cracks.

We build more than just engaging digital health tools for self-care: we create platforms that identify population behavioral health risk early, engage individuals with acuity-specific resources, and enable care teams to make smarter and more efficient decisions. Together, NeuroFlow’s solutions arm healthcare organizations with the insights they need to overcome the systemic challenges in today’s healthcare ecosystem.

How We Do It

The award-winning culture at NeuroFlow is one built around encouragement and daring to be great. Our core values have been displayed in our office since day one, and each team member is responsible for carrying out these values and keeping each other accountable to them. We succeed through our flexibility and agility, navigating and transforming an industry ripe for change where “no” or “can’t” is too often the default. NeuroFlow offers unique opportunities to work in a fun and challenging fast-paced environment with direct, meaningful impact on helping to close the divide between mental and physical health.

NeuroFlow is backed by investors including HLM Venture Partners, SEMCAP Health, Concord Health Partners, Builders VC, and Dreamit, alongside grant funding from the National Science Foundation and the U.S. Department of Defense.

Our work has been recognized by TIME Magazine as one of the World's Top HealthTech Companies of 2025, by Fierce Healthcare's 2026 Fierce15, and by MedTech Breakthrough's Best Overall Mental Health Solution award.

About the team & Opportunity:

The Care Navigation team is responsible for working directly with patients and their providers to connect them to mental health care. We respond to referrals from a patient’s referring provider and proactively reach out to patients who have mental health needs. Our goal is to reduce the challenges that patients face in their search for care, and strive to make the process as seamless as possible in order to connect them to their physicians for proper mitigation of their symptoms.

This role is Full Time from 9am-6pm EST .

  • Administrative duties:
    • Thorough documentation of patient and/or provider interactions.
    • Utilize Neuroflow technology, tools, messaging, and workflows.
    • Support administrative tasks needed by the Care Navigation and Clinical Operations Team.
    • Establish a core understanding of Neuroflow’s product, in order to successfully route a patient to the right care.
    • Apply foundational knowledge of our workflows and market nuances to assist patients in their journey to care.

  • Measures of success:

    • Answer targeted percentage of patient and/or provider phone calls each day in a timely manner.
    • Commitment to standardized Care Support Specialist performance metrics.
    • Provide exceptional customer service to patients and/or providers while connecting them with care or troubleshooting the reason for their call.
  • Collaboration:
    • Investigate and surface patient and/or provider needs as necessary to a Care Navigator, Clinical Care Navigator, and/or Manager.
    • Communicate clearly with the patients’ Care Navigator to share knowledge on the patients’ treatment needs and preferences.
    • Work cross-functionally to improve patient outcomes.
