If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As an HRIS & People Technology Operations Specialist, you will own and optimize our People tech stack. This role goes well beyond HRIS administration: you’ll work across our HRIS and the wider set of people-related tools and integrations, using automation and AI to keep data accurate, remove manual work and give teams the reports and tools they need to work independently.

You’ll work closely with the People Operations team to make sure our systems, workflows and data support a fast-growing, global, contractor-based workforce. You’ll thrive here if you’re tech-savvy, highly organised and energised by a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the go-to administrator for our HRIS and other people related tools managing fields, tables, permission groups and access levels.

  • Manage data imports, mass uploads and regular data audits to keep records accurate and up to date.

  • Build and maintain hiring, onboarding and offboarding flows, task lists, reminders and approval workflows.

  • Create reports and dashboards for teams and leadership across the full employee lifecycle, from candidate to exit.

  • Identify manual processes and automate them, using HRIS and other features, integration and automation platforms and AI tools to reduce repetitive work for the HR team and managers.

  • Explore, evaluate and introduce new people-related tools and integrations to speed up People Operations tasks, such as data checks, documentation, reporting and support.

  • Be the first point of contact for technical questions on People systems, and create guides and short training videos for teams and admins.

  • Work with vendors’ customer success teams on escalations, new features and best practices.

  • Manage multiple priorities with tight deadlines, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Proven, hands-on expertise as an administrator or system owner of an HRIS (workflows, reports, permissions, imports, performance cycles) and an ATS (job pipelines, hiring workflows, scorecards, candidate data). Experience with HiBob is highly preferred.

  • Strong working knowledge of the broader people-tech ecosystem and of connecting these tools through integrations and automation.

  • Practical, hands-on experience using automation and AI tools to streamline workflows, with examples of processes you have automated.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and confidence working with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Highly organised, with the ability to work independently, prioritise and meet deadlines.

  • Comfortable in, and genuinely enjoys, a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Tech-savvy, a quick learner, and able to pick up new tools and processes fast.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in HR or People Operations, such as recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, contracts or time off.

  • Experience with automation or integration platforms or light scripting.

  • Experience supporting multiple entities or international, contractor-based teams.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Confluence or Google Workspace.

  • A passion for technology and innovation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We are currently seeking a talented Senior Data Warehouse Developer on behalf of a major International Organization.

Job Profile

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Warehouse Developer to join our international organization and contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of modern, scalable, and high-performing data warehouse and business intelligence solutions.

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of experience in Data Warehouse Development and 8+ years of overall IT experience, with strong expertise in the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem, including Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Azure AI services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Warehouse Development: Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise-level data warehouse solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, reliability, and data integrity.
  • Azure SQL: Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and database structures, ensuring efficient data processing and high performance.
  • Azure Data Factory: Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory to support data integration, transformation, and orchestration across multiple data sources.
  • Azure Functions: Develop and maintain serverless functions to support data processing, automation, integrations, and event-driven workflows.
  • Microsoft Fabric: Contribute to the design and implementation of modern data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Pipelines, and related capabilities.
  • Power BI: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, semantic models, and data visualizations, enabling business users to access meaningful insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Azure AI: Explore, integrate, and leverage Azure AI capabilities to enhance data processing, analytics, automation, and intelligent business solutions.
  • Data Integration & Transformation: Design and implement efficient data integration processes, ensuring data consistency and quality across multiple systems and platforms.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize data warehouse components, SQL queries, data pipelines, and reporting solutions to ensure optimal performance and resource utilization.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Implement best practices for data quality, data validation, security, documentation, and governance.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with international IT teams, data engineers, architects, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver effective technical solutions.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of overall experience in IT, including a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Warehouse Development.
  • Strong experience in designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise data warehouse and data integration solutions.
  • Advanced knowledge of Azure SQL, including database development, complex SQL queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, including ETL/ELT development, pipeline orchestration, data integration, and monitoring.
  • Experience developing and integrating Azure Functions for data processing, automation, and system integration.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric, including its data engineering and data warehousing capabilities.

  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with Azure AI services and capabilities, including their integration into data and analytics solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data architecture, and data lifecycle management.
  • Experience working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple sources.
  • Good understanding of data security, data governance, data quality, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating with distributed or international teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Very good command of English, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

  • Microsoft certifications related to Azure Data Engineering, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or Azure AI.
  • Experience with Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, or other modern data engineering platforms.
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages used in data engineering and automation.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance, metadata management, and data catalog solutions.
  • Exposure to Generative AI and AI-powered analytics solutions.
  • Previous experience in a multinational or international organization.

jobs.excerpt: Description We're looking for a hands-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems.
jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a hands-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems.

We're taking a different approach to Customer Success. Rather than primarily coaching customers on how to use Insycle, our team works directly in their environments to investigate problems, build solutions, and deliver results. Think of it as Customer Success with a Forward Deployed Engineer mindset.

With our secure Support Access, you'll be able to configure and test solutions directly in customers' Insycle environments. Customers retain control over approving and executing changes to their CRM data.

You'll own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, ongoing adoption, renewals, and expansion. You'll build relationships, understand customers' business challenges, and help them get lasting value from Insycle.

This role combines hands-on technical problem-solving with customer relationships and business understanding. You'll have the autonomy to investigate challenges, design practical solutions, and see your work make a difference.

Location: Remote. We're looking for candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones who can collaborate effectively with our team and customers during U.S. business hours.

What you’ll do

Solve customer data challenges

  • Understand customers' business goals and translate their requirements into practical data solutions.
  • Investigate CRM records, fields, workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes.
  • Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf.
  • Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results.
  • Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved.

Drive adoption and customer outcomes

  • Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly.
  • Help customers move from one-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability.
  • Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases.
  • Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle.

Build relationships and grow accounts

  • Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion.
  • Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes.
  • Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk.
  • Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth.

Improve how we work

  • Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience.
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results.
  • Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: You have 3+ years of experience in technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, RevOps, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
  • Customer account ownership: You have experience directly managing ongoing customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts, taking responsibility for customer outcomes, adoption, and retention—not solely responding to technical support requests.
  • Technical problem-solving: You enjoy investigating complex problems, working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions.
  • CRM and data experience: You're comfortable with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms, including data management, business rules, workflows, and automation.
  • Ownership and initiative: You work independently, take responsibility for outcomes, and follow through without needing constant direction.
  • Customer communication: You can explain technical concepts clearly, understand business needs, and build strong customer relationships.
  • Judgment and attention to detail: You think through consequences, validate your work, and favor simple, reliable solutions.
  • Teamwork and growth: You enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, learning from feedback, and helping the team improve.

Experience with CRM data quality, deduplication, data transformation, record matching, or integrations is a plus. Software development experience is not required.

Why join Insycle

You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help.

We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth.

How we work

Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team:

  • Care deeply: Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed.
  • Everyone builds: Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions.
  • Better together: Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success.
  • Quality counts: Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results.
  • Positive energy: Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges.
  • Own the outcome: Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results.
  • Choose simplicity: Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity.
  • Raise the bar: Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve.

Compensation and benefits

  • Annual base salary of CAD $90,000 - $115,000, depending on relevant experience and location.
  • Annual performance-based bonus with a target of 10% of base salary.
  • Equity through stock options.
  • Paid time off, sick leave, flexibility for unexpected needs, and paid holidays.

Company Overview

Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce.

Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system.

Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time.

As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards.

We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Content Strategy & Innovation, Director


The Director of Content Strategy and Innovation is responsible for executing and overseeing the company’s content capabilities, improving adoption of tools and services, and driving innovation through emerging technologies. This role owns day-to-day content strategy and production, leads the in-house design team, manages the Agencies and Suppliers Management team, and oversees the Taxonomy and Metadata team.

Key Responsibilities:

Content Strategy Execution


  • Support the development and lead the execution of Amgen’s enterprise content strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals, target audiences, and transformation initiatives.
  • Partner with Business Leads, Portfolio Leads, Digital Product Managers, and transformation stakeholders to translate business use cases into audience-driven content strategies and multichannel content roadmaps.

Content Production Leadership


  • Lead the in-house design team and oversee the production of content assets, including design, copywriting, and video editing.
  • Define and implement production plans and roadmaps aligned with content strategy priorities and audience engagement plans.
  • Support the development of reusable content standards, governance frameworks, and quality assurance processes. Maintain these practices to ensure brand consistency, regulatory compliance, and efficient medical and legal review.
  • Develop channel-specific production requirements and templates for HCP, patient, customer, and internal stakeholder content.
  • Maximize production efficiency and effectiveness, including usability, accessibility, and digital channel curation.
  • Partner with creative, marketing operations, medical, legal, compliance, privacy, brand, and digital teams to ensure content is brand-aligned, compliant, and production-ready.
  • Manage the Agencies and Suppliers Management team and day-to-day relationships with external creative agencies, translation services, production vendors, and platform partners. Oversee service-level agreements, quality standards, and cost benchmarks.

Taxonomy and Metadata


  • Lead the Taxonomy and Metadata team and formalize a capability roadmap that aligns with the Content Strategy roadmap.
  • Guide taxonomy and metadata frameworks for classifying content, channels, and business domains.
  • Guide the implementation and maintenance of taxonomy and metadata standards across content management systems and marketing automation tools. Oversee the partnership between the Taxonomy and Metadata team and the Technology team.
  • Monitor taxonomy and metadata quality through regular reviews and reporting, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure the Taxonomy and Metadata team has the skills, tools, and support to maintain enterprise standards.

Innovation and Emerging Technology


  • Lead the development and implementation of new content formats and channels, partnering with the Technology team as appropriate.
  • Establish foundational capabilities to support the business, such as AI content generation technology and self-service tools.
  • Experiment with emerging technologies to create innovative, sustainable, and engaging content experiences. Partner with the lead of Agencies and Suppliers Management to identify and implement promising solutions.

Transformation Adoption and Governance


  • Drive adoption of content platforms, content management systems, taxonomy and metadata standards, and audience intelligence tools across the enterprise by communicating their value and setting clear expectations.
  • Execute the portfolio transformation roadmap, including dependencies, milestones, risks, and budget tracking. Identify efficiencies within the strategy and innovation budget.
  • Represent content strategy in working-level governance forums with Business Leads, Portfolio Leads, Digital Product Managers, and transformation stakeholders. Surface decisions, escalate blockers, and document wins.
  • Manage cross-pillar interdependencies with Marketing Excellence, Media, technology, data and analytics, and regional marketing teams.
  • Build and execute enablement communications that support role clarity, onboarding, and workflow integration across groups.
  • Measure and analyze content workstream performance, partnering with cross-functional teams to develop and implement corrective actions.
  • Build and coordinate value realization reporting, identifying wins, blockers, and the actions and owners needed to advance transformation priorities.
  • Support the adoption of emerging technologies among internal Amgen stakeholders and select third parties to advance Content Transformation initiatives.

Executive Communication


  • Prepare executive-ready decision materials that connect content strategy, innovation, adoption initiatives, and outcomes to business value, and identify escalation paths needed to make progress.
  • Develop narratives that bring capability work to life for stakeholders at all levels, from product management to executive leadership.

Team and Relationship Leadership


  • Lead the Content Strategy and Innovation team, providing guidance, support, and performance management; support hiring and professional development.
  • Ensure the team delivers on priorities set by Amgen leadership and realizes the value of Content Transformation.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, partners, and vendors.

What we expect of you


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The content strategy leader we seek has built and led this kind of function before and brings the following qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:


  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of content strategy, media, and/or design, including editorial or content leadership experience in a media or interactive environment OR
  • Master’s degree and 7 years of content strategy, media, and/or design, including editorial or content leadership experience in a media or interactive environment OR

  • Experience working with emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and augmented reality.

Confidential Search · Defense Technology

Confidential search. The hiring company's identity and full role details are shared with candidates under NDA.

About the Role

This is a fast-growing 500+ person defense-technology company building autonomous aerial systems and counter-UAS and air defense capabilities for US government customers. The Growth organization sells and executes contracts across both product lines and runs the capability showcases, demonstrations, and training that go with them.

This is the first fully dedicated business development lead for the Department of Homeland Security, and the counter-UAS and air defense line is the natural way in. Former DHS, IC, and 3-letter agency types are encouraged to apply.

You will build the roadmap for how the company wins Homeland Security, get it bought internally, and then execute it. The seat is an individual contributor role over a very large account, with more junior business development hires expected underneath it as the account grows, and a deliberate path toward broader leadership of the US growth organization.

Responsibilities

  • Own DHS and its components as a customer end to end: strategy, pipeline, and close.
  • Build the account roadmap from zero, sequence the first doors, and get internal buy-in.
  • Shape requirements with the customer, navigate DHS authorities and appropriations, and carry opportunities through award.
  • Bring and activate an existing network across component program offices and operational users.
  • Position counter-UAS and air defense capability against airspace security, border, and critical infrastructure protection needs.
  • Navigate the interagency, state, and local overlay that Homeland work brings with it.
  • Set expectations that engineering can actually meet, and bring bad news early when they cannot.
  • Grow and lead a team underneath you as the account scales.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Roughly 15 years of relevant experience. Still energized and hands-on. This seat cannot absorb someone learning the buying path on the job.
  • Has carried business through a DHS component: CBP and Air and Marine Operations, Coast Guard, ICE, Secret Service, TSA, or DHS Science and Technology.
  • Can articulate clearly how selling to DHS differs from selling to a DoD program office, in specifics rather than generalities.
  • A live DHS network that can be activated now, with named offices and people.
  • Ability to operate autonomously and build a plan where none exists.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Service in or alongside a DHS component. Military service is not required for this seat; a DHS civilian career track is fully in scope.
  • Coast Guard background, which bridges military experience and DHS authorities.
  • Counter-UAS or airspace security sales with an established Homeland Security book of business.
  • Federal law enforcement program experience that came with a buying relationship.

Not a Fit

  • Commercial-only sellers. Enterprise B2B software sales does not translate to the federal buying process.
  • DoD sellers who treat Homeland Security as the same motion. The money, the authorities, and the acquisition rhythm are materially different.

Process

  • This is a confidential search. An NDA is required before the company's identity and full role details are shared. We screen for interest at a high level first, then read candidates in once an NDA is in place.
  • Any clearance requirement is confirmed with candidates during screening.
  • Candidates are submitted and tracked through the company's applicant tracking system.

Job Summary

The Senior Technical Advisor for Emergency Response serves as a subject matter expert who provides leadership in designing and guiding the technical direction for highly complex emergency responses across the STRIDES global portfolio. This position will serve as a senior scientific advisor during public health emergencies and provide technical and clinical guidance to internal staff and external partners including, US Government agencies, and other implementing partners. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality of existing projects globally, setting strategies, guiding the investment of resources, and overseeing technical aspects. The Senior Technical Advisor is accountable for developing technical strategies, operational plans, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and budgetary requirements. Specifically, this position will lead global preparedness, surveillance, and outbreak response activities for viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF) including Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), and other high consequence pathogens. The Senior Technical Advisor will serve as a VHF technical expert and provide expert clinical recommendations and guidance around infection prevention and control strategies prior to and during such public health emergencies. The role includes staff development, mentoring, and overall responsibility for large-scale technical initiatives.

Responsibilities/Duties

Complexity & Problem Solving:

  • Develop and oversee the technical components of complex global health emergency responses within financial constraints.
  • Coordinate technical teams deployed to support cross-functional response activities.
  • Monitor epidemiological trends and use data to guide operational decision-making.
  • Review surveillance reports and provide recommendations for response adjustments based on updated epidemiological data.
  • Facilitate daily incident management meetings, situation reviews, and operational planning sessions.
  • Ensure alignment of response activities with national and international Ebola response protocols and guidelines.
  • Guide the development of best practices and ensure technical implementation aligns with global gold standards for emergency response.
  • Create mitigation plans to proactively identify risks or challenges to technical deliverables.

Discretion & Impact:

  • Exercise significant judgment in decision-making that impacts project outcomes, financial budgets, and organizational goals.
  • Ensure technical components meet funder contractual obligations and regulatory compliance for highly complex units.
  • Provides project staff with overall technical direction and guidance in line with STRIDES’ expected outcomes.
  • Monitors and maintains project protocols, instruments, data sets, manuals, training materials and reports related to technical area of expertise.

Collaboration & Interaction:

  • Foster collaborative relationships with donors, government agencies, and NGOs to support project execution.
  • Lead client and funder meetings, acting as the primary point of contact for technical activities.
  • Provide technical input in business development meetings and client presentations.
  • Maintain consistent technical exchange with field counterparts, implementing partners, and internal stakeholders.

Management & Supervision:

  • Provide technical oversight of STRIDES BVD outbreak preparedness and response activities globally.
  • Supervise and mentor technical staff, providing guidance to ensure high-quality project execution and professional development.
  • Manage staff assignments and workload distribution to meet project timelines and deliverables.
  • Provide guidance to deployed response teams, government counterparts and implementing partners
  • Provide strategic leadership in the preparation of financial and technical reports for sponsors and partners.
  • Embraces other duties as assigned, contributing to the team’s multifaceted and evolving responsibilities.

Qualifications

Knowledge & Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of technical aspects of emergency response management, including clinical, epidemiological, laboratory, and data systems. .
  • Expertise in donor-funded projects and deep understanding of the emergency response environment, including political, legal, and financial influences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex, multi-departmental challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience in publishing technical documents, peer-reviewed articles, and external communications.
  • Fluency in English and French, with additional language skills preferred


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree or its International Equivalent in Public Health, Infectious Diseases, Microbiology, or a related field.
  • Typically requires 8+ years of relevant experience in technical implementation, capacity building, and business development, with documented exp. providing technical assistance on large-scale projects.
  • Experience in project management within an NGO, government agency, or private organization setting, with demonstrated success in developing and managing technical deliverables.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctorate Degree in a related field preferred, preferably a Medical Degree with training in Infectious Diseases.
  • Trained by the US CDC Epidemic Intelligence Service (EIS)
  • Significant international outbreak response/deployment experience
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in the field with publication in peer reviewed journals.
  • Project Management (PM) Certification.


Travel

  • Up to 25% travel required.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Your Sales Career Begins Here.  Insight Global is a talent, consulting, and AI company that helps businesses find great people and solve complex challenges.
jobs.description:
Overview

Your Sales Career Begins Here.

Insight Global is a talent, consulting, and AI company that helps businesses find great people and solve complex challenges. We partner with Fortune 1000 companies across a wide range of industries and provide solutions tailored to their needs.

Since 2001, we've expanded from a small entrepreneurial startup to over $5 billion in revenue. Our growth is driven by our award-winning company culture, comprehensive training programs, and of course, our people. We pride ourselves on hiring elite entry-level sales candidates because we believe in promoting from within. Each employee starts as a Recruiter before earning a promotion to Account Management.

Responsibilities

RECRUITER

The purpose of the Recruiter role is to build the foundation for a successful sales career at Insight Global. Recruiters are matchmakers for companies and candidates. You’ll review resumes from our internal database and online job boards, conduct phone interviews, prepare candidates to meet hiring managers, and ultimately negotiate job offers to get them hired.

The average employee spends approximately 6 months in the Recruiter role before enrolling in either Account Manager Training (AMT) or Professional Recruiter Training (PRT).

ACCOUNT MANAGER

Account Managers are the face of our organization. They work directly with stakeholders and executives at Fortune 1000 companies by researching and targeting organizations in need of talent, consulting, and AI services. They make an initial connection through networking and cold calls, ultimately becoming valuable partners who build long-term relationships with their clients. Account Managers run in-person meetings and lunches to get to know hiring goals, team dynamics, and sell how our services can elevate their business.

PROFESSIONAL RECRUITER

When it comes to Professional Recruiting, think next-level recruiting and a different take on inside sales. Their job is to identify top candidates and pair them with the perfect job. Once the placement is made, our Professional Recruiters continue to work closely with each consultant guaranteeing a world-class experience and offering continued support throughout their careers.

Qualifications

WHO WE HIRE

We’re focused on hiring the best talent, regardless of major, school, or experience. We are looking for individuals with grit, leadership potential, and a competitive spirit. If you’re driven, personable, and embody our Shared Values, you’re the right fit for Insight Global.

  • Personality: We look for those who have strong personalities, who are positive, charismatic and have a willingness to connect with others.
  • Hustle & Grit: This job is challenging, but it’s extremely rewarding. We want the type of people who persevere beyond the hard stuff and proactively pursue long-term goals, work well under pressure, and can handle difficult situations. There will always be obstacles, but how our people handle them is what sets us apart.
  • Team: Together, anything is possible. IG employees must want to be part of a team and work well with others. Every success story has a team of people behind it.
  • Culture: Of everything, our culture is most important, and our Shared Values define us: Everyone Matters, We Take Care of Each Other, Leadership is Here to Serve, High Character & Hard Work Above All Else & Always Know Where You Stand. Our employees (and those we seek to hire) embody and live out these Shared Values.
  • Sales: We want someone who’s motivated, excited about sales, looking to start a long-term career, and can embody our Sales Behaviors: Ability to Build in-Person Relationships, Urgent, Aggressive and Direct, Relentlessly Compete, Always Find a Way, and Be Elite.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Insight Global offers a competitive base salary ranging from $38,000- $68,640 annually, dependent on office location. Upon promotion, Account Managers receive a base salary increase, up to $5,400 annually in commission supplement, a corporate cell phone, and uncapped commission paid weekly.

The average employee in the company makes:

  • Year 2: $73,000-$88,000
  • Year 3: $121,000-$145,000
  • Year 4: $135,000-$194,000

Account Managers and Professional Recruiters have the opportunity to win annual sales contests that include an all-expenses-paid trip to the Bahamas, LTIs, and a cash bonus starting at $7,500- $10,000. Benefit offerings include medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, company-paid life insurance, 401(k) retirement account access with employer matching, and paid vacation and sick time.


Pay Range

Starting from USD $53,000.00/Yr.

jobs.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

Job Description:


3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As an Analyst, Marketing Technologies, you will play an important role in helping bring our digital marketing strategies to life across the U.S. and Canada. You will support the development, activation, monitoring, and optimization of digital marketing programs designed to generate demand, engage dental and orthodontic professionals, and contribute to lead and revenue growth.

Working across marketing teams, agency partners, and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will help execute paid media campaigns, deploy digital education and webinar programs, monitor marketing and lead-generation performance, and translate data into actionable insights. Your work will help ensure our digital investments are effectively executed, measured, and continuously optimized to improve business results.

How you will make an impact

  • Perform: Monitor and analyze digital campaign and lead-generation performance, translating key metrics and data into actionable insights and optimization opportunities. Own webpage maintenance and continuous optimization, partnering with cross-functional teams to improve content, accuracy, usability, engagement and conversion.
  • Execute: Implement and maintain integrated digital campaigns across paid search, paid social, display, email, landing pages, and other digital channels, ensuring accurate setup, tracking, targeting, and measurement.
  • Support: Support the deployment of dental webinars, digital education, and lead-generation programs. Ensure campaigns are appropriately configured within relevant marketing platforms and that tracking, tagging, audience, lead capture and reporting requirements are implemented correctly.
  • Coordinate: Partner with marketing teams, agency partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure campaigns are launched effectively, remain aligned to objectives and timelines, and are continuously optimized.
  • Prepare: Develop campaign reporting, dashboards, performance analysis, and market insights that help teams evaluate results, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions about future marketing activities and investments.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited institution and 5 years of equivalent professional experience.

AND

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, agency, or related roles.

Additional Skills That Will Help You Succeed

  • Understanding of digital marketing metrics and concepts such as CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate, cost per lead, customer acquisition, and marketing funnel performance.
  • Experience with paid search and digital advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, LinkedIn, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with web analytics and campaign measurement platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics.
  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM, lead-management, or email marketing platforms.
  • Experience supporting webinars, virtual events, or digital customer-education programs.
  • Ability to analyze campaign data in Excel and/or reporting and visualization platforms and summarize findings for marketing stakeholders.
  • Understanding of tracking technologies such as UTM parameters, conversion tracking, pixels, tagging, and landing-page measurement.
  • Ability to work effectively with agencies and internal teams to move campaigns from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization.
  • Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with an interest in emerging digital marketing technologies, platforms, and customer-engagement trends.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly related to campaign setup, tracking, reporting, and digital execution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external agency partners.
  • Experience supporting the development and activation of paid media campaigns, including paid search, paid social, display, or other digital advertising channels.
  • Experience monitoring digital campaign performance and using marketing metrics to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.
  • Experience working with marketing data and translating performance results into clear, actionable insights.

Work location:

· Remote


Travel: May include up to 5% [domestic/international]

Relocation Assistance: May be authorized

jobs.description:
UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Retention Solutions департаменту шукаємо Middle Web Push Specialist.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • розробка маркетингових концепцій для push-кампаній в iGaming: пошук нових ідей та механік просування офферів для росту конверсій;

  • самостійне ведення гіпотез повним циклом: ідея → концепція → креатив → запуск → аналіз → оптимізація;

  • тестування кількох принципово різних концепцій для одного оффера та визначення найефективніших для конкретних GEO і сегментів;

  • написання конверсійних push-повідомлень (заголовок, текст, CTA), підбір візуалу та адаптація креативів під аудиторію;

  • запуск масових і сегментованих кампаній через власну CRM;

  • проведення A/B-тестів на достатньому обсязі даних, документування результатів і застосування висновків;

  • оптимізація кампаній не лише за CTR, а й за реєстраціями, депозитами та доходом;

  • сегментація аудиторії (GEO, поведінка, активність), оптимізація частоти й часу відправлення, контроль контактного навантаження;

  • ведення регулярної аналітики та формування плану наступних експериментів;

  • аналіз креативів конкурентів і адаптація релевантних ідей;

  • прояв ініціативи: самостійний пошук і впровадження покращень без постійної постановки задач.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • 2+ роки досвіду в retention або user acquisition;

  • практичний досвід роботи з Push Marketing, CRM-кампаніями, сегментацією аудиторії та оптимізацією конверсій;

  • вміння писати короткі тексти, що продають, і адаптувати тон під різні аудиторії;

  • досвід проведення A/B тестів і готовність ухвалювати рішення на основі даних;

  • увага до деталей: таргетинг, сегменти, час відправки, локалізація;

  • розуміння базових маркетингових метрик (CTR, конверсія, retention, LTV);

  • базові знання SQL та досвід роботи з Tableau або Looker Studio (або готовність швидко їх освоїти);

  • орієнтація на результат і бажання заробляти більше завдяки своїм показникам.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід роботи з PWA, Android/iOS Apps;

  • розуміння особливостей доставки push-повідомлень, opt-in, обмежень браузерів і мобільних платформ;

  • досвід побудови/використання аналітичних дашбордів і використання SQL для самостійного аналізу кампаній;

  • досвід в iGaming ніші.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

jobs.excerpt: À propos de N2JSoft N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.
jobs.description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Quelques chiffres

  • 230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).

Requirements

Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.


Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity


At Abbott Cancer Diagnostics, we are focused on advancing diagnostic solutions that support earlier detection, informed treatment decisions, and improved patient care across our Screening, Precision Oncology, and Rare Disease businesses.


Abbott has an opportunity for a Manager, Market Access Medical Policy Intelligence within Abbott Cancer Diagnostics (ACD). Reporting to the Sr Manager, Market Access Medical Policy & Coverage, this individual will build and maintain the payer coverage intelligence that supports commercial coverage across the ACD portfolio. The role maintains a detailed view of how payers cover ACD products, tracks changes in payer policy, and turns policy details into clear information and guidance for Market Access, Product, Medical Affairs, and Revenue Cycle. The role also supports the development and maintenance of payer evidence dossiers, working with Medical Affairs on clinical content.


Key internal partners will include Market Access and payer account teams, Screening, Precision Oncology, and Rare Disease business unit teams, Product, Medical Affairs, Revenue Cycle, and Analytics.


What You’ll Work On


  • Build and maintain a centralized coverage and criteria tracker by payer, line of business, and ACD product, and keep it accurate, current, and easy for internal teams to use
  • Review and interpret payer medical policies, and capture clinical criteria, patient eligibility requirements, testing methodology, documentation requirements, and utilization management rules
  • Monitor payer policy changes, new policy postings, and laboratory benefit manager activity, and issue timely alerts that explain what changed and why it matters to the business
  • Track and summarize the competitive coverage landscape for ACD products
  • Prepare payer profiles and coverage dashboards for Market Access, Product, Medical Affairs, and business unit leadership
  • Support the Sr Manager in identifying coverage gaps and opportunities, and prepare materials for payer engagement such as criteria comparisons and briefing documents
  • Draft and maintain payer value and evidence dossiers in partnership with the Sr Manager, working with Medical Affairs to incorporate clinical evidence, and update them as new evidence, guidelines, and payer policies emerge
  • Work with Revenue Cycle to translate policy requirements into payer-specific prior authorization, documentation, and appeals guidance
  • Partner with Analytics to review denial and appeal data, flag denials driven by payer policy, and share findings that inform coverage strategy
  • Help define the coverage data model, taxonomy, and reporting cadence, and recommend ways to automate policy monitoring where practical
  • Serve as a go-to resource for coverage questions from internal teams, and provide clear, well-supported answers

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (such as life sciences, public health, healthcare administration, or business), or an equivalent combination of education and work experience; advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in market access, payer or health plan, reimbursement, medical policy, revenue cycle, or related healthcare roles
  • Minimum of 2 years of direct experience reviewing and interpreting payer medical policies, coverage criteria, or prior authorization requirements
  • Experience with oncology diagnostics, cancer screening, molecular or genetic diagnostics, or related products preferred; rare disease or genetic testing experience a plus
  • Working knowledge of commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid coverage and reimbursement, including claims, denials, and appeals processes
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience building trackers, dashboards, or reports using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau
  • Ability to read clinical literature and summarize key points clearly for internal and payer audiences, including drafting dossier content
  • Experience working cross functionally with Product, Medical Affairs, Revenue Cycle, legal, and compliance partners
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and close attention to detail
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

About zerohash

zerohash powers the infrastructure that lets businesses embed digital assets into their products. Our APIs and embedded infrastructure enable banks, brokerages, fintechs, trading firms, and other financial institutions to launch crypto and stablecoin experiences without building the underlying infrastructure, licensing, or operations themselves. zerohash is a registered money services business across the U.S. and holds VASP registrations in the EU, and other jurisdictions.

About the role

We are looking for a pre-sales Solutions Engineer to own the technical side of our institutional trading deals. You will be the person a bank, broker-dealer, or trading firm talks to when they want to understand how zerohash connects to their trading stack: FIX sessions, order books, RFQ, market data, settlement, and the APIs around them.

You will partner with Account Executives from first meeting to signature. You will run discovery, design the solution, demo the platform, answer RFPs and due diligence questionnaires, and earn the trust of technical and business stakeholders at regulated institutions. Once a deal signs, you hand a clear, well documented solution to our Implementation Services team and stay close to the account for expansion opportunities.

Success in this role is measured by deals won, by how quickly prospects move from first call to a signed agreement, and by how few surprises Implementation finds after signature.

What you will do

  • Lead technical discovery with banks, broker-dealers, wealth platforms, and trading firms to understand their order flow, trading workflows, existing OMS/EMS setup, connectivity, and settlement needs.
  • Explain and demo how zerohash fits into an institutional trading stack, including FIX connectivity for order entry, execution reports and drop copy, central limit order book (CLOB) and RFQ execution, market data, and the REST APIs and webhooks around them.
  • Design end-to-end solutions that combine trading with adjacent products such as account funding, payouts, crypto deposits and withdrawals, and staking, and document them in solution designs and flow diagrams that both the client and our internal teams can rely on.
  • Lead executive presentations and technical deep dives for audiences ranging from heads of e-trading and CTOs to operations, risk, and compliance teams. Adjust the depth of the conversation to the room.
  • Own the technical response to RFPs, RFIs, vendor due diligence, and information security questionnaires, working with Security, Compliance, and Legal where needed.
  • Run proof-of-value demos and scope certification testing so prospects can validate connectivity before they sign.
  • Qualify deals with your Account Executive. Identify technical blockers, product gaps, and regulatory constraints early, and help shape the commercial proposal.
  • Bring structured feedback from the market to Product and Engineering, and help prioritize the capabilities that win institutional deals.
  • Hand off signed deals to Implementation Services with a complete solution design, then support upsell and expansion conversations with existing clients.
  • Build reusable pre-sales assets such as demo scripts, reference architectures, FIX onboarding materials, and an RFP answer library, and help Account Executives spot good-fit opportunities.

What you bring

  • 4+ years (6+ for Senior) in a pre-sales technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Pre-Sales Consultant, with a track record of helping win new business.
  • Experience selling, demoing, or supporting FIX-based trading connectivity for institutional clients, on the sell side, buy side, or at a trading technology vendor. You can explain sessions, order entry, execution reports, drop copy, and market data with confidence.
  • Working knowledge of market structure and trading workflows: order types, order books, RFQ, OMS/EMS, pre-trade checks, and post-trade settlement.
  • Experience selling to or working with banks, broker-dealers, or other regulated financial institutions, including navigating their procurement, security review, and compliance processes.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, REST, webhooks, and how data moves between systems. Comfortable reading API documentation and walking a client developer through an integration.
  • Excellent presentation and written communication. You can whiteboard a FIX flow for an engineer and then explain the business value to a managing director.
  • Hands-on familiarity with crypto, for example using wallets, exchanges, or stablecoins, and a strong drive to become an expert in digital assets and blockchain technology.
  • A passion for learning. You pick up new products and technologies quickly and enjoy a fast-paced environment where priorities change.
  • Fluency with AI tools in your daily work, including AI-assisted coding (vibe coding) to build demos, prototypes, and scripts, answer technical questions, and prepare for client meetings. We care about the results, not how you get there.
  • Ability to manage several active deals at once with minimal oversight.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience with digital asset trading, custody, settlement, staking, stablecoins, or tokenized assets.
  • Background at an exchange, prime broker, electronic trading desk, or OMS/EMS or FIX engine vendor.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory context of trading for U.S. and EU institutions, such as broker-dealer obligations or MiFID II trade reporting.
  • Experience with SQL and a scripting language such as Python, JavaScript, or Go to build demos, test connectivity, or analyze data.

Why join

  • Work on the infrastructure that banks and brokerages use to bring digital assets to millions of end users.
  • High visibility role with direct impact on revenue and on what we build next.
  • Work alongside a team with deep experience across trading, payments, and crypto infrastructure.

Benefits

We believe a happy, motivated, and healthy team is the best way to succeed. We offer the following benefits:

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

jobs.excerpt: Du möchtest das Marketing einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur komplett verantworten?
jobs.description:
Du möchtest das Marketing einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur komplett verantworten? Eigenmarketing ist bei EVOLVE ein eigenständiges System aus Ads, Content und Brand und läuft bereits erfolgreich. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dieses System zu übernehmen, zu schärfen und weiter auszubauen. Die Fachbereiche aus Creative, Media Buying und Vertrieb stemmen die Umsetzung mit dir. Selbstverständlich AI First.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Du entwickelst einen Lead-Magnet für unsere Wunschzielgruppe, D2C-E-Commerce-Unternehmen, und bewirbst ihn über Ads. Kurz nach der Veröffentlichung kommen viele Eintragungen und direkt vier neue Kundenanfragen.

Du wertest aus, welche Hooks und Themen am besten performen. Nach kurzer Abstimmung, machst du daraus mehr: einen Guide für unseren YouTube-Kanal, passende LinkedIn-Beiträge, neue Ad-Konzepte für Meta Ads und eine E-Mail-Kampagne.

Wenige Tage später ist das Thema auf allen Kanälen präsent, sodass niemand an EVOLVE als ganzheitlichem Wachstumspartner vorbeikommt. Zwei Wochen später hat unser Vertriebsteam den Kalender voll mit Terminen aus genau diesem Content. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote ab Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert B2B-Marketing bei EVOLVE

Bei EVOLVE ist Eigenmarketing ein eigenständiges System aus Ads, Content und Branding. Du verantwortest dieses System, statt es nur auszuführen. Darunter verstehen wir:

  • Pipeline-Generierung über Ads, Content und E-Mail als ein zusammenhängendes Marketingsystem, nicht als drei getrennte

  • Aufbau der EVOLVE-Brand, um unsere Wahrnehmung als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner in Deutschland zu stärken

  • KI-Workflows, die manuelle Abläufe ersetzen, damit deine Zeit in Konzept statt in Klickarbeit fließt. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Jeder nutzt KI wie einen Junior an seiner Seite, um besser und effizienter zu arbeiten

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Strategie und Priorisierung: Du baust Brand und Agentur-Marketing als System auf, entwickelst die Strategie hinter der Pipeline-Generierung und entscheidest, was zuerst passiert

  • Content: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und Content-Guides, schreibst LinkedIn-Posts mit und verantwortest den Contentplan über unsere Kanäle

  • Ads: Du entwickelst Ad-Konzepte und gibst zu laufenden Kampagnen Feedback. Du verantwortest das Ergebnis, nicht die Klickarbeit

  • Events und Messen: Du sorgst dafür, dass sie wirklich neue Kunden bringen

  • Projektmanagement: Du treibst alle Eigenmarketing-Projekte eigenverantwortlich voran und sorgst dafür, dass sie on time realisiert werden

  • Datenanalyse: Du bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten und kommst aus eigener Initiative mit dem nächsten Schritt für mehr qualifizierte Anfragen zur Geschäftsführung

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE nur einmal. Du steuerst und koordinierst, produzierst aber nicht alles selbst. Bei der Umsetzung bekommst du Unterstützung aus mehreren Fachbereichen, von Creative und Copywriting über Media Buying bis zum Vertrieb. Du orchestrierst diese Ressourcen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du hast schon einmal eine Media- oder Personal-Brand mitaufgebaut und dort einen Kanal oder Funnel komplett verantwortet.

  • 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing, in der du auf Pipeline, Leads oder Umsatz gesteuert hast. Nicht auf Reichweite und Follower

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Direct Response. Du siehst einem Hook an, ob er zieht, noch bevor die erste Zahl reinkommt

  • Du denkst in ganzen Funnels, von der ersten Content-Idee bis zum qualifizierten Termin.

  • Du willst selbst bestimmen, was gemacht wird, statt nach Briefing zu arbeiten

  • Du arbeitest AI native mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Modellen. Du nutzt eigene Prompts und Systeme, nicht nur zu Recherche, sondern, um die Effizienz deiner Arbeit zu steigern.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.
