jobs.excerpt: Company Overview More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most. We pioneered the way consumers shopped for term life insurance, and now, we also help people find home insurance, auto insurance, senior health insurance and more. Our quick and easy process saves consumers both time and money, and today, more than 2 million families trust us to help them with their insurance needs.

But what truly sets us apart is our people, and the opportunities to grow your career with SelectQuote are unmatched.

About the Role

Sales Development Advisor

Job Summary

SelectQuote is seeking experienced, driven, resilient, and results-oriented sales professionals to join our Qualifications Team as a Sales Development Advisor (SDA).

The SDA is an unlicensed, outbound sales position responsible for contacting prospective customers, generating interest in SelectQuote's products, understanding customer needs, overcoming objections, and transferring qualified prospects to a licensed insurance agent.

This is not a customer service role. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven sales position. Successful candidates must be comfortable making hundreds of outbound calls each day, working from established scripts and processes, handling rejection, and consistently working toward performance goals.

This role provides paid training, a base salary plus bonus opportunity, and a potential career path into a licensed sales agent position. After demonstrating success in the role, SelectQuote will provide opportunities to enter a sales training program and assist with obtaining an insurance license.

Candidates who currently hold an insurance license will not be considered for this position.

After applying, qualified candidates will receive a phone call to complete our pre-screening questionnaire.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective customers, with activity of up to 800 calls per day.

  • Generate interest and create meaningful engagement with prospective customers.

  • Quickly establish rapport and communicate confidently and professionally over the phone.

  • Identify customer needs and qualify prospects for transfer to a licensed insurance agent.

  • Handle and overcome objections, stalls, hesitation, and rejection throughout the sales conversation.

  • Confidently redirect conversations and move qualified prospects toward the next step.

  • Follow established sales scripts, processes, and instructions while maintaining a natural and engaging conversation.

  • Meet or exceed monthly transfer, contact-to-transfer, and other performance goals.

  • Accept coaching and demonstrate the ability to apply feedback to improve sales performance.

  • Work effectively with multiple monitors, software applications, and phone systems.

  • Maintain consistent attendance, punctuality, productivity, and performance.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least 1 year of telesales, inside sales, phone sales, or comparable sales experience required.

  • Proven ability to work in a high-volume, metrics-driven or commission-based sales environment preferred.

  • Demonstrated success working toward quotas, KPIs, conversion goals, or other measurable sales objectives.

  • Strong objection-handling and closing skills.

  • Confident, energetic, and conversational phone presence.

  • Strong active listening and communication skills.

  • Ability to follow scripts and established sales processes.

  • Ability to accept coaching and implement feedback.

  • Professional and reliable work habits.

  • Consistent employment history and demonstrated commitment to previous roles preferred.

  • Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain significant employment gaps, frequent job changes, or positions not reflected on their resume.

  • Current insurance licenses are not eligible for this position.

Compensation & Career Growth

  • Paid training.

  • Base salary plus bonus opportunity.

  • Average first-year earnings of approximately $50,000, with top producers earning $80,000+.

  • Potential opportunity to enter SelectQuote's sales training program after as soon as six months of successful performance.

  • SelectQuote will support successful associates in pursuing an insurance license and progressing into a licensed sales role.

This Role Is a Good Fit for You If...

  • You have a genuine sales mindset and enjoy influencing customers toward a next step.

  • You are comfortable making a very high volume of outbound calls every day.

  • You don't get discouraged by rejection.

  • You can confidently handle "I'm not interested," "I need to think about it," and other common objections.

  • You enjoy working toward quotas, KPIs, and measurable sales goals.

  • You are comfortable using a sales script and can make it sound natural rather than robotic.

  • You can follow a structured sales process while still actively listening and responding to the customer.

  • You are competitive and motivated by improving your numbers.

  • You can stay engaged and energetic through repetitive, high-volume work.

  • You take coaching seriously and can demonstrate changes based on feedback.

  • You can provide specific examples of your past sales performance and accomplishments.

  • You are looking for a long-term sales career, with the potential to progress into a licensed sales role.

  • You are dependable and prepared to consistently work your assigned schedule.

This Role May Not Be a Good Fit for You If...

  • You are primarily looking for a customer service position.

  • You are primarily interested in working from home for flexibility rather than pursuing a sales career.

  • You dislike scripted sales environments or are unwilling to follow established sales processes.

  • You prefer conversations without sales goals, quotas, or performance expectations.

  • You become uncomfortable when customers object, hesitate, or say no.

  • You have difficulty redirecting a conversation or moving a prospect toward the next step.

  • You struggle to maintain energy and engagement during repetitive phone interactions.

  • You are uncomfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • You prefer not to be coached or change your approach based on feedback.

  • You cannot provide specific examples of your sales accomplishments or performance.

  • You are unable to commit consistently to a set schedule, attendance expectations, and the demands of a full-time sales position.

Work-From-Home Requirements

This is a full-time W-2 work-from-home position with an assigned schedule.

Employees must:

  • Be punctual and consistently adhere to their assigned schedule and attendance requirements.

  • Have a quiet, dedicated workspace free from distractions.

  • Have reliable high-speed internet with minimum speeds of 20 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload through a hardwired connection.

  • Be able to remain fully engaged and available throughout scheduled work hours.

  • Be willing to work overtime, weekends, or schedule variations when business needs require it.

SelectQuote Core Values

Service — We create positive customer experiences.
Entrepreneurship — We create, innovate, and take risks.
Leadership — We build and invest in high-performing teams.
Empowerment — We embrace a changing environment.
Courage — We challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement.
Teamwork — We help, support, and celebrate each other.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, qualifications, or requirements.

Overview

When someone living with opioid use disorder is ready for help, the speed and quality of the referral they receive can change the trajectory of their life. As our Vice President of National Partnerships, you'll own the strategy that makes those referrals happen — at scale, across the country.

Fully Remote work (Not available to residents of: AK, AR, CA, HI, ID, NE, SD, UT, WY). We are prioritizing candidates who align with the Eastern time zone (EDT/EST) for consistent overlap and availability with our core clinical and operational teams.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Own the national growth strategy. You'll build and execute our national referral partnership strategy across healthcare, justice-involved, and community-based channels — setting clear channel strategies, market priorities, and measurable targets for referral volume, conversion, and census growth. Then you'll own the results.

Turn relationships into results. You'll deepen our highest-performing partnerships, expand referral volume from current partners, and source, sign, and activate new ones. When you see an emerging growth opportunity, you'll test it, prove it, and scale it.

Lead and grow a distributed team. You'll coach Partnership Development Managers across multiple markets — setting clear expectations for account ownership, field activity, CRM discipline, and follow-through, and building a culture where accountability and high morale feed each other. Through regular one-to-ones, market reviews, and coaching, you'll sharpen their consultative selling, executive communication, and partner development skills.

Build bridges across functions. You'll strengthen warm-handoff workflows and remove barriers, so more referrals lead to timely access to care, successful member activation, and sustained engagement in treatment — partnering with Marketing, Member Access, Operations, and Clinical teams along the way.

Represent us in the field. You'll build and maintain relationships with high-value national, regional, and market-level partners — courts, correctional agencies, hospitals and health systems, recovery organizations, housing providers, health plans, government stakeholders, and community coalitions.

Change minds, open doors. Working with Marketing, Clinical, Operations, and Member Access, you'll develop partner-facing presentations, education, and messaging — leading partner education on medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and evidence-based treatment, especially with justice and community partners, to reduce stigma and open referral pathways.

Let data drive the plan. You'll use market intelligence — competitive dynamics, referral trends, emerging partnership models — to decide which markets and partnerships to prioritize, with performance visibility your team and our executives can act on.

Build what's next. You'll recommend team design, role clarity, incentives, reporting, and CRM capabilities needed to scale — and partner with Emerging Markets to build referral pipelines so new locations open with volume already flowing.

Work Environment/Schedule

This is a national leadership role built for connection. You'll lead a distributed, multi-market team and work cross-functionally with Marketing, Member Access, Operations, Clinical, and executive leadership.

You'll travel as needed for partner meetings, conferences, presentations, market visits, community events, and team engagement. You'll also represent the Partnership Development function in executive discussions, planning sessions, growth reviews, and market performance meetings.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of healthcare growth, business development, partnership development, market development, or related leadership experience
  • A track record of building high-performing, distributed teams across multiple markets or states — and translating referral partnerships into measurable growth
  • Deep understanding of referral development, account management, healthcare partnerships, and market activation
  • The ability to build scalable strategies from complex, ambiguous environments
  • Fluency with CRM systems, dashboards, pipeline tools, and performance reporting (Salesforce a plus)
  • Executive-level communication — written narratives, presentations, board-level updates, and partner-facing materials
  • The ability to partner effectively with clinical, operational, analytics, marketing, and executive teams
  • Strong coaching, prioritization, and change management skills
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, conferences, market visits, and team engagement

Strongly preferred: experience in addiction treatment, behavioral health, value-based care, Medicaid, justice-involved care, health systems, or community-based healthcare.

Why Join Us

  • Expand access to care. Help more people connect with evidence-based addiction treatment by making referral pathways easier to navigate.
  • Shape national growth. Own the partnership strategy, test new opportunities, and help build a function that can scale.
  • Develop people. Coach a multi-market team with clear goals, meaningful feedback, and shared accountability for results.
  • Help reduce stigma. Equip healthcare, justice-system, and community partners with knowledge that opens more pathways to treatment.

Put your growth expertise to work expanding access to evidence-based addiction treatment. At Groups, you'll connect healthcare, justice, and community partners to care, help reduce stigma around MOUD, and shape how a national partnership function grows. jobs.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina.
jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow.

The company builds software for commercial real estate. This isn't general cloud engineering, you will actually built agentic-platform infrastructure before, not just traditional cloud architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Model Design & Delivery
    • Design, train and ship production ML models for real estate and facilities decisions, such as forecasting for space, occupancy, headcount, rent and finances
    • Own each model end to end: problem framing, data and features, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and cost and latency budgets
    • Serve models as versioned, documented APIs that product features, agents and other systems call. Keep the serving layer portable across cloud platforms, for example by using containers
    • Contribute to embedding and retrieval work, and measure retrieval quality on real customer documents
    • Contribute to synthetic data pipelines, so teams can develop and test without production customer data. Measure how closely the synthetic data matches the real data, how well models trained on it perform, and whether it leaks private data
  • Evaluation, Quality & Trust
    • Own the evaluation of every model you ship: backtests, held-out datasets, metrics that fit the problem, and regression suites in CI that gate releases
    • Build them on the shared evaluation framework that the platform team provides
    • Find the root cause of quality failures, whether data drift, leakage, a feature defect, flawed ground truth, a retrieval miss or a model regression. Fix the layer that is at fault
    • Monitor production models for accuracy, drift, silent degradation and cost
    • Retrain or roll back based on evidence
    • Own model-level safety behavior: keep customer data within each tenant’s access rules, handle PII correctly, test for privacy leakage, and disclose uncertainty clearly
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with Product to turn accuracy thresholds and confidence disclosure into shipped behavior
    • Agree on API contracts, accuracy bars and failure behavior with the teams that build AI agents on your models. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment and with Data Platform on the curated datasets and features your models read
    • Feed model performance and usage data into the warehouse, so model quality is measurable next to product analytics
    • Support the domain teams that build on your models, contribute to the shared quality standard for models and agents, and mentor engineers on ML practice

Requirements:

  • You have taken at least one ML model from problem framing to production, and kept it accurate through retraining and drift. Typically 5+ years of professional engineering experience and a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Python and SQL, including the ML stack (scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent, pandas or equivalent) and the service stack (FastAPI, Pydantic or equivalent) Testing, code review, CI/CD and production ownership. You use AI coding assistants and verify their output
  • Hands-on experience with ML evaluation: time-aware validation and backtesting against simple baselines, holdout design, metric selection, interval coverage and calibration, error analysis, and using results to gate releases. This is central to the role
  • Production experience with forecasting models, with a working knowledge of statistics and probability. You can quantify uncertainty, for example with prediction intervals
  • Model serving and MLOps: reproducible deployment, monitoring and retraining, for example with experiment tracking, a model registry, containers,
    and batch or online inference
  • Judgment about failure modes such as data leakage, drift, distribution shift, bias, privacy leakage and silent degradation. You can tell acceptable failures from unacceptable ones, and explain model behavior and uncertainty to Product and to people who are not engineers

Desirable:

  • Embeddings and retrieval systems, including how to measure retrieval quality
  • Synthetic data generation, privacy attack evaluation (for example membership inference), and familiarity with differential privacy
  • Geospatial or location data modeling
  • Experience building models that LLM agents call as tools, with an agent framework such as LangGraph and LLM tracing tools
  • Batch pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions or equivalent) and self- hosted model inference
  • Experience in real estate, facilities, finance or another data-heavy enterprise domain

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

jobs.excerpt: About Vasion For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment.
jobs.description:
About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

At Vasion, we make print intelligent. Intelligent Print Automation treats File > Print as the entry point to a workflow rather than the end of one: the moment a document is created or captured, it becomes structured, secure, auditable data instead of a page that disappears. Three products run on one cloud-native platform — serverless print management that eliminates print servers, drivers, and scripts; output management that moves business-critical ERP print off legacy on-premise infrastructure; and document automation that captures, classifies, and routes documents with AI at the point of capture, built on AWS Bedrock with connectors into Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI, and others. More than 14,000 organizations run on the platform, concentrated in healthcare, government, education, financial services, and manufacturing. We are FedRAMP High Authorized, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified, and SOC 2 Type II audited.

This role owns where that platform meets the device: the embedded control panel application (CPA) that runs on multifunction printers from HP, Xerox, Ricoh, Canon, and others. The panel is where a user authenticates, releases a job, and starts a scan — the moment print stops being paper and becomes an intelligent workflow. We are a cloud-native and agent-native product organization, and we expect our product managers to work that way.

Why This Role Exists

Millions of the documents that move through business organizations still start or end at a multifunction printer. This role owns that moment: what the application does at the device panel, how it authenticates a user, how it releases a job, how it captures a scan, and how it stays consistent across thousands of devices from different manufacturers. The panel is where digital transformation meets paper, and our platform is reinventing what happens there — turning that critical physical step in the document lifecycle into the first intelligent one.

We are building the AI and cloud-native MFP applications of the future, with no customer infrastructure behind them. Just as we eliminated print servers in print management, we are removing the infrastructure that supports the MFP so the platform meets customers where they already are: any device, any manufacturer, any identity provider, any location, and nothing to install in between. Zero trust by default, and it just works. This role owns that surface — what we build at the panel, which manufacturers get it and in what order, and what the experience becomes for the thousands of organizations that reach us there every day.

What you'll do
  • The embedded Control Panel Application (CPA) across supported manufacturers. Own the roadmap, requirements, and release decisions for the CPA: secure print release, panel authentication (badge and proximity card, PIN, SSO through customer identity providers), copy and scan, administration and installation, fleet management, cost and quota management, automation and AI solutions at the device, etc. Decide what ships natively per platform versus what runs through a shared cloud service, and defend the trade-off.
  • Driving the platform to zero customer infrastructure. Own the sequence that takes each manufacturer to a no-infrastructure experience — authentication, scanning, and installation handled without anything running in the customer's environment. Decide what "infrastructure-less" means per platform, what is committed versus targeted, and how customers on the current architecture get to the new one without disruption.
  • Multi-manufacturer capability strategy. Maintain the capability matrix across every supported platform. Decide which manufacturers get which features first, sequence work against each OEM's firmware and certification calendar, and make explicit calls about where we accept a platform limitation versus invest to work around it.
  • Capture and document workflows at the device. Own scanning and capture: OCR, destinations and cloud connectors (SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive, email, etc.), and metadata. Drive the shift from scan-to-folder toward document intelligence and agent-assisted capture at the point of scan.
  • Security and compliance posture at the panel. Partner with security and compliance to keep the on-device experience defensible for zero trust, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and FedRAMP customers. Own the authentication and release behaviors these buyers evaluate line by line.
  • The metrics. Own CPA adoption across the installed base, secure release success rate and latency at the panel, scan workflow completion, certification throughput per manufacturer, and the support ticket and field defect rates tied to on-device releases. Set the targets, instrument them, and report against them.
  • Discovery and validation. Talk to IT administrators, security teams, and the clinicians, clerks, and staff who actually stand at the panel — every week, not every quarter. Bring that evidence, plus usage data and a working knowledge of how the established competitors and manufacturer-native offerings solve the same problems, into every prioritization decision.
  • OEM and partner relationships. Co-own the manufacturer relationship alongside the internal teams who carry it — engineering, partner management, and alliances — working directly with OEM developer and certification programs. Their SDK constraints, signing requirements, and roadmaps are inputs you help manage rather than inherit. You are the person who knows, for each platform, what is possible this quarter and what is not.
How This Role Works

You operate in a trifecta with an engineering manager and a product designer. You own the problem, the case for why now, the prioritization, and the outcome. The engineering manager owns technical approach, architecture, and delivery. The designer owns the panel and administrative experience. Ownership is shared rather than siloed: you are expected to hold strong opinions on design and feasibility, and to invite the same on product.

You influence, but do not own, go-to-market packaging and pricing, launch sequencing and enablement, program-level coordination across dependent teams, and OEM certification scheduling. You are the single accountable owner of the product outcome. This role does not ask you to be the program manager, the engineering manager, or the designer.

Working in an Agent-Native Product Organization

We expect AI to be core infrastructure in your practice, not a novelty.

Use it to compress customer research and synthesis, analyze product usage data, draft and pressure-test requirements, and build working prototypes that validate a panel workflow before engineering commits to it. Prefer prototypes and working software over long planning cycles and abstract market research.

As we push document intelligence and agentic workflows into capture and release, you will work with our AI and architecture teams to reason about non-deterministic behavior: defining evaluation sets, judging model quality against them, and designing experiences that handle uncertainty deliberately through confidence thresholds, fallbacks, and human review

Qualifications
  • 5-7+ years in product management shipping software that customers depend on, including end-to-end ownership of a product area from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Deep subject-matter expertise in printers and MFP applications: the embedded panel experience, manufacturer SDK platforms and their differing capabilities, secure print and release, authentication at the device, and scanning and capture workflows. You have shipped in an environment where the software is constrained by physical devices and by vendor timelines you do not control. Ideally, hands-on experience with one or more manufacturer embedded platforms — HP Workpath or OXPd, Xerox EIP, Ricoh SDK/J, Canon MEAP, or comparable platforms from other manufacturers — across both native and web-based architectures.
    • You have built or owned products in this space and do not need to be taught the domain. This is not a nice-to-have. We will not advance candidates without demonstrated depth here.
  • Demonstrated technical fluency. You can reason about SDKs, APIs, and authentication (SSO and identity providers, badge, PIN), understand how technical choices change the product, and hold your own with engineers on architectural trade-offs.
  • Working AI fluency in your own practice. You use AI tools in real, repeatable workflows for research, analysis, documentation, or prototyping.
  • Strong written communication. You write briefs, requirements, and decision documents a cross-functional team can act on.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • Working on-site in Lehi or St. George is a significant plus. Fully remote is fine, with occasional travel to Utah.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Print, output management, document capture, or scanning domain experience.
  • Familiarity with printing standards and protocols: IPP, SNMP, Mopria, SOAP, etc.
  • Experience building for regulated and public-sector buyers: healthcare (HIPAA, EMR printing), government (FedRAMP), education, or financial services, including zero trust and VDI environments.
  • Experience with serverless or cloud print, or a comparable migration off on-premise servers.
  • Experience defining evaluation sets or shipping AI, machine learning, or document intelligence features in production.
  • Experience working directly with OEM developer and certification programs or a hardware partner ecosystem.
What Good Looks Like
By 90 days

You have built a working command of the manufacturer capability matrix and are leading conversations about it rather than following them. You have talked with IT administrators and end users across at least two verticals, spent time at real devices across multiple brands, and established a point of view on the top constraints and opportunities in the embedded portfolio.

By six months

Set CRM adoption and data quality standards and hold commercial teams accountable to them.

Marketing Operations

  • Support the lead lifecycle from initial inquiry through MQL, SQL, opportunity, and closed business, with clear service-level agreements between Marketing and Sales.

Revenue Analytics, Forecasting & Executive Reporting

GTM Process Design, Enablement & Customer Lifecycle Operations

  • Architect and document the lead-to-cash process, including handoffs across lead capture, opportunity management, quoting, contracting, booking, invoicing, and cash collection.

  • Build the renewal operations engine, including health scoring, timeline management, risk escalation, and expansion signals.

Commercial Technology, Data Governance & AI

  • Own the business roadmap for commercial technology, including Claude, CoPilot,HubSpot, Gong,BI,data enrichment, and emerging revenue tools.
  • Define data governance standards, integration requirements, reporting specifications, and prioritized business requirements for technical implementation partners.
  • Lead an AI-firstRevOpsoperating model, using tools such as Claude, Copilot, and Gong to automate reporting, forecast preparation, pipeline inspection, and data hygiene, and own AI use-case prioritization, safeguards, and adoption across commercial teams.
  • Set platform priorities with the NetSuite Solutions Manager, who leads configuration, integrations, and automation, and validate that delivered solutions meet business needs.
  • Directly administer Gong and manageRevOpstechnology vendors, licenses, renewals, and total cost of ownership.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and executive leaders on revenue performance, operating priorities, investment tradeoffs, and scalability.
  • Create clear decision rights and an effective “business owner + technical partner” operating model across Revenue Operations and Technology.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives through influence, credible data, practical change management, and strong stakeholder communication.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or a closely related function, including at least 5 years leading teams and major operating programs.
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming a RevOps function into scalable infrastructure across a multi-product or multi-motion organization.
  • Experience improving forecast accuracy, pipeline discipline, data quality, and commercial decision-making.
  • Experience in K–12, EdTech, education publishing, or public-sector selling, or another environment with complex, seasonal, budget-cycle-driven buying, preferred.
  • Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment with executive and board reporting expectations preferred.

jobs.excerpt: anstellungsdetails Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin info Who we are We are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group.
jobs.description:
anstellungsdetails

Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin

info

Who we are

We are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail


Product data is the backbone of our marketplace. Every product page, search result, recommendation, and ad, and every answer an AI assistant gives about our products, depends on it. Whether a customer finds the right item, trusts what they see, and decides to buy is decided by the quality of that data.
With tens of millions of items, several countries and languages, and thousands of sellers, this cannot be solved with manual work. It takes scalable systems, and increasingly AI.
As Senior Product Manager, you own a key part of this backbone: how we enrich, evaluate, and prioritize product data, and how we make sure that customers, partners, and the many systems that rely on it can trust it. You will build scalable, backend-heavy products with a direct line to GMV, customer trust, and seller experience.
  • You own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for scalable products that enrich, evaluate, and prioritize product data, from the first idea through architecture and launch to measurable impact
  • You turn open-ended, ambiguous problems into clear sub-problems, a prioritized plan, and an execution path, and you defend your choices with data
  • You design and drive AI-powered systems at scale: LLMs and machine learning for attribute extraction, validation, translation, and quality scoring across multiple languages. You make sure that results are measurable, reliable and cost-efficient
  • You define how we measure the quality and reliability of content: what is “good data”, how do we know, and what do we do when sources disagree?
  • You decide where to invest limited capacity first by quantifying business impact, risk, and cost per item and per category
  • You work as the connecting point between Engineering, Data Science, Design, Search, Legal, Seller-facing teams, and other product teams. You translate business needs into technical requirements and technical trade-offs into business decisions
  • You build the metrics, dashboards, and feedback loops that tell us whether the system works, and you present results to stakeholders up to senior leadership

profil

Your profile – this is what we expect from you

  • You have extensive experience in digital product management or in related fields such as strategy or innovation with proven impact on users and business
  • You approach problems in a structured way: you can break down unclear challenges, form hypotheses, test them with data, and prioritize with a clear rationale
  • You have a good understanding of Data Science Models and when to apply them
  • You are experienced in using LLMs in production environments. You also know their limits and how to check whether results can be trusted
  • You are highly data-literate and outcome-driven, and you can turn metrics and user feedback into decisions
  • You think in scale: you look for solutions that work for millions of items, in several languages, and with limited manual effort
  • You are a strong written and verbal communicator, can explain complex topics simply, and can convince technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels
  • You have a solid technical understanding of data flows, APIs, and system integrations, and you enjoy working closely with engineers
  • You put the customer and the seller first and enjoy solving real pain points
  • You enjoy working in an international, English-speaking team (C1 level) and in a fast-paced, pragmatic environment

benefits

What we offer

  • Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
  • Do you want to move to Germany? No problem – we offer you an attractive relocation package to give you a smooth start.
  • Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
  • Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
  • Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!

Descripción del puesto

En The Whiteam Consultingbuscamos un/a Arquitecto de Software / Senior Backend Developer para incorporarse a un programa estratégico de modernización tecnológica orientado a la transformación de aplicaciones Mainframe hacia arquitecturas modernas basadas en Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Oracle y AWS.

Buscamos un perfil senior con experiencia en desarrollo backend, entornos Mainframe y arquitectura de aplicaciones, capaz de comprender sistemas legacy complejos, definir estrategias de transformación y participar en procesos de migración asistidos por herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial.

La persona seleccionada desempeñará un papel clave en el análisis de aplicaciones existentes, la definición de reglas de conversión y la validación técnica de los activos generados durante el proceso de modernización.

Responsabilidades

  • Analizar aplicaciones desarrolladas en entornos Mainframe.

  • Interpretar componentes implementados en:

    • COBOL

    • JCL

    • CICS

    • DB2

    • Copybooks

  • Diseñar estrategias de transformación hacia arquitecturas modernas basadas en Java.

  • Definir reglas, patrones y criterios de conversión de aplicaciones legacy.

  • Revisar y validar conversiones generadas mediante herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial.

  • Participar en el diseño e implementación de arquitecturas APX dentro del proceso de modernización.

  • Garantizar la calidad técnica y funcional de las aplicaciones migradas.

  • Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, arquitectura y transformación tecnológica.

Requisitos

  • Al menos 4 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software.

  • Experiencia demostrable trabajando con tecnologías Mainframe como COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2 o Copybooks.

  • Experiencia analizando e interpretando aplicaciones Mainframe.

  • Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional con Java y Spring Boot.

  • Experiencia en Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Oracle y/o AWS.

  • Experiencia en diseño técnico, arquitectura de aplicaciones o definición de soluciones.

  • Capacidad para analizar aplicaciones existentes y definir su migración hacia arquitecturas modernas.

  • Experiencia o conocimientos en APX.

  • Participación en proyectos de modernización, transformación o migración tecnológica.

Se Valorará

  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación Mainframe a Java.

  • Experiencia en sector bancario o financiero.

Job Title: Undergrad Intern – R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (Summer 2027)

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Undergrad Intern – R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. The intern will be an integral member of the R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (R&D EOS) organization, which is focused on driving innovation beyond the molecule and applying digital strategies to simplify processes. The 4 functional areas within R&D EOS are:

  • Strategy: Powering-up industry-leading R&D through strategy, functional transformation, and performance excellence
  • Portfolio & Program Management: Turning product strategy into execution to bring medicines to patients faster
  • R&D Business Operations: Innovating excellence and navigating efficiency to manage R&D operational activities, including budget planning and contracting, suppliers, laboratories, workforce strategy and environmental, social & governance (ESG)
  • R&D Knowledge & Learning: Transforming and advancing digitization and contemporized learning as well as cultivating talent & culture for a people-centric and inclusive workforce

As a member of Amgen's R&D EOS Organization, your work will be highly collaborative across multiple functions and levels within Amgen, including for example, Research & Development, Corporate Affairs, Digital Technology & Innovation, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging, and others. You will be uniquely responsible for one or more key projects that will advance R&D EOS’ mission, including the following:

  • Developing a project charter to map out objectives and identify key stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables
  • Leveraging your analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work in teams, identify problems, conduct research, develop recommendations through qualitative and quantitative analysis, and deliver final projects
  • Presenting your deliverables/findings through various forums including an intern-wide poster session and a final readout to executive management
  • You will also be engaged in learning activities, networking with colleagues across the company, and enjoying full access to Amgen’s Employee Resource Groups

This job description serves as a general outline for the responsibilities of an undergraduate intern in R&D EOS. The specific tasks and requirements may vary depending on the organization and its projects.

Program Eligibility Requirements

  • Expected completion of one year of study from an accredited college or university prior to the internship commencing
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program
  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative individual we seek is hard-working with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for an undergrad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • 18 years or older
  • Currently enrolled in a full-time Bachelor’s Degree program from an accredited college or university with a 3.0 minimum GPA or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

· Degree concentration(s) in Business, Finance, Management Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, Communications, Psychology, Human Resources, Information Science or a related field

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

· Highly organized, with an ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

· Enthusiastic, proactive, and a willingness to learn

· Adaptability in navigating and effectively responding to ambiguity and evolving circumstances and priorities

· Basic understanding of project management concepts is a plus

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $28.87 per hour.

  • Build a network of colleagues that will endure and grow throughout your time with us and beyond.
  • Bring your authentic self to the table and become the professional you’re inspired to be through accepting a culture that values the diversity of thought and experience and will flex to your strengths and possibilities.
  • Participate in executive and social networking events, as well as community volunteer projects.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the duration of this program. Sponsorship for future FTE roles is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

jobs.description:
Liebe*r zukünftig*r Kolleg*in,

heute bewerben wir uns bei dir und stellen dir unser Unternehmen, unsere Leistungen und das Besondere an Plusnet vor:

Wir leben und gestalten Kommunikation

Die Plusnet GmbH, eine Tochtergesellschaft der EnBW, ist ein deutsches Telekommunikationsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Geschäftskunden. Plusnet betreibt eine eigene, bundesweite Netzinfrastruktur und verfügt über jahrzehntelange Erfahrung im Betrieb unterschiedlicher Breitband-Technologien. Auf Basis ihres umfassenden Know-hows stellt die Plusnet Gruppe mehr als 40.000 Geschäftskunden jeder Größenordnung zuverlässige und hochsichere Sprach- und Datendienste zur Verfügung. Darüber hinaus agiert Plusnet als Vermittler zukunftssicherer Netze: Über die bundesweite offene Connectivity-Handelsplattform Netbridge können Partner eigene Glasfasernetze bzw. andere Infrastrukturen besser auslasten oder zusätzliche Reichweite für eigene Services gewinnen. Das Unternehmen mit Sitz in Köln beschäftigt rund 500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an insgesamt zehn deutschen Standorten. Diese wichtigen Themen kannst du mitgestalten und voranbringen.

Dein Wirkungsfeld

Als Partner Manager Retail verantwortest du die strategische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung eines definierten Portfolios von Retail- und Vertriebspartnern im indirekten Vertrieb. Du gewinnst, aktivierst und entwickelst Partner gezielt weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie ihr Vertriebs- und Umsatzpotenzial ausschöpfen. Dabei steuerst du die Partnerperformance entlang von Umsatz, Pipeline, Conversion und Kampagnenaktivität und stellst eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit sicher.

Requirements

Dein Aufgabenfeld

  • Du verantwortest dein Partnerportfolio: Du betreust Retail- und Vertriebspartner im indirekten Vertrieb, gewinnst neue Partner und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften strategisch und wirtschaftlich weiter.

  • Du planst und steuerst die Partnerperformance: Du entwickelst Partner-Business-Pläne mit Umsatz-, Pipeline- und Forecast-Zielen und leitest aus relevanten KPIs konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Du aktivierst und befähigst deine Partner: Du stellst die Kampagnenfähigkeit sicher, steuerst Lead-Zuführung und -Bearbeitung und unterstützt deine Partner durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und eine einheitliche Verkaufsstory.

  • Du entwickelst Partnerschaften nachhaltig: In regelmäßigen Business- und Performance-Reviews identifizierst du Potenziale und Risiken, gibst strukturiertes Feedback und leitest Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung ab.

  • Du steuerst Schnittstellen und Eskalationen: Du koordinierst wiederkehrende Themen, klärst Channel-Konflikte mit dem Key Account Management und sorgst für transparente CRM-, Pipeline- und Forecast-Daten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst relevante Erfahrung mit: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im indirekten Vertrieb, Channel- oder Partner Management mit.

  • Verständnis für Partnervertrieb: Partnerökosysteme, Lead Management, Kampagnensteuerung und Vertriebsperformance sind für dich vertrautes Terrain.

  • Stärke in der Partnerentwicklung: Du weißt, wie du Partner gewinnst, aktivierst, befähigst und mithilfe von Enablement und Performance Management nachhaltig entwickelst.

  • Kommerzielles und vertriebliches Know-how: Du kannst Rahmen- und Konditionsverträge sicher verhandeln, steuerst Partner anhand relevanter Vertriebskennzahlen und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für B2B-Telekommunikations-, ITK- und cloudbasierte Lösungen mit. Dabei kannst du deren Nutzen verständlich und vertriebsorientiert vermitteln.

  • Struktur & Kommunikation: Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-/PRM- und Reporting-Tools, kommunizierst souverän mit Partnern und internen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse mit.

Bei uns sind alle Menschen willkommen. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, mit oder ohne Behinderung.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich bei uns zu bewerben!

jobs.excerpt: Title: Principal Marketing Specialist, Tradeshows & Events At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world.
jobs.description:
Title:

Principal Marketing Specialist, Tradeshows & Events

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.


Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 


Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 


Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 


The Principal Marketing Specialist is a key member of the Corporate Marketing Tradeshows & Events team, providing strategic leadership for tradeshow, event, sponsorship, and membership marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for developing, driving, and optimizing event marketing strategies that support business growth, strengthen brand visibility, enhance customer engagement, and advance strategic business development objectives across domestic and international markets. Working collaboratively with business leaders, business development teams, and marketing stakeholders, the Principal Marketing Specialist leads a diverse portfolio of high-profile events while providing strategic guidance, performance insights, and recommendations that maximize organizational impact and return on investment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the full lifecycle of event management initiatives, spanning strategic planning, vendor sourcing and oversight, logistics coordination, and budget adherence, ensuring alignment with overarching brand and business objectives.
  • Serve as a cross-functional project leader, managing multiple concurrent initiatives and ensuring deliverables are executed on time, within budget, and in support of business goals.
  • Drive the planning and execution of key tradeshows, conferences, sponsorships, memberships, and affiliated events supporting Trinzic's business objectives, ensuring a high-impact and engaging brand presence.
  • Oversee all aspects of event execution, including venue selection, exhibit and booth design, meeting schedules, staffing coordination, A/V, catering, shipping logistics, and on-site event management.
  • Lead the planning and execution of executive engagements, customer events, media days, and other high-visibility corporate events involving executive leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Partner with business leaders, business development teams, and marketing stakeholders to define event objectives, strategic messaging, audience engagement strategies, and success metrics that support growth and customer engagement.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop event marketing materials and assets, including presentations, brochures, signage, multimedia content, promotional campaigns, and branded merchandise that reinforce Trinzic's value proposition.
  • Establish and track event performance metrics, deliver post-event reporting and analysis, and provide actionable recommendations to enhance future event strategies and maximize return on investment.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with event organizers, industry associations, sponsors, vendors, and external partners, negotiating contracts and ensuring successful delivery of services.
  • Develop, manage, and reconcile event, sponsorship, and membership budgets while identifying opportunities to optimize resources and maximize value.
  • Facilitate planning meetings, readiness reviews, and post-event debriefs to align stakeholders, evaluate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement across event programs.
  • Ensure consistent brand representation and excellence across all event touchpoints while managing multiple complex events in a fast-paced environment.
  • Oversee membership administration and event-related financial activities, including contract management, sponsorship fulfillment, purchase requisitions, payment processing, and budget reconciliation.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive marketing experience, including direct hands-on experience developing and executing tradeshow, event marketing, sponsorship, and experiential marketing programs.
  • Experience planning and executing complex national and international tradeshows, conferences, sponsorships, executive events, and customer engagements.
  • Experience managing event budgets, vendor contracts, sponsorship investments, and related financial processes.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including evenings and weekends, as required.

Professional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of event marketing, tradeshow strategy, sponsorship activation, and event planning best practices.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and budget requirements.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with experience measuring event effectiveness and translating results into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate and manage relationships with vendors, venues, industry organizations, and external partners.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, and JIRA or similar project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting defense, government contracting, aerospace, logistics, space, or technology organizations, including planning and executing events that engage U.S. Government, Department of Defense, and federal civilian customers.
  • Experience managing events of varying size, complexity, and format, ranging from executive meetings and customer engagements to large-scale tradeshows, conferences, and sponsorship activations.
  • Professional certification in event management, marketing, or project management.
  • Experience utilizing CRM, event management, marketing automation, or analytics platforms to measure campaign and event performance.

Location: The ideal candidate will be located in the Washington, D.C. area however remote candidates are encouraged to apply.


Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.


Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.


KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Director, Data Architecture owns the strategy, standards, and team behind how data moves through Supplier.io, from source systems and web-scraping pipelines through ingestion, transformation, and governed delivery into the warehouses and marts the rest of the business relies on. You'll operate as a peer to our other engineering leaders, setting data architecture direction jointly with the CTO, while staying accountable for the reliability, quality, and governance of every data workflow we run.

You'll lead two distinct groups: a Data Engineering team building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and a Data Operations Engineering team running and maintaining the processes already in production. In the near term, before the team and its processes are fully built out, this role is hands-on: you'll be designing pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly, not just directing from a distance.

What You Will Do

Data Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Own the multi-year data architecture strategy across our data warehouses and operational data stores, including evolving toward a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) lakehouse model.
  • Design and own our data lake and warehouse architecture, including the formation and population of data marts that serve analytics, product, and stakeholder reporting needs.
  • Set the orchestration strategy and standards for all data workflows, including source ingestion, web-scraping pipelines, ETL/ELT, and automated workflow management, and standardize the tooling used across the function.
  • Own the infrastructure and administration behind our data warehouses and pipelines, including capacity, reliability, and cost.
  • Own data governance end to end: the policies, standards, and practices for data quality, lineage, access, retention, and classification across every system of record.

Team & Execution Leadership

  • Build, lead, and grow two functions: Data Engineering, building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and Data Operations Engineering, running and maintaining existing production data processes.
  • Decide how the function is organized as it scales, including when and whether to add management layers beneath you to run day-to-day execution.
  • Stay hands-on early: design and review pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly until the team is built out to carry that execution independently, and stay close enough to the technology afterward to make credible architecture calls.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with engineering leadership to keep data architecture decisions aligned with company-wide standards.
  • Work closely with data engineering teams on technical planning and delivery for our core data products.
  • Partner with product, analytics, and other business stakeholders across the company to understand data needs and translate them into warehouse and data mart designs.

Data Quality & Compliance

  • Define and enforce data quality gates, lineage tracking, and auditability standards across all data pipelines.
  • Own data access controls, classification, and retention policy across the data estate.
  • Ensure compliance-relevant and audit-sensitive data is handled according to governance standards as our data sources and customer base grow.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, including 5+ years in a Director or Manager-level leadership role owning architecture strategy and a team, not just individual delivery.
  • Deep, hands-on experience designing and operating cloud data warehouse or lakehouse architectures (Snowflake and/or BigQuery), including medallion (bronze, silver, gold) patterns.
  • Experience integrating a range of source systems (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and building ingestion and ETL pipelines from varied and unstructured sources, including web-scraping pipelines and background job orchestration.
  • A track record of building and scaling a data engineering or data platform organization, including deciding when and how to split engineering and operations functions.
  • Strong data governance background: establishing policies and standards for data quality, lineage, access, and retention in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment.
  • Experience setting technical direction jointly with peer engineering leaders and influencing architecture decisions across teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, comfortable setting strategy with peer leaders and reporting data platform health, cost, and risk directly to the CTO.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience consolidating or re-architecting data platforms following an acquisition or significant data source expansion.
  • Experience with orchestration tooling such as Airflow or dbt, and with scraping or crawling infrastructure at scale.
  • Background establishing data marts and self-service analytics layers for non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, Soda, or similar).

The Data Analyst II keeps data accurate, complete, and on time for a large enterprise Salesforce platform that exchanges records with multiple external partners.   • Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau or CRM Analytics.
  • Support data validation and reconciliation for the Education Cloud migration.
  • Communicate data issues and resolutions to external partners in the language of the data dictionary.

  • 3+ years of data analysis experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce data within the last 12 months: SOQL, reports, and Data Loader.
  • Advanced SQL and Excel.
  • Experience validating and reconciling data exchanged between organizations.

jobs.excerpt: About SuiteOp Hospitality is one of the most human businesses in the world, and one of the hardest to run.
jobs.description:
About SuiteOp

Hospitality is one of the most human businesses in the world, and one of the hardest to run. Behind every great stay is someone who answered a guest at midnight, a cleaner who turned a home in two hours, and an operator holding it all together with spreadsheets and group chats.

We started SuiteOp because we've been those operators. Our founders ran rentals before they built software for them, and that's still how we build: we sit with operators, watch where their day breaks, and fix it.

Today more than 30,000 units run on SuiteOp, across short-term rentals and boutique hotels. With SuiteOp V2, AI agents take on the repetitive work, from guest messages to turnovers, so operators and their teams can get back to the part that matters: hospitality.

We're a small team (seed stage, $3M+ raised), headquartered in New York with customers around the world. We care deeply about the craft. We sweat the details operators feel every day, we ship fast, and we use AI in everything we do because it lets a small team build something great.

About the role

SuiteOp is growing fast in Europe, and we need someone on the ground to make sure every European operator who signs with us gets live and loves it. Onboarding is the heart of this role. You'll guide new customers from signed contract to launch day and beyond. Our onboarding is heavily powered by AI: agents handle much of the setup, and you'll be the person who makes sure every customer feels supported, confident, and ready. Then you'll help us make it even faster for the next one.

You bring energy to every conversation and keep momentum going. You guide customers confidently through each step, secure clear next steps, and get them live.

You'll work closely with our Customer Success & Solutions Lead in New York, and what you learn from European operators will shape what we build next.

What you'll do

  • Own onboarding from signed contract to go-live for new customers across Spain and the rest of Europe
  • Lead onboarding calls in Spanish and English: kickoff, configuration, training, and launch
  • Become a SuiteOp V2 expert and guide customers through best practices
  • Use AI to build onboarding plans, checklists, and timelines, so every account keeps moving without manual overhead
  • Turn customer conversations into clear, actionable feedback for Engineering, using Claude and our internal tools to spot patterns across accounts
  • Build onboarding guides, videos, and templates in Spanish and English that help customers succeed on their own
  • Watch account health and remove blockers before customers feel them

AI is how we work

Our team runs on Claude. It isn't a trend for us. It means less time on busywork and more time with customers. We're looking for someone who already works this way and loves it.

  • You build AI workflows and agents that make onboarding faster and more personal, and you can't wait to show us one you're proud of
  • You reach for AI first to draft, summarize, and organize, so your time goes to the customer
  • You don't wait for structure: you build it, then automate it
  • Bonus: you've built with Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

What you bring

  • You love helping people, and you stay calm and kind on a customer's busiest day
  • You can make a complex product feel simple
  • Native or fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken
  • 2 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, customer success, account management, consulting, or a similar role
  • Experience running customer meetings and guiding customers through technical setup
  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Intercom, Notion, or Zendesk
  • Organized and detail-oriented, comfortable managing several customers at once
  • Bonus: Portuguese, French, Italian, or German
  • Bonus: experience in hospitality, property management, or a startup

Why you'll love it here

  • You'll see the difference you make: operators get hours of their week back, and you'll hear it from them
  • You'll work closely with the founders and engineers, and your ideas will turn into product
  • You'll be one of our first team members in Europe and help shape how we take care of every European customer

Compensation

  • Base salary: €42,000 to €50,000
  • Equity in SuiteOp

This is a remote role based in Spain (Madrid or Barcelona is a plus), working European business hours.

If you love helping people succeed and want operators to fall in love with how their business runs, we'd love to meet you.
