jobs.description:
Be part of a team that values safety, inclusion, and excellence

We are one of the largest U.S. railroads transporting the nation’s freight across 28 western states and 3 Canadian provinces. As a member of our team, you will play a role in supporting the movement of essential products and materials that help feed, clothe, supply, and power communities throughout America and the world.

bnsf | tech: innovating and transforming the future of freight rail
bnsf | tech is the technology division making BNSF the preeminent freight and mobility company in north america.



Are you ready to drive change? If you are passionate about making a difference and eager to advance your career in a dynamic and supportive environment, we want you on our team! join us in reshaping the future of freight rail and discover a fulfilling career where your contributions matter.We are committed to a culture where all employees are included, belong, and have equal opportunity to achieve their full potential. Come make a difference with us!

Learn more about BNSF and our Benefits

Job Location: REMOTE
Anticipated Start Date: 2/1/2027, 6/14/2027, 9/20/2027
Number of Positions: 30
Annual Salary: $105,000

The position starts at $105,000 and represents the amount bnsf | tech reasonably expects to pay for the position and is determined by the hiring location and additional factors including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education. In addition to base pay and bonus eligibility, BNSF offers a comprehensive benefits package.

This is a full-time remote position. Employees may work from anywhere within the contiguous 48 states of the United States.

Travel is up to 20%. Travel expenses for business needs will be covered by BNSF.

The BNSF Tech Trainee Program is designed for recent graduates eager to launch their careers in technology and innovation within the freight rail industry. This immersive program offers a deep dive into BNSF Railway’s operations, culture, and technology organization.

The tech trainee role begins with in person onboarding at our Corporate Headquarters in Fort Worth, TX where you will gain insights into the railroad industry, BNSF’s strategic vision and how bnsf | tech is transforming the future of freight rail. During this time, tech trainees will also engage in hands-on coding challenges and collaborative problem solving. Tech trainees will develop software for customers at scale, analyze data and solve complex problems with a team. Trainees will gain formal training and hands-on experience in a fast-paced, innovative environment while receiving support from managers and mentors along the way.

What we do:

product engineering: bridge the gap between vision and reality by transforming complex rail logistics and workflows into high-performing products that meet user needs, enhance efficiency and accelerate our business.

platform engineering: develop solutions that connect our customers through advanced marketing, unified identity and communication services. Our platform engineers optimize strategies and deliver innovative services to support operations.

data & ai: lead our charge into the future as an ai company by transforming our data assets into a real time enterprise.

infrastructure: build rail’s first hybrid cloud to enable millions of freight transactions a day with an open-source stack that delivers the lowest unit cost of technology.

enterprise engineering: empower the workforce with cutting-edge collaboration tools and services. Our enterprise engineers boost productivity, enhance mobility and ensure reliable systems for finance, human resources legal operations and more.

cybersecurity: protect the company, our customers and employees against cyber threats and innovate engineering solutions for a more resilient rail network.

Applicants will be notified via e-mail regarding potential interviews, testing, and hiring events for this position. Please check your e-mail daily.

Key responsibilities may include:

Write production-quality code for well-defined tasks.

Follow team coding standards and processes.

Participate in design reviews to learn best practices.

Write and maintain unit/integration tests.

Debug and fix straightforward issues.

Seek feedback proactively and apply it to improve.

jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States or Canada.

JOIN OUR TEAM!

Bitovi is looking for a Backend Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients: backend services in Java, Go, TypeScript, Python, and C#, Temporal for workflow orchestration, and Kafka for event streaming, all running on Kubernetes and AWS. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration and systems engineering seriously, and have ideas on how to make delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

WHO YOU ARE

You’re experienced building and running backend applications at the enterprise level, and you own your services all the way to production. You think like a systems engineer, reasoning about how services, workflows, and the infrastructure under them behave together, especially when something fails. You’re comfortable working in more than one language and pick up a new stack without fuss, because client work rarely matches your favorite one. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world systems as an integral team member, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

You’ll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

  • Professional experience building and operating production backend services in at least one of Java, Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, or C#. Production experience in more than one, and a willingness to move between them as client needs change, is a strong plus

  • Practical experience with Temporal or another workflow orchestration engine (Cadence, AWS Step Functions, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar), including modeling multi-step workflows, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes

  • Hands-on experience deploying and running production services on a major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), comfortable with IAM, basic networking, and managed data and messaging services

  • A systems engineering mindset: understanding of scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems

  • A solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices

  • Experience with observability in practice: logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)

  • Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications

Nice to have

  • Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs: schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus

  • Kafka or other event streaming experience: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag

  • Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads

  • Experience planning and executing migrations: application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime

Other skills we value

Temporal depth

  • Running Temporal in production, self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud

  • Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations

  • Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)

  • Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g., APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud)

Kafka & event streaming depth

  • Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)

  • Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)

  • Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores

  • Techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

Platform depth

  • GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, Crossplane, ACK, or similar

  • Helm chart authoring, Kubernetes operators, and CRDs

  • Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)

  • Building or contributing to an internal developer platform

General

  • Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)

  • API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)

  • AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)

  • Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

WHO WE ARE

Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them, with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions. We want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

WHAT YOU’LL DO AT BITOVI

Build durable systems. Design and implement backend services, Temporal workflows, and event-driven pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution the right way, from first workflow to production scale.

Modernize with care. Help clients move workflows, services, and data onto new platforms, working with teammates to plan cutovers that treat safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

Ship to production. Deploy and run your services on AWS and Kubernetes, working alongside Bitovi’s platform engineers on CI/CD and infrastructure. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we’ll always do our best to work with your schedule.

Teach. We’ll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your expertise.

BENEFITS WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity

  • Completely remote work with flexible hours

  • 401(k) matching

  • 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

Benefits vary by country of employment.

HOW TO APPLY

Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions. Yes, we read through all the answers!

Please note that we are not interested in working with recruiters. All job offers are contingent on passing a background check. Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in the United States or Canada; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.# Backend Developer Consultant

jobs.excerpt: IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email.
jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $25–$60/hr

Role Title: Game Developer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging Game Developers to contribute to a pioneering customer project focused on evaluating and advancing AI capabilities in the domain of game creation and interaction. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.
  2. Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.
  3. Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.
  4. Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.
  5. Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.
  6. Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.
  7. Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.
  2. A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.
  3. Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
  4. Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.
  5. Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
  6. Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.
  7. Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.excerpt: UnionTrack builds the software labor unions use to run their operations, from membership management to training and certification.
jobs.description:
UnionTrack builds the software labor unions use to run their operations, from membership management to training and certification. Unions face constant pressure to deliver more for their members while keeping operating costs down, and growing regulation is changing how they must store and transmit members’ personal data.

UnionTrack takes that work off their plate so unions can spend their time and resources on their core mission: protecting the rights of today’s workforce and training the next generation of skilled workers. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for labor union management and membership operations.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer to help build and grow the UnionTrack platform. You’ll work across the stack, from SQL Server and C# APIs to the Angular screens our customers use every day, with a strong focus on the financial features unions depend on, such as dues, payments, billing, and reporting. This role will both support our legacy systems and help us build the next iteration of Engage, our flagship platform. You’ll also help us find practical ways to use AI, both in how we build software and in the product itself. This is a fully remote (US or Canada Based) position reporting to the Director of Development.

What you’ll do:

  • Build features end to end: C# and ASP.NET Core Web API on the back end, SQL Server for data, and Angular on the front end.
  • Own the front-end work for the features you build, including layouts, forms, and data-heavy screens, using our existing design patterns and component libraries. You’ll partner with our UI team on larger design efforts.
  • Build and maintain the financial side of the platform, including dues and payment processing, billing, reconciliation, and financial reporting, with the accuracy and auditability that handling money requires.

Requirements Gathering & Data Architecture: Gather business requirements in an iterative agile/scrum model and define structural requirements for new analytical applications, including data transformation processes and source-to-target mappings that ensure data integrity and traceability.

Healthcare Data Analysis & Profiling: Analyze structured and semi-structured healthcare datasets — including medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data — to conduct detailed data profiling, ad hoc analyses, and complex investigations of functional data issues.

Scalable Reporting & Pipeline Development: Design and build scalable reporting processes and production-grade data pipelines using advanced SQL, Databricks, and cloud-native tools that support ongoing analytical and regulatory reporting needs.

Regulatory & Compliance Analytics: Produce analysis supporting HEDIS, STAR ratings, CMS encounter submissions, and risk adjustment reporting to ensure the organization is audit-ready and compliant with applicable CMS and HIPAA standards.

Data Quality & Governance: Validate data accuracy across systems, apply schema validation and data contract enforcement, and own data quality validation logic to ensure that all outputs are decision-ready, traceable, and compliant with PHI/PII requirements.

AI-First Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and apply AI-assisted querying, automated data preparation, and natural language analytics tools to accelerate insight generation and increase analytical capacity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Data SME Guidance: Serve as the data subject matter expert for the team, collaborating with analysts, product managers, and platform/cloud engineers to deliver reliable data solutions and provide technical guidance to junior analytical resources.

  • Experience in a regulated, HIPAA-compliant data environment with PHI/PII datasets

Preferred:

  • Experience applying AI or automation tools to analytical workflows, including natural language querying, automated data preparation, or predictive modeling

Education

Preferred:

Training

  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and at least one BI or data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent), demonstrated through project work

Technical/Role-Specific Skills

jobs.excerpt: Want to build instead of inherit?  System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up.
jobs.description:
Want to build instead of inherit? System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up.

This is a true greenfield opportunity. You won’t be inheriting years of legacy frontend code or simply working through an established backlog. You’ll have the opportunity to help establish the frontend architecture, component patterns, development workflows, and technical standards that shape the application as it grows.

We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend development skills with broader software engineering fundamentals. You should be comfortable building modern web applications, integrating with APIs, working within GitHub and CI/CD workflows, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and other technical specialists. React is our preferred direction, but because the application is still being built, we value strong engineering fundamentals and experience with modern frontend frameworks over expertise in one narrowly defined stack.

We also want someone who knows how to use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively. AI should make you faster at tasks like documentation, testing, scaffolding, debugging, and repetitive development but it shouldn't replace your ability to understand the code, challenge the output, and make sound engineering decisions.

If you're energized by a blank canvas, enjoy solving problems without having every step prescribed, and want to see your technical decisions directly influence a new product, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Frontend Application Layer: Help design and build the frontend from the ground up, establishing scalable patterns for components, routing, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build Production-Ready Experiences: Translate product requirements and UI/UX concepts into responsive, intuitive, high-quality application features.
  • Integrate with APIs: Build reliable integrations between the frontend and backend services, confidently working with API contracts, data structures, payloads, application state, error handling, and asynchronous workflows.
  • Shape Frontend Architecture: Participate in technical decisions around frameworks, libraries, application structure, reusable components, testing strategies, and development standards.
  • Work Across Engineering Boundaries: Collaborate with backend development, AI/technical specialists, QA, and product leadership to solve problems that span multiple parts of the application.
  • Build Efficient Development Workflows: Work within GitHub, AWS/GIT-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, integration, and deployment.
  • Use AI to Increase Engineering Velocity: Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate documentation, testing, debugging, code scaffolding, and repetitive engineering tasks while independently reviewing, validating, and improving generated output.
  • Automate Where It Makes Sense: Write lightweight scripts or utilities to eliminate repetitive tasks, manipulate data, support development environments, or improve engineering workflows.
  • Deliver Iteratively: Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and deliver working software through an Agile/Scrum development process.
  • Contribute Beyond Your Code: Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months, you will have:

  • Helped establish the technical foundation and architecture of a new frontend application.
  • Built and delivered production-ready features that turn product requirements into an intuitive user experience.
  • Established reliable integrations between the frontend and backend APIs.
  • Contributed reusable components, patterns, and development standards that make the application easier to extend and maintain.
  • Demonstrated the ability to independently troubleshoot issues across the frontend, API, data, and development workflow layers.
  • Integrated AI-assisted development into your workflow in ways that measurably improve speed and efficiency without compromising engineering quality.
  • Become a trusted technical partner to product leadership, backend development, QA, and other members of the engineering team.

Must Haves

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on experience building modern frontend applications.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern component-based frontend development.
  • Professional experience with React or another modern frontend framework. React experience is preferred, but strong engineers coming from comparable frameworks will be considered.
  • Experience designing and building reusable frontend components and responsive application interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience integrating applications with RESTful APIs or comparable backend services.
  • Experience using Git and GitHub in a collaborative software engineering environment.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and modern software development workflows.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including maintainability, testing, debugging, source control, and code review.
  • Ability to work independently through ambiguous technical problems and clearly explain the reasoning behind your implementation decisions.
  • Experience using AI-assisted software development tools for activities such as code generation, testing, documentation, debugging, or development acceleration—and the technical judgment to validate their output.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience helping build a new application, product, or significant feature from the ground up.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Familiarity with GIT/AWS development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud-based application delivery.
  • Experience working across frontend/backend boundaries or collaborating closely with backend engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation using Node.js, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience establishing frontend architecture, component libraries, design systems, or engineering standards.
  • Experience with automated frontend or unit testing.
  • Exposure to applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities or other intelligent application services.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You’re likely to enjoy this role if you like building more than maintaining.

You don’t need someone else to define every implementation detail before you can get started. You’re comfortable taking a requirement, asking the right questions, evaluating different approaches, making a recommendation, and turning that recommendation into working software.

You also recognize that modern engineering is changing. You’re interested in using AI and automation to remove repetitive work and increase your output, but you understand that engineering judgment still matters. You can explain your code, defend your technical decisions, identify when generated code is wrong, and improve a solution rather than accepting the first answer a tool provides.

Most importantly, you want ownership. This is an opportunity to help establish something new rather than simply inherit what someone else already built.

What is the Compensation Range for this role?

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $145,000 annually for full-time status. Actual compensation within this range at Veilant is determined by numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, including experience, education, certifications, technical skills, as well as contract-specific affordability and labor categories, the scope and responsibilities of the role, market and business considerations, and geographic location.

Here are some Perks at System High!

Benefits That Support Your Life and Career

  • Medical, dental, vision, and prescription coverage options.
  • Paid time off that grows with tenure, plus 11 paid holidays annually.
  • A 401(k) retirement savings plan and financial planning guidance.
  • Up to $5,250 annually in tuition assistance for approved coursework.
  • Support for professional training and certifications.
  • Company HSA contributions of $600 for individual coverage or $1,200 for family coverage, prorated.
  • Company paid life insurance, plus short term and long term disability coverage.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office
  • Constantly work with computers and other information technology equipment
  • The ability to communicate information and ideas in a classroom style format, may stand at a podium for long periods of time

We are looking for engineers who understand the fundamentals behind the technologies they use, can reason through complex problems, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership from problem definition through production support.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Experience with APIs, automated testing, cloud applications, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
    • What Success Looks Like
      You are a strong, independent engineer who can solve complex problems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and deliver reliable production software. You understand the fundamentals behind your technology choices, take ownership of outcomes, and contribute to the technical growth of the team.
      You communicate proactively, collaborate effectively, and know when to work through a problem independently versus when to involve others. You raise issues early and keep your team informed as work progresses.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Job Description:

Seeking a seasoned Software Developer Principal with deep Snowflake expertise and strong AWS experience to design, develop, and support enterprise data and software solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong SQL and Linux skills, experience with GitHub and Jenkins CI/CD processes, knowledge of deployment methodologies, and a solid understanding of unit testing and data structures. Python experience is preferred, while JavaScript and API development experience are considered desirable. This role may provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams while supporting critical business initiatives.


The Software Developer Principal serves as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise software solutions and data platforms. This role performs all phases of the software development lifecycle, collaborates with business and technical stakeholders to define requirements, and develops scalable solutions utilizing modern cloud and data technologies. The Software Developer Principal provides technical leadership, supports system optimization efforts, and ensures software quality, performance, and maintainability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and support.
  • Analyze business and user requirements to design and implement software solutions that meet organizational objectives.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize applications, data pipelines, and system integrations.
  • Create technical designs, models, diagrams, and documentation to communicate system architecture and application functionality.
  • Design, develop, and maintain solutions utilizing Snowflake, AWS cloud services, SQL, and Linux-based environments.
  • Participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards, best practices, and quality assurance processes.
  • Execute software updates, enhancements, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning activities.
  • Develop and execute unit tests to ensure software reliability and quality.
  • Support CI/CD deployment processes utilizing GitHub, Jenkins, and related DevOps tools.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure technology solutions.
  • Prepare reports and provide analysis on project status, technical specifications, risks, and development activities.
  • Recommend and implement best practices for documentation, maintainability, scalability, and future system enhancements.
  • Support production deployments and issue resolution activities.
  • May mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to less experienced team members.
  • May serve as a technical lead, team lead, or task lead on software development initiatives.
  • Occasional after-hours support may be required during deployments, maintenance activities, or critical production incidents.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications


Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical discipline, or equivalent technical training and/or relevant work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on software development experience.
  • Experience participating in all phases of the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience working in Agile or similar development environments.

Technical Skills

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Snowflake development, optimization, and administration.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-based application development.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex query development and database optimization.
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix environments.
  • Experience with GitHub source control management and Jenkins CI/CD processes.
  • Experience supporting software deployment and release management processes.
  • Strong understanding of unit testing methodologies and test automation practices.
  • Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing applications using Python.
  • Experience with JavaScript development.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and system integration concepts.
  • Experience with data engineering, ETL processes, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience leading technical projects or mentoring development teams.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of software engineering principles and development best practices.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and secure software solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to team success.

Location: Remote work environment.

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.
